abnormal_observation.en: A VIN mismatch, suspected character or plate alteration, unclear record source or date, or an unexplained collision, major-repair, claim, title constraint, or non-compliant-modification clue requires official or professional verification.
abnormal_observation.zh: VIN 不一致、字符或铭牌疑似改动，记录来源/时间不明，或记录出现未解释的事故、重大维修、出险、权利限制或违规改装线索；须由官方或专业渠道复核。

check_what.en: Compare a masked VIN character by character at the visible manufacturer plate and vehicle documents, then review collision, repair, insurance, title-constraint, and modification records through an authorized or officially available channel. Save only the comparison result and mask the complete VIN and personal information in evidence.
check_what.zh: 在制造商铭牌和车辆文件的可见位置逐位核对脱敏 VIN；再使用获授权或官方可用渠道核对事故、维修、出险、权利限制和改装记录。只保存核对结论，证据照片必须遮蔽完整 VIN 与个人信息。

detailed_explanation.en: “Verify the VIN and vehicle legal/history records” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “VIN码核验事故、维修、出险记录，检查车辆是否抵押、查封或存在改装违规”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The masked VIN matches character by character across the vehicle plate, contract, and authorized records, with no unexplained collision, major-repair, claim, lien, seizure, or non-compliant-modification clue in the records available.
normal_observation.zh: 车辆铭牌、合同与获授权记录中的脱敏 VIN 逐位一致；可用记录未显示未解释的事故、重大维修、出险、抵押、查封或违规改装线索。

localized_label.en: A missing key, severe wear, damaged housing, button, or blade, or any key that fails an agreed function, responds intermittently, or requires force is abnormal.
localized_label.zh: 钥匙缺失、严重磨损、外壳/按键/钥匙齿损坏，或任一钥匙无法完成约定功能、响应间歇性或需要强行操作。

abnormal_observation.en: A missing key, severe wear, damaged housing, button, or blade, or any key that fails an agreed function, responds intermittently, or requires force is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 钥匙缺失、严重磨损、外壳/按键/钥匙齿损坏，或任一钥匙无法完成约定功能、响应间歇性或需要强行操作。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, count electronic and mechanical keys, test locking, unlocking, the trunk, and every fitted remote function one key at a time, and record housing, button, and blade wear. Consult the instructions for an unclear function and never force a mechanical key or open its housing.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后清点电子钥匙和机械钥匙；逐把测试上锁、解锁、后备箱及本车实际配备的遥控功能，并记录外壳、按键和钥匙齿磨损。功能不明时查阅手册，不强扭机械钥匙或拆壳。

detailed_explanation.en: “Keys and mechanical key” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “钥匙应检查数量，磨损程度，机械钥匙以及全部功能”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Delivered electronic and mechanical key counts match the agreement, housings, buttons, and blades remain usable, and each key correctly operates locking, unlocking, the trunk, and every fitted remote function tested.
normal_observation.zh: 交付钥匙与机械钥匙数量和约定一致，外壳、按键及钥匙齿可用；逐把测试的上锁、解锁、后备箱及实际配备遥控功能均有正确响应。

warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

localized_label.en: A deep scratch, localized gloss loss, distorted reflection, color mismatch, overspray, orange-peel difference, or distinct repaint edge is a repair clue to record.
localized_label.zh: 出现深划痕、局部失光、反射扭曲、色差、喷漆飞雾、橘皮差异或清晰补漆分界；只作为修复线索记录。

abnormal_observation.en: A deep scratch, localized gloss loss, distorted reflection, color mismatch, overspray, orange-peel difference, or distinct repaint edge is a repair clue to record.
abnormal_observation.zh: 出现深划痕、局部失光、反射扭曲、色差、喷漆飞雾、橘皮差异或清晰补漆分界；只作为修复线索记录。

check_what.en: Under consistent diffuse light, clean visible surfaces and compare adjacent panels from several oblique angles for scratch depth, reflection continuity, gloss, color, orange peel, and paint edges. Capture like-for-like comparison images and do not diagnose a collision from color difference alone.
check_what.zh: 先在一致、漫射光线下清洁可见表面，再从多个斜角比较相邻面板的划痕深度、反射连续性、光泽、颜色、橘皮纹和喷漆边界；发现差异时拍摄同角度对照，不把色差直接诊断为事故。

detailed_explanation.en: “Body paint scratches, reflections, and color match” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车身各涂面划痕、反光、色差检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Under the same light and viewing angle, adjacent paint has continuous gloss, reflection texture, and color with no through-scratch, localized haze, or abrupt repaint boundary.
normal_observation.zh: 同一光线和观察角度下，相邻漆面光泽、反射纹理与颜色连续，未见穿透性划痕、局部雾化或突兀补漆边界。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Under consistent diffuse light, clean visible surfaces and compare adjacent panels from several oblique angles for scratch depth, reflection continuity, gloss, color, orange peel, and paint edges. Capture like-for-like comparison images and do not diagnose a collision from color difference alone.
zh: 先在一致、漫射光线下清洁可见表面，再从多个斜角比较相邻面板的划痕深度、反射连续性、光泽、颜色、橘皮纹和喷漆边界；发现差异时拍摄同角度对照，不把色差直接诊断为事故。

localized_label.en: A one-sided abrupt gap change, excessive or narrow gap, step, raised corner, rubbing, or missing clip indicates a fit or repair difference for follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 单侧缝隙突变、过宽/过窄、错台、翘角、摩擦或卡扣缺失，提示装配或修复差异并需进一步核对。

abnormal_observation.en: A one-sided abrupt gap change, excessive or narrow gap, step, raised corner, rubbing, or missing clip indicates a fit or repair difference for follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 单侧缝隙突变、过宽/过窄、错台、翘角、摩擦或卡扣缺失，提示装配或修复差异并需进一步核对。

check_what.en: With every closure stationary, compare left/right reference points around doors, hood, fenders, and tailgate for gap width, direction, and flushness. A no-pinch gauge may be used, but never use fingers as a gauge or measure a moving closure.
check_what.zh: 在所有开合件完全静止时，从左右可比位置观察车门、机盖、翼子板和尾门的缝隙宽度、走向与平齐度；可使用无夹伤量规，但不得用手指伸入缝隙或在开合中测量。

detailed_explanation.en: “Body-panel gap inspection” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车身部件缝隙检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Adjacent door, hood, fender, and tailgate gaps have continuous width, direction, and flushness, comparable left/right points are similar, and closures show no interference marks.
normal_observation.zh: 车门、机盖、翼子板和尾门相邻缝隙的宽度、走向与平齐度连续，左右可比位置相近，开合件无干涉痕。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With every closure stationary, compare left/right reference points around doors, hood, fenders, and tailgate for gap width, direction, and flushness. A no-pinch gauge may be used, but never use fingers as a gauge or measure a moving closure.
zh: 在所有开合件完全静止时，从左右可比位置观察车门、机盖、翼子板和尾门的缝隙宽度、走向与平齐度；可使用无夹伤量规，但不得用手指伸入缝隙或在开合中测量。

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Only layered rust, perforation, material loss or impact deformation in load-bearing material safely visible from this underbody edge; no professional joining-method verification.
localized_label.zh: 仅当前车底边缘安全可见承载材料的起层锈、穿孔、材料脱落或撞击变形；不包含专业连接方法核验。

abnormal_observation.en: Scaling rust, perforation, structural material loss, extensive wet corrosion, or impact deformation within the visible scope is abnormal and requires recorded professional lift follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 在可见范围发现起层锈、穿孔、结构材料脱落、大片潮湿锈蚀或撞击变形；记录位置并转专业举升复检。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect only visible underbody areas from the vehicle edge using a flashlight, phone, or mirror; never place any body part beneath the vehicle.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后，只从车身边缘用手电筒、手机或镜子观察可见底盘；身体任何部位不得进入车辆下方。

detailed_explanation.en: “Underbody corrosion and rust severity” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “底盘腐蚀/锈迹程度”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Every underbody edge area required by this flow is safely visible and shows no scaling corrosion, perforation, material loss, or fresh impact deformation; if any required critical area is concealed, do not select normal and use unable to confirm.
normal_observation.zh: 本流程要求的底盘外缘区域均可安全看见，表面和连接处无起层锈蚀、穿孔、明显材料脱落或新鲜撞击变形；任一必查关键区被遮挡时不选正常，改选无法确认。

en: placing the body beneath the vehicle
relying on uncertified or unstable support
zh: 身体进入车辆下方
依赖未认证或不稳定支撑

en: a clear view would require placing the head, arm, or body beneath the vehicle
the ground, lighting, or parked vehicle is unstable
a loose panel, active drip, or another unknown hazard is found
zh: 必须把头、手臂或身体伸入车辆下方才能看清
地面、光线或车辆停放不稳定
发现松动护板、滴漏或其他不明危险

warning.en: Observe only from the vehicle edge using a flashlight, phone, or mirror; no part of the body may go beneath the vehicle.
warning.zh: 只能从车身边缘用手电筒、手机或镜子观察；身体不得进入车辆下方。

change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A panel-wide high cluster, edge discontinuity, non-repeatable readings, or misleading cross-material comparison is a repaint or filler clue, not a diagnosis.
localized_label.zh: 单一面板出现成片高值、边缘突变、不可重复读数，或跨不同材质得到误导性差异；结果只作为补漆/腻子复检线索。

localized_label.en: Coating thickness
localized_label.zh: 涂层厚度

abnormal_observation.en: A panel-wide high cluster, edge discontinuity, non-repeatable readings, or misleading cross-material comparison is a repaint or filler clue, not a diagnosis.
abnormal_observation.zh: 单一面板出现成片高值、边缘突变、不可重复读数，或跨不同材质得到误导性差异；结果只作为补漆/腻子复检线索。

check_what.en: Confirm and calibrate the gauge for the material, then take perpendicular multi-point grid or Z-pattern readings on clean same-material metal panels, repeat outliers, and compare only with a justified adjacent reference. Visually inspect bumpers and other incompatible materials instead of forcing a reading.
check_what.zh: 确认漆膜仪适用于待测材质并校准后，在清洁的同材质金属面按网格/Z形多点垂直测量，复测异常点并与有依据的相邻参考面比较；保险杠等非适用材质只做目视检查。

detailed_explanation.en: “Paint-thickness gauge inspection” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “漆膜仪检测”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Repeated readings across clean panels of the same material are consistent and continuous and remain explainable against a verified adjacent reference panel.
normal_observation.zh: 清洁且材质相同的面板多点读数可重复、分布连续，并与已核实的相邻参考面处于可解释范围。

en: climbing the vehicle, standing on a sill or seat, or overreaching
forcing a reading with an uncalibrated or incompatible gauge
comparing across materials or assuming the roof is an original-paint baseline without evidence
zh: 攀爬车身、站上门槛/座椅或过度伸展
用未校准或不兼容量具强行取值
跨材质或无依据地把车顶当原漆基准

en: gauge compatibility or calibration, panel material, or reference justification cannot be confirmed
a point would require climbing, overreaching, or standing on the vehicle
a surface is wet, hot, moving, or a reading cannot be repeated reliably
zh: 量具兼容性/校准状态、面板材质或参考依据无法确认
测点需要攀爬、过度伸展或站上车辆
表面潮湿、高温、运动或读数无法可靠复测

warning.en: First confirm that the paint gauge is compatible with the target material and calibrated, and use only a same-material reference justified by material and repair records. Every point must be safely reachable from the ground; never climb, stand on a sill or seat, or overreach.
warning.zh: 先确认漆膜仪与待测材质兼容并完成校准，只把有材质和维修记录依据的同材质面作为参考；所有测点必须从地面安全可达，不得攀爬、站上门槛/座椅或过度伸展。

en: Confirm and calibrate the gauge for the material, then take perpendicular multi-point grid or Z-pattern readings on clean same-material metal panels, repeat outliers, and compare only with a justified adjacent reference. Visually inspect bumpers and other incompatible materials instead of forcing a reading.
zh: 确认漆膜仪适用于待测材质并校准后，在清洁的同材质金属面按网格/Z形多点垂直测量，复测异常点并与有依据的相邻参考面比较；保险杠等非适用材质只做目视检查。

why_important.en: Exterior differences can indicate repairs, collision damage, corrosion, or fit issues and guide professional follow-up.
why_important.zh: 外观差异可能提示维修、事故、腐蚀或装配问题，并影响后续专业复检重点。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 漆膜仪检测

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A localized response that is markedly duller, hollower, or inconsistent with adjacent same-material areas is a filler, lining, or structure clue and is not conclusive alone.
localized_label.zh: 局部声音明显更闷、更空或与相邻同材质区域不一致；仅记录疑似腻子、内衬或结构差异，不能单凭敲击定论。

abnormal_observation.en: A localized response that is markedly duller, hollower, or inconsistent with adjacent same-material areas is a filler, lining, or structure clue and is not conclusive alone.
abnormal_observation.zh: 局部声音明显更闷、更空或与相邻同材质区域不一致；仅记录疑似腻子、内衬或结构差异，不能单凭敲击定论。

check_what.en: Lightly tap only safely accessible adjacent panels of the same material with comparable force, avoiding glass, plastic, sensors, sharp edges, and damaged areas. Record a localized dull response without drawing a conclusion from tapping alone.
check_what.zh: 只在确认可安全轻敲的同材质相邻覆盖件上，以相近力度逐点比较声音和触感；避开玻璃、塑料、传感器、锐边及已损伤处，记录局部沉闷差异但不单凭敲击下结论。

detailed_explanation.en: “Panel tap comparison” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “敲击检测”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Across safely tapped adjacent areas of the same material, sound and feel are reasonably consistent without a localized markedly dull or hollow response.
normal_observation.zh: 在可安全轻敲的同材质相邻区域，回声和触感相对一致，未出现单点明显沉闷或空鼓差异。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Lightly tap only safely accessible adjacent panels of the same material with comparable force, avoiding glass, plastic, sensors, sharp edges, and damaged areas. Record a localized dull response without drawing a conclusion from tapping alone.
zh: 只在确认可安全轻敲的同材质相邻覆盖件上，以相近力度逐点比较声音和触感；避开玻璃、塑料、传感器、锐边及已损伤处，记录局部沉闷差异但不单凭敲击下结论。

why_important.en: Exterior differences can indicate repairs, collision damage, corrosion, or fit issues and guide professional follow-up.
why_important.zh: 外观差异可能提示维修、事故、腐蚀或装配问题，并影响后续专业复检重点。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 敲击检测

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Glass damage or laminate defect
localized_label.zh: 玻璃裂损或夹层异常

abnormal_observation.en: A spreading crack, star break, edge chip, whitening or bubbles in the laminate, or damage in the viewing area must be recorded without pressing and professionally assessed.
abnormal_observation.zh: 发现延伸裂纹、星点、崩边、夹层发白/气泡或视线区域损伤；不得按压裂口，应记录位置并专业评估。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked in good light, inspect safely visible inner and outer glass surfaces for cracks, edge chips, star breaks, and laminate defects. Do not press a damaged area; mark unable to confirm when the view is obstructed.
check_what.zh: 在光线充足且车辆停稳时，从玻璃内外可见面观察裂纹、崩边、星点和夹层异常；不要在裂口上按压，视线受遮挡时标记无法确认。

detailed_explanation.en: “Glass cracks or damage” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “玻璃裂痕或破损检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Visible glazing surfaces, edges, and laminate are intact, with no crack, star break, edge chip, delamination, or visibility-impairing damage.
normal_observation.zh: 可见玻璃表面、边缘和夹层完整，未见裂纹、星点、崩边、分层或影响视野的损伤。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked in good light, inspect safely visible inner and outer glass surfaces for cracks, edge chips, star breaks, and laminate defects. Do not press a damaged area; mark unable to confirm when the view is obstructed.
zh: 在光线充足且车辆停稳时，从玻璃内外可见面观察裂纹、崩边、星点和夹层异常；不要在裂口上按压，视线受遮挡时标记无法确认。

why_important.en: Glass damage, date inconsistencies, or seal issues can affect visibility, safety, and collision evidence.
why_important.zh: 玻璃损伤、日期或密封异常可能影响视野、安全和事故线索。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 玻璃裂痕或破损检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: One or more materially outlying dates decoded safely under a confirmed applicable rule, or a conflict with replacement records, is only a replacement or collision follow-up clue.
localized_label.zh: 按已确认适用规则安全解读后，单片或多片日期明显离群，或日期与更换记录矛盾；差异只作更换/事故复检线索。

abnormal_observation.en: One or more materially outlying dates decoded safely under a confirmed applicable rule, or a conflict with replacement records, is only a replacement or collision follow-up clue.
abnormal_observation.zh: 按已确认适用规则安全解读后，单片或多片日期明显离群，或日期与更换记录矛盾；差异只作更换/事故复检线索。

check_what.en: First confirm the glazing supplier and applicable coding rule, then read each visible date code from a safe position outside and compare it with vehicle production timing and available replacement records. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when a code is unreadable, the rule is uncertain, or reading would require disassembly or an unsafe position.
check_what.zh: 先确认玻璃供应商和适用编码规则，再从车外安全位置逐片读取可见日期码，与整车生产时间和可用更换记录比较。编码磨损不可读、规则无法确认或需要拆卸/危险姿势时，选择“无法确认”，不得归为异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Glass date consistency with the vehicle” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “玻璃日期和原车是否一致”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When decoded using each applicable supplier rule, pane dates are logically consistent with vehicle production and known replacement records.
normal_observation.zh: 按各供应商适用规则解读后，各片玻璃日期与整车生产时间及已知更换记录逻辑相符。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: First confirm the glazing supplier and applicable coding rule, then read each visible date code from a safe position outside and compare it with vehicle production timing and available replacement records. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when a code is unreadable, the rule is uncertain, or reading would require disassembly or an unsafe position.
zh: 先确认玻璃供应商和适用编码规则，再从车外安全位置逐片读取可见日期码，与整车生产时间和可用更换记录比较。编码磨损不可读、规则无法确认或需要拆卸/危险姿势时，选择“无法确认”，不得归为异常。

why_important.en: Glass damage, date inconsistencies, or seal issues can affect visibility, safety, and collision evidence.
why_important.zh: 玻璃损伤、日期或密封异常可能影响视野、安全和事故线索。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Glass date consistency with the vehicle
title.zh: 玻璃日期和原车是否一致

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Insufficient tread or abnormal wear
localized_label.zh: 胎纹不足或异常磨耗

localized_label.en: Tread depth
localized_label.zh: 胎纹深度

abnormal_observation.en: Tread at the wear bars or below an applicable limit, uneven or sawtooth wear, a localized bald patch, or an anomalous tire-to-tire difference requires professional action.
abnormal_observation.zh: 沟槽达到磨耗标记或低于适用限值，出现偏磨、锯齿磨损、局部秃斑或四轮差异异常；应停止把该轮胎记为正常并专业处理。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each tire's main grooves and wear bars from outside. If an appropriate tread gauge can be used without going beneath the vehicle, measure several visible inner, center, and outer points and compare with legal, manufacturer, and wear-bar limits; mark hidden inner areas unable to confirm.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后从外侧逐轮观察主要沟槽和磨耗标记；如有合适胎纹尺，在无需进入车下的位置测量多个内/中/外可见点，并对照法定、制造商和轮胎磨耗标记限值。内侧不可见时标记无法确认。

detailed_explanation.en: “Tire tread wear” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “轮胎磨损程度”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Each tire's main grooves remain above legal, manufacturer, and wear-indicator limits, with reasonably even left/right and inner/outer wear and no localized bald patch.
normal_observation.zh: 各轮胎主要沟槽仍高于法定、制造商及磨耗标记要求，左右/内外磨损相对均匀且无局部秃斑。

en: putting a hand or body into a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
turning or removing a wheel or measuring while the vehicle moves
approaching hot brake parts or applying force in a loaded hazard zone
zh: 把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
转动车轮、拆轮或在车辆移动时测量
靠近仍热的制动件或在受载危险区施力测量

en: the vehicle or wheel cannot be kept securely stationary
a hand or body would need to enter a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
the wheel would need turning or removal or a hot or moving part would need to be approached
zh: 车辆或车轮不能可靠保持静止
必须把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
需要转轮、拆轮或接近仍热/运动的部件

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only from outside the tire or wheel or use an appropriate gauge at safely reachable outside points; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮胎/车轮外侧观察或在安全可达的外侧测点使用合适量具；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each tire's main grooves and wear bars from outside. If an appropriate tread gauge can be used without going beneath the vehicle, measure several visible inner, center, and outer points and compare with legal, manufacturer, and wear-bar limits; mark hidden inner areas unable to confirm.
zh: 车辆停稳后从外侧逐轮观察主要沟槽和磨耗标记；如有合适胎纹尺，在无需进入车下的位置测量多个内/中/外可见点，并对照法定、制造商和轮胎磨耗标记限值。内侧不可见时标记无法确认。

why_important.en: Tires and wheels directly affect grip, braking, stability, and immediate road safety.
why_important.zh: 轮胎和轮毂直接影响抓地、制动、稳定性与立即使用安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 轮胎磨损程度

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Decoded tire age/date discrepancy
localized_label.zh: 已解读胎龄或日期组合异常

localized_label.en: This source supports only visible tire cracks or bulges; do not add exposed cord or cuts absent from this source.
localized_label.zh: 本来源只支持当前轮胎可见裂纹或鼓包；不新增露线、割伤等本来源未列异常。

abnormal_observation.en: A safely read tire age beyond the manufacturer limit, an anomalous date mix, or cracking or bulging even on a newer tire is abnormal; the source's four- and six-year references do not replace professional judgment.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已安全读出的胎龄超过制造商限值、四轮日期组合异常，或即使胎龄较新仍有裂纹/鼓包；来源的四年/六年仅作参考，不替代专业判断。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, read each externally visible four-digit week/year code only from outside, record tire-to-tire differences, and compare them with manufacturer limits and replacement records. Treat the source's within-four and six-or-more-year figures only as references and assess cracks or bulges independently. Select unable to confirm and refer for professional follow-up when a code is unreadable or hidden on the inner side.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后只从外侧读取每条轮胎可见的四位周/年日期码，记录四轮差异并与制造商限值和更换记录比较。来源的四年内/六年以上仅作参考；裂纹、鼓包等损伤独立判定。日期码不可读或内侧码不可见时选择“无法确认”并转专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Tire production date” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “轮胎侧面生产日期检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The four-digit date code is legible, age aligns with configuration and replacement records, remains within any stricter manufacturer limit, and the sidewall has no independent hazard such as cracking or bulging.
normal_observation.zh: 四位日期码清晰，胎龄与配置和更换记录相符，未超过制造商更严限值，且侧壁无裂纹、鼓包等独立危险迹象。

en: turning or removing a wheel to read a date code
putting a hand or body into a wheel well, pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
reading a code while the vehicle moves
zh: 转动车轮或拆轮查看日期码
把手或身体伸入轮拱、夹伤区或车下
车辆移动时读码

en: the vehicle or wheel cannot be kept securely stationary
a date code is unreadable or an inner position cannot be safely viewed from outside
reading would require turning or removing a wheel or reaching into a hazard zone
zh: 车辆或车轮不能可靠保持静止
日期码不可读或内侧位置无法从外侧安全看见
读取需要转轮、拆轮或把手/身体伸入危险区

warning.en: With the vehicle parked and wheels secured, read only date codes safely visible from outside. Select unable to confirm for an unreadable or hidden inner code; never turn a wheel or put a hand or body into a wheel well or beneath the vehicle.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定后，只从轮胎外侧读取安全可见日期码；编码不可读或内侧码被遮挡时选择“无法确认”，不得转动车轮、把手或身体伸入轮拱/车下。

en: With the vehicle parked, read each externally visible four-digit week/year code only from outside, record tire-to-tire differences, and compare them with manufacturer limits and replacement records. Treat the source's within-four and six-or-more-year figures only as references and assess cracks or bulges independently. Select unable to confirm and refer for professional follow-up when a code is unreadable or hidden on the inner side.
zh: 车辆停稳后只从外侧读取每条轮胎可见的四位周/年日期码，记录四轮差异并与制造商限值和更换记录比较。来源的四年内/六年以上仅作参考；裂纹、鼓包等损伤独立判定。日期码不可读或内侧码不可见时选择“无法确认”并转专业复检。

why_important.en: Tires and wheels directly affect grip, braking, stability, and immediate road safety.
why_important.zh: 轮胎和轮毂直接影响抓地、制动、稳定性与立即使用安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 轮胎侧面生产日期检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Tire bulge, cracking or exposed cord
localized_label.zh: 轮胎鼓包、裂损或露线

abnormal_observation.en: A bulge, exposed cord or wire, deep crack, or structural cut requires stopping use or further testing and obtaining professional service; never press the bulge.
abnormal_observation.zh: 发现鼓包、帘线/钢丝外露、深裂或结构性割伤，应停止继续使用/验证并安排专业处置；不得按压鼓包。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each outer sidewall for bulges, deep cracks, cuts, and exposed cords. Keep hands out of wheel wells and from beneath the vehicle; mark the hidden inner side unable to confirm unless professionally inspected.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后从轮胎外侧逐轮观察侧壁鼓包、深裂、割伤和帘线外露；不把手伸入轮拱或车辆下方，内侧不可见时标记无法确认并专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Tire bulges or exposed cords” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “轮胎鼓包、侧壁露线检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Every sidewall area required by this flow is safely visible from outside and has a smooth profile without a bulge, deep crack, structural cut, or exposed cord or wire; if a required inner area is hidden, do not select normal and use unable to confirm.
normal_observation.zh: 本流程要求核对的侧壁区域均可从外侧安全看见，轮廓平顺且无鼓包、深裂、结构性割伤或帘线/钢丝外露；必查内侧区域不可见时不选正常，改选无法确认。

en: pressing a bulge or deflating the tire
driving to verify a damaged tire
reaching into a wheel well or beneath the vehicle
zh: 按压鼓包或自行放气
继续驾驶验证受损轮胎
把手或身体伸入轮拱/车下

en: a bulge, deep crack, structural cut, or exposed cord or wire is found
the inner area cannot be viewed safely
the vehicle or tire cannot be kept stationary
zh: 发现鼓包、深裂、结构性割伤或帘线/钢丝外露
内侧区域不可安全看见
车辆或轮胎无法可靠保持静止

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect sidewalls only from outside. Never press a bulge, deflate a tire, reach into a wheel well or beneath the vehicle, or drive to test a damaged tire.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳后只从轮胎外侧观察侧壁；不得按压鼓包、放气、把手伸入轮拱/车下，或继续驾驶验证受损轮胎。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each outer sidewall for bulges, deep cracks, cuts, and exposed cords. Keep hands out of wheel wells and from beneath the vehicle; mark the hidden inner side unable to confirm unless professionally inspected.
zh: 车辆停稳后从轮胎外侧逐轮观察侧壁鼓包、深裂、割伤和帘线外露；不把手伸入轮拱或车辆下方，内侧不可见时标记无法确认并专业复检。

why_important.en: Tires and wheels directly affect grip, braking, stability, and immediate road safety.
why_important.zh: 轮胎和轮毂直接影响抓地、制动、稳定性与立即使用安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 轮胎鼓包、侧壁露线检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Wheel damage or deformation
localized_label.zh: 轮毂裂损或变形

abnormal_observation.en: A crack, chip, dent, out-of-round deformation, or fresh impact mark safely visible from outside the wheel requires professional inspection without reaching into the brake pinch zone.
abnormal_observation.zh: 从车轮外侧安全可见的轮毂存在裂纹、缺口、凹陷、失圆/变形或新鲜撞击痕；记录并专业检查，不触及制动夹伤区。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only the rim edge, spokes, and safely visible inner barrel from outside the wheel. Never put a hand or body into the wheel well or brake pinch zone, turn or remove a wheel, or go beneath the vehicle; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从车轮外侧观察轮毂边缘、辐条和安全可见内圈。不得把手或身体伸入轮拱/制动夹伤区，不转轮、不拆轮、不进入车下；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Wheel damage, dents, or deformation” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “轮毂损坏、凹陷或变形检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The rim edge, spokes, and visible inner barrel have continuous profiles without a crack, chip, material dent, deformation, or fresh impact mark.
normal_observation.zh: 轮毂外缘、辐条和可见内圈轮廓连续，无裂纹、缺口、明显凹陷、变形或新鲜撞击痕。

en: putting a hand or body into a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
turning or removing a wheel or measuring while the vehicle moves
approaching hot brake parts or applying force in a loaded hazard zone
zh: 把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
转动车轮、拆轮或在车辆移动时测量
靠近仍热的制动件或在受载危险区施力测量

en: the vehicle or wheel cannot be kept securely stationary
a hand or body would need to enter a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
the wheel would need turning or removal or a hot or moving part would need to be approached
zh: 车辆或车轮不能可靠保持静止
必须把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
需要转轮、拆轮或接近仍热/运动的部件

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only from outside the tire or wheel or use an appropriate gauge at safely reachable outside points; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮胎/车轮外侧观察或在安全可达的外侧测点使用合适量具；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only the rim edge, spokes, and safely visible inner barrel from outside the wheel. Never put a hand or body into the wheel well or brake pinch zone, turn or remove a wheel, or go beneath the vehicle; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从车轮外侧观察轮毂边缘、辐条和安全可见内圈。不得把手或身体伸入轮拱/制动夹伤区，不转轮、不拆轮、不进入车下；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Tires and wheels directly affect grip, braking, stability, and immediate road safety.
why_important.zh: 轮胎和轮毂直接影响抓地、制动、稳定性与立即使用安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 轮毂损坏、凹陷或变形检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Any lamp that does not illuminate, flashes abnormally, has material moisture ingress, differs in color or brightness, or produces a lamp-fault warning requires follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 任一灯不亮、闪烁异常、明显进水起雾、颜色/亮度差异或仪表报灯具故障；按实际配置记录并复检。

abnormal_observation.en: Any lamp that does not illuminate, flashes abnormally, has material moisture ingress, differs in color or brightness, or produces a lamp-fault warning requires follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 任一灯不亮、闪烁异常、明显进水起雾、颜色/亮度差异或仪表报灯具故障；按实际配置记录并复检。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked and the light path clear, have one person operate low and high beams, fog lamps, indicators, tail lamps, and other fitted lights while another verifies illumination, left/right brightness, flash rate, and dashboard messages from a safe position or reflection.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳并清空灯光照射方向后，由一人依次操作近光、远光、雾灯、转向灯、尾灯及实际配备灯具，另一人从安全位置或反射面核对点亮、左右亮度、闪烁节奏和仪表提示。

detailed_explanation.en: “Exterior-light function test” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车灯功能测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Low and high beams, fog lamps, indicators, tail lamps, and fitted position and license lamps respond to controls with no material left/right brightness or flash-rate difference.
normal_observation.zh: 近光、远光、雾灯、转向灯、尾灯及实际配备的示宽/牌照灯均按控制指令点亮，左右亮度和闪烁节奏无明显差异。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked and the light path clear, have one person operate low and high beams, fog lamps, indicators, tail lamps, and other fitted lights while another verifies illumination, left/right brightness, flash rate, and dashboard messages from a safe position or reflection.
zh: 车辆停稳并清空灯光照射方向后，由一人依次操作近光、远光、雾灯、转向灯、尾灯及实际配备灯具，另一人从安全位置或反射面核对点亮、左右亮度、闪烁节奏和仪表提示。

why_important.en: Lighting, signaling, and wiping functions affect driver visibility and how other road users perceive the vehicle.
why_important.zh: 照明、信号和清洁功能影响驾驶员视野及其他道路使用者识别车辆的能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 车灯功能测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Skipping, missed areas, severe streaking, abnormal noise, an inoperative speed, or incorrect parking is abnormal; do not continue on dry or frozen glass or with an obstruction.
localized_label.zh: 雨刮跳动、漏刮、条纹严重、异常响声、速度档失效或停位错误；干玻璃、结冰或有障碍时不继续测试。

abnormal_observation.en: Skipping, missed areas, severe streaking, abnormal noise, an inoperative speed, or incorrect parking is abnormal; do not continue on dry or frozen glass or with an obstruction.
abnormal_observation.zh: 雨刮跳动、漏刮、条纹严重、异常响声、速度档失效或停位错误；干玻璃、结冰或有障碍时不继续测试。

check_what.en: After wetting the glass and clearing the wiper path, briefly operate each permitted setting and observe skipping, missed areas, noise, and incorrect parking. Do not keep wipers running on dry or frozen glass.
check_what.zh: 确认玻璃湿润、雨刮路径无人和异物后，按车辆手册短暂运行各档位，观察刮片是否跳动、漏刮、异响或回位异常；不要在干玻璃或结冰表面持续运行。

detailed_explanation.en: “Wiper operation” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “雨刮器运行状态检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: With wet glass and a clear path, each permitted setting runs continuously, wipes the intended area without material skipping or noise, and parks correctly.
normal_observation.zh: 玻璃湿润且路径清空时，各允许档位运行连续，刮片覆盖完整、无明显跳动或异响，并能停回正确位置。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: After wetting the glass and clearing the wiper path, briefly operate each permitted setting and observe skipping, missed areas, noise, and incorrect parking. Do not keep wipers running on dry or frozen glass.
zh: 确认玻璃湿润、雨刮路径无人和异物后，按车辆手册短暂运行各档位，观察刮片是否跳动、漏刮、异响或回位异常；不要在干玻璃或结冰表面持续运行。

why_important.en: Lighting, signaling, and wiping functions affect driver visibility and how other road users perceive the vehicle.
why_important.zh: 照明、信号和清洁功能影响驾驶员视野及其他道路使用者识别车辆的能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 雨刮器运行状态检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: No pump or spray, materially misdirected or intermittent coverage, a hose leak, or a frozen or blocked system is abnormal; stop and never probe a pressurized nozzle.
localized_label.zh: 无泵声/无喷射、覆盖明显偏离、喷射间歇、液体从管路泄漏，或系统结冰/堵塞；停止且不带压用针疏通。

abnormal_observation.en: No pump or spray, materially misdirected or intermittent coverage, a hose leak, or a frozen or blocked system is abnormal; stop and never probe a pressurized nozzle.
abnormal_observation.zh: 无泵声/无喷射、覆盖明显偏离、喷射间歇、液体从管路泄漏，或系统结冰/堵塞；停止且不带压用针疏通。

check_what.en: Close the hood, clear the spray direction, and briefly operate the washer to check front/rear coverage, pump sound, and leakage. Stop for frozen fluid, blockage, or pump abnormality and do not probe a pressurized nozzle with a pin.
check_what.zh: 关闭机盖并清空喷射方向，短暂操作玻璃水，核对前后喷嘴覆盖、泵声及是否漏液；液体结冰、喷嘴堵塞或泵异常时停止，不用针具带压疏通。

detailed_explanation.en: “Windshield-washer spray” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “玻璃水喷射功能测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During brief operation, the pump and spray respond normally, fitted front and rear nozzles cover the intended area, and no visible fluid leak appears around hoses or nozzles.
normal_observation.zh: 短暂操作时泵声和喷射响应正常，前后实际配备喷嘴覆盖目标区域，软管/喷嘴周围无可见漏液。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Close the hood, clear the spray direction, and briefly operate the washer to check front/rear coverage, pump sound, and leakage. Stop for frozen fluid, blockage, or pump abnormality and do not probe a pressurized nozzle with a pin.
zh: 关闭机盖并清空喷射方向，短暂操作玻璃水，核对前后喷嘴覆盖、泵声及是否漏液；液体结冰、喷嘴堵塞或泵异常时停止，不用针具带压疏通。

why_important.en: Lighting, signaling, and wiping functions affect driver visibility and how other road users perceive the vehicle.
why_important.zh: 照明、信号和清洁功能影响驾驶员视野及其他道路使用者识别车辆的能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 玻璃水喷射功能测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A safely read materially outlying lamp date, left/right conflict, evidence of label reattachment, or contradiction with replacement records is a replacement or repair follow-up clue.
localized_label.zh: 安全读出的灯具日期明显离群、左右信息冲突、标签有重贴证据，或日期与更换记录矛盾；仅把差异作为更换/维修复检线索。

abnormal_observation.en: A safely read materially outlying lamp date, left/right conflict, evidence of label reattachment, or contradiction with replacement records is a replacement or repair follow-up clue.
abnormal_observation.zh: 安全读出的灯具日期明显离群、左右信息冲突、标签有重贴证据，或日期与更换记录矛盾；仅把差异作为更换/维修复检线索。

check_what.en: With the lamp stationary, read only dates or labels safely visible without lamp or bumper removal and compare them with production timing, service, and replacement records. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when a label is unreadable or confirmation would require disassembly.
check_what.zh: 在灯具完全静止时，只读取无需拆灯、拆杠即可安全看到的日期或标签，并与整车生产时间、维修和更换记录比较。标签不可读或必须拆卸才能确认时选择“无法确认”，不得把缺少证据记为异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Headlamp production dates compared with vehicle build date” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “大灯生产日期与车辆出厂日期一致性核对”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Left and right lamp dates or labels readable without disassembly align with vehicle production, service, and replacement records, and housings are securely fitted.
normal_observation.zh: 无需拆卸即可读取的左右灯具日期/标签与整车生产时间、维修和更换记录逻辑一致，灯壳固定完整。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the lamp stationary, read only dates or labels safely visible without lamp or bumper removal and compare them with production timing, service, and replacement records. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when a label is unreadable or confirmation would require disassembly.
zh: 在灯具完全静止时，只读取无需拆灯、拆杠即可安全看到的日期或标签，并与整车生产时间、维修和更换记录比较。标签不可读或必须拆卸才能确认时选择“无法确认”，不得把缺少证据记为异常。

why_important.en: Lighting, signaling, and wiping functions affect driver visibility and how other road users perceive the vehicle.
why_important.zh: 照明、信号和清洁功能影响驾驶员视野及其他道路使用者识别车辆的能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Headlamp production dates compared with vehicle build date
title.zh: 大灯生产日期与车辆出厂日期一致性核对

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Physical-control damage or actuation defect
localized_label.zh: 物理按键本体破损或操作异常

localized_label.en: Only movement, direction and stop from the fitted physical control of this window; this source authorizes no additional anti-pinch test.
localized_label.zh: 只测试当前车窗实际配备物理控制引起的动作、方向和停位；本来源不授权额外防夹试验。

localized_label.en: Only fitted physical controls and resulting movement, direction and stop of this seat with the path clear; no upholstery or belt judgment.
localized_label.zh: 只测试当前座椅实际配备物理控制引起的动作、方向和停位，路径无人；不判断材质或安全带。

abnormal_observation.en: A broken, unresponsive, repeated-force control, a binding or wrong-direction movement, or a related fault message is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 按键破损、无响应、需反复/过度用力、控制对象动作卡滞或方向错误，或出现故障提示。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, briefly operate each fitted window, seat, and other physical control and observe the corresponding movement, direction, travel, and stop. Keep pinch paths clear and release immediately for binding, abnormal noise, or unintended movement.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后逐一短按车窗、座椅及其他实际配备的物理控制，观察对应动作、方向、行程和停位；清空夹伤路径，出现卡滞、异常声或非预期动作立即松开。

detailed_explanation.en: “Physical control test” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “物理按键测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked, fitted window, seat, and other physical controls produce the intended response on one operation, move smoothly, and show no binding, repeated triggering, or fault message.
normal_observation.zh: 车辆停稳时，车窗、座椅及其他实际配备物理按键按一次即有对应响应，行程平顺且无卡滞、反复触发或异常提示。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked, briefly operate each fitted window, seat, and other physical control and observe the corresponding movement, direction, travel, and stop. Keep pinch paths clear and release immediately for binding, abnormal noise, or unintended movement.
zh: 车辆停稳后逐一短按车窗、座椅及其他实际配备的物理控制，观察对应动作、方向、行程和停位；清空夹伤路径，出现卡滞、异常声或非预期动作立即松开。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 物理按键测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Record only head-unit restarting or freezing.
localized_label.zh: 只记录主机重启或死机。

localized_label.en: Record only failure of the selected media input source.
localized_label.zh: 只记录已选择媒体输入源失效。

localized_label.en: Speaker, channel or volume-output defect
localized_label.zh: 扬声器、声道或音量输出异常

abnormal_observation.en: Head-unit reboot or freeze, failed source selection, speaker distortion or popping, persistent noise, a missing channel, or erratic volume is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 主机重启/死机、输入源失效、扬声器破音、爆音、持续杂音、单声道缺失或音量异常跳变。

check_what.en: While parked, start the head unit, select non-copyrighted test audio, and adjust volume, channels, and balance to check every fitted speaker for continuous sound, distortion, popping, or persistent noise. Avoid prolonged high volume.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳时启动主机并选择无版权测试音频，依次调整音量、声道和平衡，核对实际配备扬声器是否连续出声、有无破音、爆音或持续杂音；避免高音量长时间播放。

detailed_explanation.en: “Multimedia-system function” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “多媒体系统功能测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The head unit, source selection, and volume control operate, and non-copyrighted test audio plays continuously through fitted speakers without distortion, noise, or a silent side.
normal_observation.zh: 主机屏幕、输入源和音量控制可用，无版权测试音频在实际配备扬声器中声音连续、无破音、杂音或单侧缺声。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: While parked, start the head unit, select non-copyrighted test audio, and adjust volume, channels, and balance to check every fitted speaker for continuous sound, distortion, popping, or persistent noise. Avoid prolonged high volume.
zh: 车辆停稳时启动主机并选择无版权测试音频，依次调整音量、声道和平衡，核对实际配备扬声器是否连续出声、有无破音、爆音或持续杂音；避免高音量长时间播放。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 多媒体系统功能测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Climate temperature, airflow or operation defect
localized_label.zh: 空调温度、风量或运行异常

localized_label.en: Persistent abnormal odor after ventilation
localized_label.zh: 通风后持续异常气味

abnormal_observation.en: No material temperature change, weak or inoperative airflow, failed direction control, compressor or blower noise, or mold, burning, or irritating odor is abnormal; record an accessible filter issue.
abnormal_observation.zh: 温度无明显变化、风量弱或档位失效、风向不可调、压缩机/风机异响，或出现霉味、烧焦味、刺激性气味；可安全接近的滤芯异常需记录。

check_what.en: Under permitted operating conditions, select cooling, heating, airflow levels, and directions, allow a reasonable response time, and record temperature change, airflow, noise, and abnormal odor. Inspect a cabin filter only when the instructions allow safe tool-free access without trim removal.
check_what.zh: 在车辆手册允许工况下分别设置制冷、制热、不同风量和风向，等待合理响应时间并记录出风温度变化、风量、噪声和异常气味；空调滤芯仅在无需工具且手册允许的可安全位置目视，不拆饰板。

detailed_explanation.en: “Heating and air-conditioning function, airflow, and odor” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “空调制冷/制热功能及风量、异味检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Under permitted conditions, cooling and heating produce a clear temperature change, airflow levels and directions respond, and output is steady without mold, burning, or irritating odor.
normal_observation.zh: 在允许工况下制冷与制热均有明确温度变化，各风量和风向档位响应，出风连续且无霉味、烧焦味或刺激性异味。

en: running an internal-combustion engine in an enclosed or partly enclosed garage to test climate control
leaving a running vehicle or bypassing Park or an interlock
sniffing directly at a vent or removing trim to inspect a filter
zh: 在封闭或半封闭车库运行燃油发动机测试空调
离开运行中车辆或绕过驻车/联锁
把脸贴近出风口嗅闻或拆饰板查滤芯

en: dizziness, headache, nausea, breathing discomfort, or exhaust accumulation occurs
unexpected movement, an engine, high-voltage, or climate warning, or a burning odor appears
testing would require trim removal, approaching belts or fans, or inadequate ventilation
zh: 出现头晕、头痛、恶心、呼吸不适或尾气聚集
车辆非预期移动、发动机/高压/空调警告或焦味
测试需要拆饰板、接近皮带风扇或现场通风不足

warning.en: Secure the vehicle with the parking brake and confirm Park or Neutral as instructed. Test heating and cooling only outdoors or with adequate ventilation under model-permitted conditions. If an internal-combustion engine must run, a qualified driver remains in control; never idle in an enclosed garage or leave the vehicle unattended.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、驻车制动生效并按手册确认驻车档/空档；只在室外或充分通风处按车型允许工况测试制冷/制热。燃油发动机需要运行时由有资格驾驶员控制，不得在封闭车库怠速或让车辆无人看管。

en: Under permitted operating conditions, select cooling, heating, airflow levels, and directions, allow a reasonable response time, and record temperature change, airflow, noise, and abnormal odor. Inspect a cabin filter only when the instructions allow safe tool-free access without trim removal.
zh: 在车辆手册允许工况下分别设置制冷、制热、不同风量和风向，等待合理响应时间并记录出风温度变化、风量、噪声和异常气味；空调滤芯仅在无需工具且手册允许的可安全位置目视，不拆饰板。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Heating and air-conditioning function, airflow, and odor
title.zh: 空调制冷/制热功能及风量、异味检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Cut or severely frayed webbing, weak retraction, failure to lock, an unlatching or binding buckle, or an occupancy-related belt-warning mismatch is abnormal.
localized_label.zh: 织带割伤/起毛严重、回收无力、无法锁止、插扣松脱、卡滞或安全带警告与占用状态不符。

abnormal_observation.en: Cut or severely frayed webbing, weak retraction, failure to lock, an unlatching or binding buckle, or an occupancy-related belt-warning mismatch is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 织带割伤/起毛严重、回收无力、无法锁止、插扣松脱、卡滞或安全带警告与占用状态不符。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each belt and anchor, extend it slowly and confirm retraction, then use a sharp pull to verify locking. Latch and release the tongue and verify the belt-warning logic.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后逐座检查织带和固定点外观，缓慢拉出并确认自动回收，再快速拉动验证锁止；将锁舌插入插扣并确认可靠扣合、按键释放和安全带提示逻辑。

detailed_explanation.en: “Seat-belt function” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全带功能测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Each seat belt has intact webbing, extends and retracts smoothly, locks on a sharp pull, and its tongue and buckle latch and release reliably.
normal_observation.zh: 各座位安全带织带完整，能顺畅拉出并自动回收，快速拉动时锁止，锁舌与插扣可靠扣合和释放。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect each belt and anchor, extend it slowly and confirm retraction, then use a sharp pull to verify locking. Latch and release the tongue and verify the belt-warning logic.
zh: 车辆停稳后逐座检查织带和固定点外观，缓慢拉出并确认自动回收，再快速拉动验证锁止；将锁舌插入插扣并确认可靠扣合、按键释放和安全带提示逻辑。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 安全带功能测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: An SRS lamp that stays on, flashes, or never illuminates for self-test, a fault message, or a deployment or repair record without qualified proof requires professional follow-up; never disassemble an airbag.
localized_label.zh: SRS 灯常亮、闪烁、自检时不亮，仪表提示故障，或记录显示碰撞展开/维修但无合格修复证明；不得拆检气囊。

abnormal_observation.en: An SRS lamp that stays on, flashes, or never illuminates for self-test, a fault message, or a deployment or repair record without qualified proof requires professional follow-up; never disassemble an airbag.
abnormal_observation.zh: SRS 灯常亮、闪烁、自检时不亮，仪表提示故障，或记录显示碰撞展开/维修但无合格修复证明；不得拆检气囊。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, observe the complete manual-defined SRS or airbag warning self-test from illumination to going out and review dashboard messages plus available collision, airbag, and pretensioner records. Never disassemble, press, or electrically probe an airbag component.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后按手册观察 SRS/安全气囊警告灯从点亮自检到熄灭的全过程，并核对仪表提示及可用碰撞、气囊和预紧器维修记录；不得拆卸、按压或测量气囊组件。

detailed_explanation.en: “Airbag status” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全气囊状态”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The SRS or airbag warning completes its manual-defined self-test and goes out, no persistent fault remains, and available records show no unexplained airbag or pretensioner repair.
normal_observation.zh: SRS/安全气囊警告灯按手册完成自检后熄灭，仪表无持续故障提示，可用维修记录无未解释的气囊/预紧器维修。

en: removing steering-wheel, dashboard, or airbag covers
zh: 拆卸方向盘、仪表台或安全气囊盖板

en: an airbag component would need to be disassembled, pressed, or electrically probed
zh: 需要拆卸、按压或电气测量安全气囊部件

warning.en: Observe only the SRS warning, visible covers/seams, collision evidence, and records; never dismantle airbag components.
warning.zh: 仅观察 SRS 警告灯、可见盖板/接缝、事故痕迹和记录；不得拆卸任何安全气囊部件。

en: With the vehicle parked, observe the complete manual-defined SRS or airbag warning self-test from illumination to going out and review dashboard messages plus available collision, airbag, and pretensioner records. Never disassemble, press, or electrically probe an airbag component.
zh: 车辆停稳后按手册观察 SRS/安全气囊警告灯从点亮自检到熄灭的全过程，并核对仪表提示及可用碰撞、气囊和预紧器维修记录；不得拆卸、按压或测量气囊组件。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 安全气囊状态

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Unexpected raising or lowering, body tilt, binding, noise, a fault message, or abnormal parking-brake status requires follow-up; never go beneath the vehicle or test by slope movement.
localized_label.zh: 出现非预期升降、车身倾斜、卡滞、异响、故障提示或驻车状态异常；不得进入车下或用坡道滑移验证。

abnormal_observation.en: Unexpected raising or lowering, body tilt, binding, noise, a fault message, or abnormal parking-brake status requires follow-up; never go beneath the vehicle or test by slope movement.
abnormal_observation.zh: 出现非预期升降、车身倾斜、卡滞、异响、故障提示或驻车状态异常；不得进入车下或用坡道滑移验证。

check_what.en: On firm level ground with the area clear, use only the in-cabin procedure in the vehicle instructions to review fitted height controls and parking-brake status; never go beneath the vehicle, approach suspension pinch zones, or use vehicle movement on a slope to test holding.
check_what.zh: 在水平坚实地面停稳并清空周围后，只从车内按手册核对如配备的高度控制和驻车制动状态；不得进入车下、接近悬挂夹伤区或在坡道用车辆移动验证驻车保持。

detailed_explanation.en: “Stationary air-suspension height and parking-brake status” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “空气悬架车高与驻车制动静态状态”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During stationary review on level ground, fitted ride-height controls and parking-brake status, indications, and body response follow the instructions without unexpected height movement or a fault.
normal_observation.zh: 水平地面静态核对时，实际配备的车高控制与驻车制动状态、指示和车身响应符合手册，且无非预期升降或故障提示。

en: going beneath the vehicle or reaching into the suspension area
releasing the brake on a slope to verify holding
using off-road or height modes on unsuitable ground
zh: 身体进入车辆下方或把手伸入悬挂区域
在坡道松开制动验证驻车保持
在不合适地面启用越野/高度模式

en: the body moves or tilts unexpectedly, makes abnormal noise, or shows a fault
a person or object enters the body, wheel, or suspension movement zone
verification would require vehicle movement, slope holding, or entry beneath the vehicle
zh: 车身发生非预期升降、倾斜、异响或故障提示
有人或物进入车身、车轮或悬挂运动区域
验证需要车辆移动、坡道保持或进入车下

warning.en: On firm level ground with the area clear, use only the in-cabin procedure in the vehicle instructions to review fitted ride-height controls and parking-brake status. Keep everyone away from the body, wheels, and suspension pinch zones, and never verify parking hold on a slope.
warning.zh: 车辆停在水平坚实地面并清空周围后，只从车内按手册核对如配备的高度控制和驻车制动状态；所有人远离车身、车轮和悬挂夹伤区，不得在坡道验证驻车保持。

en: On firm level ground with the area clear, use only the in-cabin procedure in the vehicle instructions to review fitted height controls and parking-brake status; never go beneath the vehicle, approach suspension pinch zones, or use vehicle movement on a slope to test holding.
zh: 在水平坚实地面停稳并清空周围后，只从车内按手册核对如配备的高度控制和驻车制动状态；不得进入车下、接近悬挂夹伤区或在坡道用车辆移动验证驻车保持。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Stationary air-suspension height and parking-brake status
title.zh: 空气悬架车高与驻车制动静态状态

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A selector/display mismatch, delayed or refused selection, unexpected vehicle movement, or absent or abnormal reverse camera or sensor response requires an immediate stop.
localized_label.zh: 档位显示与选择不符、切换延迟/拒绝、车辆非预期移动，或倒档影像/雷达未触发、画面异常；立即停止。

abnormal_observation.en: A selector/display mismatch, delayed or refused selection, unexpected vehicle movement, or absent or abnormal reverse camera or sensor response requires an immediate stop.
abnormal_observation.zh: 档位显示与选择不符、切换延迟/拒绝、车辆非预期移动，或倒档影像/雷达未触发、画面异常；立即停止。

check_what.en: Clear the area, have a qualified driver hold the brake, and follow the vehicle instructions while selecting each position; keep the vehicle stationary and only verify the display and fitted sensors or cameras.
check_what.zh: 清空车辆周围，由有资格驾驶员踩住制动并按车辆手册依次选择档位；车辆保持静止，只核对仪表及如配备的雷达/影像是否触发。

detailed_explanation.en: “Gear selection and reverse functions” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “档位/倒车”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: With the area clear, brake held, and vehicle stationary, every permitted selector position is correctly displayed and Reverse triggers fitted camera, sensor, or alert functions.
normal_observation.zh: 周围清空、制动踏板保持且车辆静止时，各允许档位在仪表正确显示；倒档能触发实际配备的影像、雷达或提示。

en: selecting a drive position near people or obstacles
moving blindly merely to test the camera
zh: 在人员或障碍物附近切入行驶档
为验证影像而盲目移动车辆

en: the vehicle moves unexpectedly
the brake cannot hold the vehicle reliably
a person or obstacle enters the surrounding area
zh: 车辆出现非预期移动
制动无法可靠保持车辆
车辆周围有人或障碍物

warning.en: Clear the area and use a qualified driver; hold the brake, follow the vehicle instructions for selecting positions, and only confirm the display and fitted sensor/camera activation.
warning.zh: 车辆周围必须清空并由有资格驾驶员操作；踩住制动踏板、按车辆手册切换档位，只确认仪表和如配备的雷达/影像触发。

en: Clear the area, have a qualified driver hold the brake, and follow the vehicle instructions while selecting each position; keep the vehicle stationary and only verify the display and fitted sensors or cameras.
zh: 清空车辆周围，由有资格驾驶员踩住制动并按车辆手册依次选择档位；车辆保持静止，只核对仪表及如配备的雷达/影像是否触发。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 档位/倒车

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent abnormal odor after ventilation
localized_label.zh: 通风后持续异常气味

localized_label.en: Visible waterline, dampness or related deposit
localized_label.zh: 可见水线、潮湿或相关沉积迹象

localized_label.en: Visible non-water-related cabin contamination
localized_label.zh: 非水迹类可见污染残留

abnormal_observation.en: Dampness, mold, a water line, dirty-water residue, animal or smoke contamination, or fuel, burning, or strong chemical odor is abnormal; leave immediately if anyone feels unwell.
abnormal_observation.zh: 发现潮湿、霉斑、水线、污水沉积、动物/烟熏残留，或燃油、烧焦、强烈化学气味；出现不适应立即离开。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation, then passively inspect the cabin, carpets, seat gaps, and storage areas for dampness, mold, water marks, contaminants, and persistent abnormal odor from a normal seating position without close sniffing. Leave immediately for fuel or burning odor, smoke, or any personal discomfort; select unable to confirm when ventilation is unavailable.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风，再从正常乘坐位置被动观察座舱、地毯、座椅缝隙和储物区的潮湿、霉斑、水迹、污染物及持续异常气味；不要贴近嗅闻。燃油味、烧焦味、烟雾或任何人员不适时立即离开；无法通风时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Interior cleanliness and odor” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车内清洁度及异味检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After ventilation, the cabin, carpets, seat gaps, and storage areas are dry and reasonably clean without mold, water marks, unusual contamination, or persistent irritating odor.
normal_observation.zh: 通风后座舱、地毯、座椅缝隙和储物区干燥整洁，无霉斑、水迹、异常污物或持续刺激性气味。

en: sniffing directly near upholstery, carpet, or an unknown substance
remaining in the cabin for a persistent odor or personal discomfort
using ignition, heat, or a chemical to locate an odor
zh: 贴近座椅、地毯或未知物质直接嗅闻
在持续异味或人员不适时留在座舱
用点火、加热或化学剂定位气味

en: persistent fuel, burning, or strong chemical odor, smoke, or visible leakage
anyone feels dizzy, headache, nausea, breathing discomfort, or eye or nose irritation
the area cannot be ventilated or assessment would require sniffing near an unknown substance
zh: 持续燃油味、烧焦味、强烈化学味、烟雾或可见泄漏
任何人头晕、头痛、恶心、呼吸不适或眼鼻刺激
现场无法通风或需要靠近未知物质嗅闻

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation. Assess cabin air passively from a normal seating position without putting a face near a surface or taking a deliberate deep sniff.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风；人员从正常乘坐位置被动判断座舱空气，不把脸贴近表面或主动深嗅。

en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation, then passively inspect the cabin, carpets, seat gaps, and storage areas for dampness, mold, water marks, contaminants, and persistent abnormal odor from a normal seating position without close sniffing. Leave immediately for fuel or burning odor, smoke, or any personal discomfort; select unable to confirm when ventilation is unavailable.
zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风，再从正常乘坐位置被动观察座舱、地毯、座椅缝隙和储物区的潮湿、霉斑、水迹、污染物及持续异常气味；不要贴近嗅闻。燃油味、烧焦味、烟雾或任何人员不适时立即离开；无法通风时选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 车内清洁度及异味检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Localized severe polishing, damage, collapse, refinishing, or materially inconsistent wear that conflicts with mileage or records is only a use or mileage follow-up clue.
localized_label.zh: 局部严重磨平、破损、塌陷、翻新或部件间磨损明显失衡，且与里程/记录不符；仅作为使用强度或里程复核线索。

abnormal_observation.en: Localized severe polishing, damage, collapse, refinishing, or materially inconsistent wear that conflicts with mileage or records is only a use or mileage follow-up clue.
abnormal_observation.zh: 局部严重磨平、破损、塌陷、翻新或部件间磨损明显失衡，且与里程/记录不符；仅作为使用强度或里程复核线索。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect steering-wheel, seat-bolster, pedal, and selector materials for wear, damage, collapse, or repair, and cross-check against mileage and use records. Wear is only a clue and cannot alone prove odometer tampering.
check_what.zh: 在车辆停稳时观察方向盘、座椅侧翼、踏板和档把的材质磨损、破损、塌陷与修补痕迹，并与里程和使用记录交叉核对；磨损只能作为线索，不能单独判定调表。

detailed_explanation.en: “Steering-wheel, seat, and selector wear” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “方向盘、座椅、档把磨损程度评估”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Wear across the steering wheel, seat bolsters, pedals, and selector is mutually consistent and reasonably explained by mileage, age, and available use records.
normal_observation.zh: 方向盘、座椅侧翼、踏板和档把的磨损程度彼此协调，并能由里程、车龄及可用使用记录合理解释。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect steering-wheel, seat-bolster, pedal, and selector materials for wear, damage, collapse, or repair, and cross-check against mileage and use records. Wear is only a clue and cannot alone prove odometer tampering.
zh: 在车辆停稳时观察方向盘、座椅侧翼、踏板和档把的材质磨损、破损、塌陷与修补痕迹，并与里程和使用记录交叉核对；磨损只能作为线索，不能单独判定调表。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 方向盘、座椅、档把磨损程度评估

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: An unusually polished, faded, or refinished area inconsistent with other touch surfaces or records is a clue only and cannot prove odometer alteration.
localized_label.zh: 单一部位异常亮滑、掉色或翻新边界明显，且与其他接触面和记录不一致；不得凭“亮面”单独推断调表。

abnormal_observation.en: An unusually polished, faded, or refinished area inconsistent with other touch surfaces or records is a clue only and cannot prove odometer alteration.
abnormal_observation.zh: 单一部位异常亮滑、掉色或翻新边界明显，且与其他接触面和记录不一致；不得凭“亮面”单独推断调表。

check_what.en: Under consistent light, compare polish, fading, and patina on the steering wheel, buttons, armrests, selector, and other touch surfaces with other wear and records. Record inconsistencies without inferring mileage from gloss alone.
check_what.zh: 在一致光线下比较方向盘、按键、扶手、档把和常触表面的抛光、掉色或包浆，与同车其他磨损和记录交叉核对；只记录不一致线索，不凭亮面单独推断里程。

detailed_explanation.en: “Glossy interior wear compared with recorded mileage” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “内饰“亮面”磨损与公里数匹配性判断”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Under consistent light, gloss, fading, and patina on frequent-touch surfaces align with adjacent materials, other wear, and use records.
normal_observation.zh: 一致光线下，各常触表面的光泽、掉色和包浆程度与相邻材质、其他磨损及使用记录相互协调。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Under consistent light, compare polish, fading, and patina on the steering wheel, buttons, armrests, selector, and other touch surfaces with other wear and records. Record inconsistencies without inferring mileage from gloss alone.
zh: 在一致光线下比较方向盘、按键、扶手、档把和常触表面的抛光、掉色或包浆，与同车其他磨损和记录交叉核对；只记录不一致线索，不凭亮面单独推断里程。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Glossy interior wear compared with recorded mileage
title.zh: 内饰“亮面”磨损与公里数匹配性判断

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Cabin-trim noise over a minor unevenness
localized_label.zh: 轻微起伏时车内饰件异响

abnormal_observation.en: Repeatable knocking, creaking, rubbing, or loose-component noise over minor unavoidable unevenness is abnormal; never seek potholes or repeat impacts.
abnormal_observation.zh: 轻微起伏即触发可重复的敲击、咯吱、摩擦或部件松动声；不得主动寻找坑洞或反复冲击，应记录位置并复检。

check_what.en: Only during an ordinary trip, a qualified driver may cross one unavoidable minor uneven section at the legal low speed while occupants remain seated and record repeatable noise from doors, seats, headliner, or dashboard. Never seek potholes, increase speed, or repeat impacts.
check_what.zh: 仅在正常行程中由有资格驾驶员以合法低速一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏，乘员从座位上记录车门、座椅、顶棚和中控区域的重复异响；不得主动寻找坑洞、提高速度或反复冲击。

detailed_explanation.en: “Interior rattles while driving” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “行驶中内饰异响排查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After one unavoidable minor uneven section during an ordinary trip, doors, seats, headliner, and dashboard show no repeatable loose, knocking, or rubbing noise.
normal_observation.zh: 正常行程中一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏后，车门、座椅、顶棚和中控区域无重复松散声、敲击声或摩擦声。

en: emergency or limit maneuvers in public traffic
testing beyond the driver's competence
zh: 在公共交通中进行紧急或极限动作
超出驾驶员能力测试

en: a qualified driver, legal low-risk route, or seller permission is unavailable
traffic, road, or vehicle conditions are unsafe
zh: 没有合格驾驶员、合法低风险路段或卖家同意
交通、路面或车辆状态不安全

warning.en: Only a qualified driver may test in a legal, open, low-speed setting with permission; stop for unsafe traffic, road, or vehicle conditions.
warning.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且卖家同意的环境测试；交通、路面或车辆状态不安全时立即停止。

en: Only during an ordinary trip, a qualified driver may cross one unavoidable minor uneven section at the legal low speed while occupants remain seated and record repeatable noise from doors, seats, headliner, or dashboard. Never seek potholes, increase speed, or repeat impacts.
zh: 仅在正常行程中由有资格驾驶员以合法低速一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏，乘员从座位上记录车门、座椅、顶棚和中控区域的重复异响；不得主动寻找坑洞、提高速度或反复冲击。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 行驶中内饰异响排查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Visible identified low-voltage wiring damage
localized_label.zh: 已识别低压线束外观损伤

abnormal_observation.en: Visible corrosion, damaged insulation, breakage, bare conductor, loose connector, scorching, or non-standard modification requires professional follow-up without touching unknown or high-voltage wiring.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可见腐蚀、破皮、断裂、裸线、松脱插头、烧蚀或非规范改装接线；不触碰未知/高压线束，转专业复检。

check_what.en: With the vehicle powered down or parked and without trim removal, visually inspect only visible low-voltage insulation, routing, and connector seating. Never touch or unplug unknown or orange high-voltage wiring, and stop for corrosion, damage, bare conductors, scorching, or non-standard splices.
check_what.zh: 车辆断电/驻车且无需拆饰板时，只目视可见低压线束的绝缘、固定和插头就位情况；不触碰、不拔插用途不明或橙色高压线束，发现腐蚀、破损、裸线、烧蚀或改装接线即停止。

detailed_explanation.en: “Interior electrical wiring condition” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车内电子设备线路检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Low-voltage cabin wiring visible without trim removal has intact insulation, secure routing, seated connectors, and no corrosion, break, bare conductor, or non-standard splice.
normal_observation.zh: 无需拆饰板即可看到的低压车内线束绝缘完整、固定可靠、插头就位，无腐蚀、断裂、裸线或非规范接线。

en: touching or unplugging unknown or orange high-voltage wiring
piercing insulation, shorting, or energized probing
removing trim to find wiring
zh: 触碰或拔插未知/橙色高压线束
刺穿绝缘、短接或带电探测
拆卸饰板寻找线束

en: damaged insulation, bare conductors, scorching, corrosion, or a non-standard splice is found
the wiring cannot be confirmed as low voltage
inspection would require trim removal, unplugging, or energized probing
zh: 发现破皮、裸线、烧蚀、腐蚀或非规范接线
无法确认线束属于低压系统
检查需要拆饰板、拔插或通电探测

warning.en: With the vehicle powered down or parked and without trim removal, visually inspect only visible low-voltage wiring. Never touch, unplug, or probe unknown or orange high-voltage wiring.
warning.zh: 车辆断电/驻车且无需拆饰板时，只目视可见低压线束；不得触碰、拔插或探测用途不明及橙色高压线束。

en: With the vehicle powered down or parked and without trim removal, visually inspect only visible low-voltage insulation, routing, and connector seating. Never touch or unplug unknown or orange high-voltage wiring, and stop for corrosion, damage, bare conductors, scorching, or non-standard splices.
zh: 车辆断电/驻车且无需拆饰板时，只目视可见低压线束的绝缘、固定和插头就位情况；不触碰、不拔插用途不明或橙色高压线束，发现腐蚀、破损、裸线、烧蚀或改装接线即停止。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 车内电子设备线路检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Explicit ABS/ESP fault or unavailability
localized_label.zh: ABS/ESP明确故障或不可用

localized_label.en: Explicit ADAS fault, unavailability or incomplete calibration
localized_label.zh: ADAS明确故障、不可用或校准未完成

abnormal_observation.en: An AEB, ABS, stability-control, or related fault lamp or explicit unavailable message, or an unresolved related fault in an available record, requires professional closed-facility follow-up without intentionally triggering an emergency.
abnormal_observation.zh: 出现 AEB、ABS、ESP 等故障灯或明确不可用提示，或可用记录显示相关故障尚未处理；不得主动制造紧急事件验证，转专业封闭场地复检。
