check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, review only warning self-tests, settings, explicit availability messages, and available service or diagnostic records. A general user must not trigger AEB, ABS, stability control, or an emergency scenario. Select unable to confirm when self-test conditions, status meaning, or records cannot be established, and select abnormal only for explicit fault evidence.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后只核对安全系统警告灯自检、设置、明确可用性提示及可用维修/诊断记录；普通用户不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。自检条件、状态含义或记录无法确认时选择“无法确认”，仅在发现明确故障证据时选择“异常”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Stationary safety-system status and records review” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全系统静态状态与记录核对”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Parked self-tests, settings, and availability messages show no fault and available service or diagnostic records show no unresolved related issue; this does not verify dynamic intervention.
normal_observation.zh: 驻车静态自检、设置和可用性提示未见故障，可用维修/诊断记录无相关未处理异常；这不代表已验证动态介入。

en: intentionally triggering AEB, ABS, stability control, or emergency braking
using a person, vehicle, or object as an activation target
verifying safety-system intervention on a public road
zh: 主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或紧急制动
放置人员、车辆或物体作为触发目标
在公共道路验证安全系统介入

en: a fault warning, unavailable message, or unclear status appears during stationary review
verification would require moving the vehicle, placing an obstacle, or inducing a skid or emergency stop
model instructions, authorized records, or a professional facility are unavailable
zh: 静态自检出现故障灯、不可用提示或状态不明
验证需要移动车辆、设置障碍物或制造打滑/紧急制动
缺少车型手册、授权记录或专业场地

warning.en: A general user may review only parked warning self-tests, settings, availability messages, and service or diagnostic records. Do not intentionally trigger AEB, ABS, or stability control or create an emergency. Dynamic verification is for qualified professionals following manufacturer procedures at a closed professional facility and is not instructed here.
warning.zh: 普通用户只核对驻车状态下的警告灯自检、设置、可用性提示及维修/诊断记录；不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。动态功能只能由专业人员在封闭专业场地按制造商程序验证，本清单不指导执行。

en: With the vehicle parked, review only warning self-tests, settings, explicit availability messages, and available service or diagnostic records. A general user must not trigger AEB, ABS, stability control, or an emergency scenario. Select unable to confirm when self-test conditions, status meaning, or records cannot be established, and select abnormal only for explicit fault evidence.
zh: 车辆停稳后只核对安全系统警告灯自检、设置、明确可用性提示及可用维修/诊断记录；普通用户不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。自检条件、状态含义或记录无法确认时选择“无法确认”，仅在发现明确故障证据时选择“异常”。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Stationary safety-system status and records review
title.zh: 安全系统静态状态与记录核对

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Record only system restarting or freezing.
localized_label.zh: 只记录系统重启或卡死。

localized_label.en: Media input, navigation or connection defect
localized_label.zh: 媒体输入、导航或连接功能异常

abnormal_observation.en: A reboot or freeze, navigation-position error, failed or repeatedly dropped Bluetooth or phone-projection connection, or inability to remove test data is abnormal; never troubleshoot while driving.
abnormal_observation.zh: 系统重启/卡死、导航定位异常、蓝牙或手机映射无法连接/频繁断开，或测试数据无法删除；驾驶中不得排查。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, test the display, radio, navigation, Bluetooth, and fitted CarPlay or Android Auto one at a time. Use only a temporary test device, then remove pairing, address, account, and test-notification data; never operate or troubleshoot while driving.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后依次测试屏幕、收音机、导航、蓝牙及实际配备的 CarPlay/Android Auto；只连接临时测试设备，结束后删除配对、地址和账号数据，并确认未留下测试通知。驾驶中不得操作或排障。

detailed_explanation.en: “Infotainment and phone-connectivity functions” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “系统车机、电台、车载导航、蓝牙连接测试、Carplay/ Android Auto测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked, the display, radio, navigation, Bluetooth, and fitted CarPlay or Android Auto connect and remain usable, and temporary pairing, address, and account data is removed afterward.
normal_observation.zh: 车辆停稳时，屏幕、收音机、导航、蓝牙及实际配备的 CarPlay/Android Auto 能建立并保持连接；测试后已删除临时配对、地址和账号数据。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked, test the display, radio, navigation, Bluetooth, and fitted CarPlay or Android Auto one at a time. Use only a temporary test device, then remove pairing, address, account, and test-notification data; never operate or troubleshoot while driving.
zh: 车辆停稳后依次测试屏幕、收音机、导航、蓝牙及实际配备的 CarPlay/Android Auto；只连接临时测试设备，结束后删除配对、地址和账号数据，并确认未留下测试通知。驾驶中不得操作或排障。

why_important.en: Wear, odor, and rattles can help assess use, water exposure, repairs, or assembly condition.
why_important.zh: 磨损、异味和异响可帮助判断使用强度、水泡、修复或装配状态。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 系统车机、电台、车载导航、蓝牙连接测试、Carplay/ Android Auto测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Material cranking delay, failure to start, need for repeated attempts, or severe vibration, stalling, abnormal noise, or warning after start requires stopping repeated attempts and professional follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 启动明显延迟、空转不着、需反复点火，或启动后剧烈抖动、熄火、异常异响/警告；停止连续尝试并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: Material cranking delay, failure to start, need for repeated attempts, or severe vibration, stalling, abnormal noise, or warning after start requires stopping repeated attempts and professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 启动明显延迟、空转不着、需反复点火，或启动后剧烈抖动、熄火、异常异响/警告；停止连续尝试并专业复检。

check_what.en: Outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, have a qualified driver confirm Park/Neutral and secure parking before performing one normal start as instructed. Record delay, abnormal vibration, warning, or noise and do not repeat-start continuously.
check_what.zh: 在室外或充分通风处让有资格驾驶员确认车辆处于驻车档/空档并可靠驻车，再按车辆手册执行一次正常启动；记录启动延迟、异常抖动、警告或异响，不连续反复点火。

detailed_explanation.en: “Engine starting smoothness” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “点火顺畅度检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, one normal start responds promptly and establishes a stable idle without abnormal vibration, persistent noise, or a new warning.
normal_observation.zh: 室外或充分通风处，一次正常启动响应及时，怠速建立平稳，无异常抖动、持续异响或新增警告。

en: starting an internal-combustion engine in an enclosed garage
starting before confirming Park/Neutral and the parking brake
repeated continuous starting or bringing hands, clothing, or tools near moving parts
zh: 在封闭车库内启动燃油发动机
未确认驻车档/空档和驻车制动就点火
连续反复点火或让手、衣物、工具接近运动部件

en: the vehicle moves unexpectedly
dense smoke, fuel odor, burning odor, or an active leak appears
the starter runs continuously, severe noise or a warning appears, or anyone feels unwell
zh: 车辆出现非预期移动
出现浓烟、燃油味、烧焦味或明显泄漏
启动机持续运转、剧烈异响、警告或人员不适

warning.en: Only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, have a qualified driver confirm Park/Neutral and the parking brake before one normal start as instructed; keep everyone clear of the vehicle path and moving engine-bay parts.
warning.zh: 只在室外或充分通风处，由有资格驾驶员确认驻车档/空档和驻车制动后按车辆手册执行一次正常启动；所有人远离车辆行进方向和发动机舱运动部件。

en: Outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, have a qualified driver confirm Park/Neutral and secure parking before performing one normal start as instructed. Record delay, abnormal vibration, warning, or noise and do not repeat-start continuously.
zh: 在室外或充分通风处让有资格驾驶员确认车辆处于驻车档/空档并可靠驻车，再按车辆手册执行一次正常启动；记录启动延迟、异常抖动、警告或异响，不连续反复点火。

why_important.en: Cold-start behavior can reveal starting, lubrication, combustion, or mechanical issues hidden when warm.
why_important.zh: 冷启动表现可暴露热车后不明显的启动、润滑、燃烧或机械问题。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 点火顺畅度检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent metallic knock, squeal, scrape, backfire, or markedly irregular running noise is abnormal; stay clear of belts, fans, and hot parts and stop.
localized_label.zh: 持续金属敲击、尖啸、刮擦、爆鸣或明显不规则运转声出现；保持远离皮带、风扇和高温件并停止复检。

abnormal_observation.en: Persistent metallic knock, squeal, scrape, backfire, or markedly irregular running noise is abnormal; stay clear of belts, fans, and hot parts and stop.
abnormal_observation.zh: 持续金属敲击、尖啸、刮擦、爆鸣或明显不规则运转声出现；保持远离皮带、风扇和高温件并停止复检。

check_what.en: Park outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, secure the hood, and listen from the engine-bay edge while keeping hair, clothing, hands, and tools away from belts, fans, and hot parts.
check_what.zh: 在室外或充分通风处驻车，确认机盖支撑牢固后从发动机舱边缘监听；头发、衣物、手和工具远离皮带、风扇及高温部件。

detailed_explanation.en: “Abnormal engine noise” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “发动机异响排查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When listening from the engine-bay edge in a ventilated setting, operating sound is stable with no persistent knock, squeal, scrape, or abnormal speed-related noise.
normal_observation.zh: 在通风环境从发动机舱边缘监听时，运转声稳定，无持续敲击、尖啸、刮擦或随转速异常变化的噪声。

en: touching moving belts, fans, or hot parts
placing loose clothing or tools in the engine bay
zh: 触碰运行中的皮带、风扇或高温部件
把松散衣物或工具伸入发动机舱

en: hood support, Park or Neutral, or the parking brake is not secure
the vehicle moves unexpectedly or the driver or owner leaves the controls
smoke, strong odor, spray or leakage appears, or the check would require reaching into the running bay
zh: 机盖支撑、驻车档/空档或驻车制动不可靠
车辆非预期移动，或驾驶员/车主离开控制位
出现烟雾、强烈气味、液体喷溅/泄漏，或需要把手、头、工具伸入运行舱内

warning.en: Listen only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area with a qualified driver or owner remaining at the controls after confirming Park or Neutral, the parking brake, and secure hood support. Listen from the bay edge and keep hair, clothing, hands, and tools away from belts, fans, and hot parts.
warning.zh: 只在室外或充分通风处，由有资格驾驶员/车主留在控制位，确认驻车档/空档、驻车制动和机盖支撑牢固后从发动机舱边缘监听；头发、衣物、手和工具远离皮带、风扇及高温部件。

en: Park outdoors or in a well-ventilated area, secure the hood, and listen from the engine-bay edge while keeping hair, clothing, hands, and tools away from belts, fans, and hot parts.
zh: 在室外或充分通风处驻车，确认机盖支撑牢固后从发动机舱边缘监听；头发、衣物、手和工具远离皮带、风扇及高温部件。

why_important.en: Cold-start behavior can reveal starting, lubrication, combustion, or mechanical issues hidden when warm.
why_important.zh: 冷启动表现可暴露热车后不明显的启动、润滑、燃烧或机械问题。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 发动机异响排查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent white, blue, or black smoke, dense smoke, flame, or abnormal liquid or sound must only be recorded before stopping and leaving immediately if anyone feels unwell.
localized_label.zh: 持续白、蓝或黑烟、浓烟、火焰或异常滴液/声响；只记录并停止，任何人员不适时立即离开。

abnormal_observation.en: Persistent white, blue, or black smoke, dense smoke, flame, or abnormal liquid or sound must only be recorded before stopping and leaving immediately if anyone feels unwell.
abnormal_observation.zh: 持续白、蓝或黑烟、浓烟、火焰或异常滴液/声响；只记录并停止，任何人员不适时立即离开。

check_what.en: In an open outdoor area, observe the seller's normal cold start from clean air away from the tailpipe; do not rev a cold engine for the checklist. Leave and stop for dizziness, headache, nausea, or breathing discomfort, and leave any loaded test to a professional.
check_what.zh: 只在室外开阔处从清洁空气位置观察卖家正常冷启动时的尾气，远离排气口；不要为完成清单深踩冷车油门。若头晕、头痛、恶心或呼吸不适，立即离开并停止；来源所述加载测试交由专业人员。

detailed_explanation.en: “Cold-start exhaust observation under safe conditions” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全条件下观察冷启动尾气”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During a normal outdoor cold start, brief condensation clears promptly without persistent visible white, blue, or black smoke, while the observer remains in clean air.
normal_observation.zh: 室外正常冷启动时，短暂水汽很快消散，无持续白、蓝或黑色可见烟雾；观察者始终位于清洁空气处。

en: running the engine in a garage or another enclosed or partly enclosed space
inhaling exhaust near the tailpipe
revving or loading a cold engine merely to complete the checklist
zh: 在车库或其他封闭/半封闭空间运行发动机
靠近排气口吸入尾气
为完成清单深踩冷车油门或主动加载

en: dizziness, headache, nausea, drowsiness, or breathing discomfort
exhaust accumulates around the observer or the setting is not open outdoors
unexpected vehicle movement, flame, dense smoke, or another severe abnormality
zh: 头晕、头痛、恶心、困倦或呼吸不适
尾气向观察者聚集或现场不是室外开阔环境
车辆出现非预期移动、火焰、浓烟或强烈异常

warning.en: Have the seller perform only a normal cold start in an open outdoor area. Observe from clean air to the side and rear, stay clear of exhaust, and never rely on odor to detect carbon monoxide. Leave immediately and stop for dizziness, headache, nausea, or breathing discomfort.
warning.zh: 只在室外开阔处让卖家进行正常冷启动；观察者站在排气口侧后方的清洁空气处，远离尾气且不得依赖气味判断一氧化碳是否存在。出现头晕、头痛、恶心或呼吸不适立即离开并停止。

en: In an open outdoor area, observe the seller's normal cold start from clean air away from the tailpipe; do not rev a cold engine for the checklist. Leave and stop for dizziness, headache, nausea, or breathing discomfort, and leave any loaded test to a professional.
zh: 只在室外开阔处从清洁空气位置观察卖家正常冷启动时的尾气，远离排气口；不要为完成清单深踩冷车油门。若头晕、头痛、恶心或呼吸不适，立即离开并停止；来源所述加载测试交由专业人员。

why_important.en: Cold-start behavior can reveal starting, lubrication, combustion, or mechanical issues hidden when warm.
why_important.zh: 冷启动表现可暴露热车后不明显的启动、润滑、燃烧或机械问题。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Cold-start exhaust observation under safe conditions
title.zh: 安全条件下观察冷启动尾气

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Coolant-level discrepancy
localized_label.zh: 冷却液液位异常

localized_label.en: Coolant oil film, cloudiness or abnormal appearance
localized_label.zh: 冷却液油膜、浑浊或颜色异常

abnormal_observation.en: A cold level below or above the specified range, dark or brown coolant, cloudiness, oil film, or emulsion is abnormal; never open a hot or pressurized cap.
abnormal_observation.zh: 冷车液位过低/过高，冷却液变黑、变棕、浑浊、出现油膜或乳化；不得打开热态或带压盖。

check_what.en: After the powertrain is shut down and related thermal or cooling components have naturally cooled as required for the model, observe only through the reservoir for level against MIN/MAX or model marks, color, cloudiness, and oil film. Never open a hot or pressurized cap, and mark an obscured or unclear reservoir unable to confirm.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭并让相关热管理/冷却部件按车型规定自然冷却后，只透过储液罐观察液位相对 MIN/MAX 或车型标记、颜色、浑浊和油膜；不得打开热态或带压盖，标记不清或容器遮挡时无法确认。

detailed_explanation.en: “Coolant level and condition” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “冷却液液位及浑浊度检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When cold, the level is within the model-defined MIN and MAX range, with consistent color and no dark or brown discoloration, cloudiness, oil film, or emulsion.
normal_observation.zh: 冷车时液位处于车型规定的 MIN/MAX 范围，颜色均匀且无黑/棕变色、浑浊、油膜或乳化。

en: opening a hot or pressurized cooling or thermal-system cap
touching, tasting, or wiping an unknown fluid or deposit
approaching a fan, pump, orange wiring, or another moving or energized part

触摸、品尝或擦除未知液体/结晶
接近风扇、泵、橙色线束或其他运动/带电部件

en: a component remains hot, the system may be pressurized, or the powertrain may auto-start
spray, an active leak, smoke, scorching, or a high-voltage warning appears
inspection would require opening, disconnecting, touching fluid, or approaching a moving or energized part
zh: 部件仍热、系统可能带压或动力系统可能自动启动
发现喷溅、活跃滴漏、冒烟、烧蚀或高压警告
观察需要开盖、拆接、触摸液体或接近运动/带电部件

warning.en: After powertrain shutdown and model-defined natural cooling of the related thermal or cooling circuit, inspect only from a safely visible position. Never open a hot or pressurized cap, touch an unknown fluid, or reach toward a fan, pump, or another part that may move or remain energized.

en: After the powertrain is shut down and related thermal or cooling components have naturally cooled as required for the model, observe only through the reservoir for level against MIN/MAX or model marks, color, cloudiness, and oil film. Never open a hot or pressurized cap, and mark an obscured or unclear reservoir unable to confirm.
zh: 动力系统关闭并让相关热管理/冷却部件按车型规定自然冷却后，只透过储液罐观察液位相对 MIN/MAX 或车型标记、颜色、浑浊和油膜；不得打开热态或带压盖，标记不清或容器遮挡时无法确认。

why_important.en: Cooling-system problems can cause overheating and major powertrain damage.

normal_observation.en: After shutdown and cooling, visible coolant hoses, pump areas, and joints are dry without pink or colored crystallization, wetness, or a spray path.
normal_observation.zh: 停机冷却后，可见冷却软管、水泵区域和接头干燥，无粉色/彩色结晶、湿痕或喷溅轨迹。

localized_label.zh: 冷却液油膜、浑浊或颜色异常

localized_label.en: Emulsion or deposits in safely visible engine-oil sample
localized_label.zh: 安全可见机油样本乳化或沉积

abnormal_observation.en: An oil film or cloudiness in coolant, or milky foam or paste-like deposit in oil, is abnormal; never open a cap while hot or pressurized and seek professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 冷却液有油膜/混浊，或机油呈乳白泡沫、膏状沉积；热车/带压时一律不打开盖，只记录并专业复检。

check_what.en: Only when the engine is cold and the system depressurized, look through the reservoir for oil film or cloudiness and, under the model instructions, view a safely accessible dipstick or filler-area oil sample for milky foam or deposit. Stop for any hot, pressurized, or inaccessible condition.
check_what.zh: 仅在发动机冷却且系统无压力时透过储液壶观察油膜或混浊，并按车型手册在安全条件下查看机油尺/加注盖可见样本是否有乳白泡沫或沉积；任何热态、带压或位置不可达情况均停止。

detailed_explanation.en: “Coolant reservoir and oil emulsification” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “冷却壶与机油乳化现象检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When observed only cold and depressurized, the reservoir contents are uniform without an oil film, and any safely obtained oil sample has no milky foam or emulsified deposit.
normal_observation.zh: 仅在冷却、无压条件下观察时，储液壶内容物均匀，无油膜；安全取得的机油观察样本无乳白泡沫或乳化沉积。

en: opening a hot cooling-system cap
touching moving belts or fans
zh: 热车开冷却系统盖
手接触旋转皮带或风扇

en: the engine is not shut down and cool or rotating parts remain in motion
a hot or pressurized cap would need to be opened
zh: 发动机未熄火冷却或旋转部件仍在运转
需要打开热态或带压盖

warning.en: Stay clear of moving and hot parts; approach only after shutdown and cooling, and never open a hot or pressurized cap.
warning.zh: 远离旋转和高温部件；发动机熄火并冷却后再接近，热车或有压力时不得开盖。

en: Only when the engine is cold and the system depressurized, look through the reservoir for oil film or cloudiness and, under the model instructions, view a safely accessible dipstick or filler-area oil sample for milky foam or deposit. Stop for any hot, pressurized, or inaccessible condition.
zh: 仅在发动机冷却且系统无压力时透过储液壶观察油膜或混浊，并按车型手册在安全条件下查看机油尺/加注盖可见样本是否有乳白泡沫或沉积；任何热态、带压或位置不可达情况均停止。

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.

localized_label.en: A below-minimum or material overfill reading, invalid electronic reading, or level issue with a fresh leak is abnormal; stop driving for a below-minimum result and investigate.
localized_label.zh: 液位低于下限、明显过量、电子读数无效或液位异常伴随新鲜渗漏；低于下限时停止继续驾驶并查因。

abnormal_observation.en: A below-minimum or material overfill reading, invalid electronic reading, or level issue with a fresh leak is abnormal; stop driving for a below-minimum result and investigate.
abnormal_observation.zh: 液位低于下限、明显过量、电子读数无效或液位异常伴随新鲜渗漏；低于下限时停止继续驾驶并查因。

check_what.en: Park on level ground and follow model-defined shutdown and wait conditions before reading the dipstick or vehicle oil display, repeating once when needed to confirm validity. Stop driving and obtain professional diagnosis for a below-minimum result or accompanying leak.
check_what.zh: 将车辆停在水平地面，按车型手册规定的停机和等待条件使用机油尺或车机读取液位，必要时复读一次确认有效；低于下限或伴随渗漏时停止继续驾驶并专业查因。

detailed_explanation.en: “Engine-oil level” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “机油液位检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Under the model-defined level-ground, shutdown, and wait conditions, the dipstick or vehicle display gives a stable valid reading within range with no nearby fresh leak.
normal_observation.zh: 按车型手册规定的水平、停机和等待条件读取后，机油尺/车机显示在有效范围内，读数稳定且周边无新鲜渗漏。

en: opening a hot cooling-system cap
touching moving belts or fans
zh: 热车开冷却系统盖
手接触旋转皮带或风扇

en: the engine is not shut down and cool or rotating parts remain in motion
a hot or pressurized cap would need to be opened
zh: 发动机未熄火冷却或旋转部件仍在运转
需要打开热态或带压盖

warning.en: Stay clear of moving and hot parts; approach only after shutdown and cooling, and never open a hot or pressurized cap.
warning.zh: 远离旋转和高温部件；发动机熄火并冷却后再接近，热车或有压力时不得开盖。

en: Park on level ground and follow model-defined shutdown and wait conditions before reading the dipstick or vehicle oil display, repeating once when needed to confirm validity. Stop driving and obtain professional diagnosis for a below-minimum result or accompanying leak.
zh: 将车辆停在水平地面，按车型手册规定的停机和等待条件使用机油尺或车机读取液位，必要时复读一次确认有效；低于下限或伴随渗漏时停止继续驾驶并专业查因。

why_important.en: Abnormal oil level or condition may indicate poor maintenance, leakage, or internal damage.
why_important.zh: 油位或油液状态异常可能提示维护不足、泄漏或内部损伤。

localized_label.en: Material lag, power interruption, surge, vibration, abnormal noise, or a warning during ordinary progressive acceleration is abnormal; never use full-throttle or limit acceleration.
localized_label.zh: 普通渐进加速即出现明显迟滞、动力中断、顿挫、抖动、异常噪声或警告；不得深踩/极限加速，停止并复检。

abnormal_observation.en: Material lag, power interruption, surge, vibration, abnormal noise, or a warning during ordinary progressive acceleration is abnormal; never use full-throttle or limit acceleration.
abnormal_observation.zh: 普通渐进加速即出现明显迟滞、动力中断、顿挫、抖动、异常噪声或警告；不得深踩/极限加速，停止并复检。

check_what.en: A qualified driver may use ordinary progressive acceleration on a legal, open, safe road to observe smooth power delivery; do not use full throttle or perform a limit test merely for this checklist.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷且安全的路段进行普通渐进加速，观察动力是否平顺；不要为完成清单而深踩油门或进行极限加速。

detailed_explanation.en: “Power delivery during safe, ordinary acceleration” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全条件下观察加速动力输出平稳性”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During ordinary progressive acceleration on a legal safe road, a qualified driver experiences continuous, predictable response without material lag, surge, misfire-like behavior, or a new warning.
normal_observation.zh: 有资格驾驶员在合法安全路段普通渐进加速时，动力响应连续可预测，无明显迟滞、顿挫、失火感或新增警告。

testing beyond the driver's competence

localized_label.zh: 换挡出现重复顿挫、长时间迟滞、转速空升、抖动、卡在档位或异响/警告；不以激烈驾驶验证。

abnormal_observation.en: Repeatable shift shock, long delay, engine-speed flare, shudder, a stuck ratio, or related noise or warning is abnormal; do not verify with aggressive driving.
abnormal_observation.zh: 换挡出现重复顿挫、长时间迟滞、转速空升、抖动、卡在档位或异响/警告；不以激烈驾驶验证。

check_what.en: A qualified driver on a legal safe road may use ordinary acceleration and deceleration to observe shift timing, speed changes, and vehicle response and record repeatable shock, delay, flare, shudder, or noise. Never reproduce it with hard acceleration, hard deceleration, or limit operation.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法安全路段以普通加速和减速观察换挡时机、转速变化和车身响应，记录重复顿挫、迟滞、空转、抖动或异响；不得以急加速、急减速或极限工况复现。

detailed_explanation.en: “Shift smoothness” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “换挡平顺性检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During ordinary acceleration and deceleration, gear changes are continuous, engine speed and road speed respond coherently, and there is no material shock, delay, flare, or noise.
normal_observation.zh: 正常加速和减速过程中，档位变化连续、转速与车速响应协调，无明显冲击、拖延、空转或异响。

title.zh: 换挡平顺性检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Available service records conflict with the model requirements, or a fresh wet trace or drip is visible externally without lifting, disassembly, or plug opening; obtain a professional model-specific review.
localized_label.zh: 可用保养记录与车型要求矛盾，或无需举升/拆卸/开塞即可看到的外部区域存在新鲜湿痕或滴漏；转专业车型流程核对。

abnormal_observation.en: Available service records conflict with the model requirements, or a fresh wet trace or drip is visible externally without lifting, disassembly, or plug opening; obtain a professional model-specific review.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可用保养记录与车型要求矛盾，或无需举升/拆卸/开塞即可看到的外部区域存在新鲜湿痕或滴漏；转专业车型流程核对。

check_what.en: After securing the vehicle and meeting the model-defined cooling condition, first inspect external areas visible without hot operation, lifting, disassembly, or plug opening. Record a visible fresh wet trace or drip as abnormal even when records are missing. Then review transmission service records; if the exterior has no abnormality but records are missing, or level or color requires hot operation, lifting, or plug opening, select unable to confirm.
check_what.zh: 车辆按车型要求停稳并满足手册规定的冷却工况后，先观察无需热机、举升、拆卸或开塞即可看到的外部区域：发现可见新鲜湿痕/滴漏时直接记为“异常”，不因缺记录而跳过。再核对变速箱保养记录；外部无异常但记录缺失，或液位/颜色只能靠热机、举升、开塞确认时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Transmission-fluid condition” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “变速箱油”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Service records show model-appropriate maintenance, and transmission exterior areas visible without lifting, disassembly, or opening a plug are dry with no fresh leak.
normal_observation.zh: 保养记录显示按车型要求维护；无需举升、拆卸或开塞即可看到的变速箱外部区域干燥、无新鲜渗漏。

en: a general user opening a transmission fill or check plug while hot
going beneath a jack-supported or running vehicle
adding, extracting, or tasting unknown fluid
zh: 普通用户热机开启变速箱加注塞或检查塞
仅靠千斤顶进入车下或在车辆运行时从车下检测
自行加注、抽取或品尝未知油液

en: confirmation would require running hot, lifting the vehicle, or opening a fill/check plug
hot fluid, fresh leakage, or an unidentified component is found
the model service procedure or a qualified professional is unavailable
zh: 确认需要热车运行、举升车辆或开启加注/检查塞
发现热液体、新鲜泄漏或部件用途不明
缺少车型维修工艺或合格人员

warning.en: A general user reviews service records and only external leakage visible without lifting, disassembly, or opening a plug. Model-specific transmission-fluid level, temperature, and color procedures belong to a qualified professional following the service manual.
warning.zh: 普通用户只核对保养/维修记录及无需举升、拆卸或开塞即可看到的外部渗漏；变速箱油液位、温度和颜色的车型专用工艺交由合格人员按维修手册处理。

en: After securing the vehicle and meeting the model-defined cooling condition, first inspect external areas visible without hot operation, lifting, disassembly, or plug opening. Record a visible fresh wet trace or drip as abnormal even when records are missing. Then review transmission service records; if the exterior has no abnormality but records are missing, or level or color requires hot operation, lifting, or plug opening, select unable to confirm.
zh: 车辆按车型要求停稳并满足手册规定的冷却工况后，先观察无需热机、举升、拆卸或开塞即可看到的外部区域：发现可见新鲜湿痕/滴漏时直接记为“异常”，不因缺记录而跳过。再核对变速箱保养记录；外部无异常但记录缺失，或液位/颜色只能靠热机、举升、开塞确认时选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Power-delivery or transmission abnormalities affect drivability and may require professional diagnosis.
why_important.zh: 动力输出和传动异常会影响可驾驶性，并可能需要专业诊断。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 变速箱油

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A housing or clip visible without disassembly is broken, or visible intake plumbing is cracked, corroded, abnormally oily, loose, or mis-seated; obtain professional follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 无需拆卸即可看到的外壳/卡扣破损，或进气管出现裂纹、腐蚀、异常油污、松脱或接口错位；转专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: A housing or clip visible without disassembly is broken, or visible intake plumbing is cracked, corroded, abnormally oily, loose, or mis-seated; obtain professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 无需拆卸即可看到的外壳/卡扣破损，或进气管出现裂纹、腐蚀、异常油污、松脱或接口错位；转专业复检。

check_what.en: After powertrain shutdown and full cooling, inspect only the air-filter housing, clips, and intake plumbing visible without disassembly and record oil contamination, cracking, corrosion, or looseness. Never remove plumbing, touch a sensor, or reach near moving parts; select unable to confirm when inspection would require disassembly or contact.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭并充分冷却后，只观察无需拆卸即可看到的空气滤芯外壳、卡扣和进气管固定，记录油污、裂纹、腐蚀或松动；不得拆管、触碰传感器或把手伸入运动部件附近。需要拆卸或接触才能确认时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Air filter and intake plumbing” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “检查空气滤芯，进气管道是否存在油污、裂纹、锈蚀或松动情况”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After shutdown and cooling, the air-filter housing, clips, and intake plumbing visible without disassembly are securely fitted and show no abnormal oil contamination, cracking, corrosion, or looseness.
normal_observation.zh: 发动机熄火冷却后，无需拆卸可见的空气滤芯外壳、卡扣和进气管固定完整，表面无异常油污、裂纹、腐蚀或松脱。

en: removing intake plumbing or the filter housing
touching a sensor, belt, or fan
reaching into the engine bay while running
zh: 拆卸进气管或滤芯外壳
触碰传感器、皮带或风扇
运行中伸手进入发动机舱

en: a part remains hot or the engine may auto-start
inspection would require plumbing or housing removal or sensor contact
a loose part, damaged wiring, or unknown liquid is found
zh: 部件仍热或发动机可能自动启动
检查需要拆管、拆外壳或触碰传感器
发现松脱部件、破损线束或不明液体

warning.en: After shutdown and full cooling, inspect only the air-filter housing, clips, and intake plumbing visible without disassembly. Never remove plumbing, touch a sensor, or reach near moving parts.
warning.zh: 发动机熄火并充分冷却后，只观察无需拆卸即可看到的空气滤芯外壳、卡扣和进气管；不得拆管、触碰传感器或把手伸入运动部件附近。

en: After powertrain shutdown and full cooling, inspect only the air-filter housing, clips, and intake plumbing visible without disassembly and record oil contamination, cracking, corrosion, or looseness. Never remove plumbing, touch a sensor, or reach near moving parts; select unable to confirm when inspection would require disassembly or contact.
zh: 动力系统关闭并充分冷却后，只观察无需拆卸即可看到的空气滤芯外壳、卡扣和进气管固定，记录油污、裂纹、腐蚀或松动；不得拆管、触碰传感器或把手伸入运动部件附近。需要拆卸或接触才能确认时选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Intake or exhaust defects can affect performance, emissions, noise, and safety.
why_important.zh: 进排气缺陷可能影响动力、排放、噪声和安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 检查空气滤芯，进气管道是否存在油污、裂纹、锈蚀或松动情况

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A visible crack, perforation, scaling corrosion, broken hanger, loose joint, or sagging pipe requires professional follow-up without touching sharp rust or going beneath the vehicle.
localized_label.zh: 可见裂纹、穿孔、起层锈蚀、吊耳断裂、接缝松脱或管路下垂；不触摸锐利锈边、不进入车下，转专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: A visible crack, perforation, scaling corrosion, broken hanger, loose joint, or sagging pipe requires professional follow-up without touching sharp rust or going beneath the vehicle.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可见裂纹、穿孔、起层锈蚀、吊耳断裂、接缝松脱或管路下垂；不触摸锐利锈边、不进入车下，转专业复检。

check_what.en: After shutdown and full exhaust cooling, inspect only externally visible pipe, hangers, and joints for cracks, holes, severe corrosion, or looseness. Do not touch sharp rust edges or place any body part beneath the vehicle.
check_what.zh: 发动机熄火且排气部件充分冷却后，只从车辆外缘观察可见排气管、吊耳和接缝的裂纹、穿孔、严重锈蚀或松动；不触摸锋利锈边，也不把身体伸入车辆下方。

detailed_explanation.en: “Exhaust-pipe condition” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “检查排气管是否存在裂纹、锈蚀或松动情况”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After shutdown and full cooling, exhaust pipe, hangers, and joints visible from the vehicle edge are intact and secure without cracks, holes, severe corrosion, or sagging.
normal_observation.zh: 发动机熄火且排气充分冷却后，从车身外缘可见的管路、吊耳和接缝完整固定，无裂纹、穿孔、严重锈蚀或下垂。

en: touching hot exhaust or sharp corroded edges
placing the body beneath the vehicle
shaking, removing, or striking exhaust components
zh: 触摸热排气或锋利锈蚀边缘
身体进入车辆下方
摇晃、拆卸或敲击排气部件

en: an exhaust part remains hot or has a sharp rust edge
a clear view would require a head, arm, or body beneath the vehicle
a loose part, hole, dense smoke, or unknown hazard is found
zh: 排气部件仍热或存在锋利锈边
必须把头、手臂或身体伸入车辆下方
发现松脱部件、穿孔、浓重烟雾或不明危险

warning.en: After shutdown, full exhaust cooling, and secure parking, inspect only pipes, joints, and hangers visible from the vehicle edge; no body part may go beneath the vehicle.
warning.zh: 发动机熄火、排气系统充分冷却且车辆可靠停稳后，只从车辆外缘观察可见管路、接缝和吊耳；身体不得进入车辆下方。

en: After shutdown and full exhaust cooling, inspect only externally visible pipe, hangers, and joints for cracks, holes, severe corrosion, or looseness. Do not touch sharp rust edges or place any body part beneath the vehicle.
zh: 发动机熄火且排气部件充分冷却后，只从车辆外缘观察可见排气管、吊耳和接缝的裂纹、穿孔、严重锈蚀或松动；不触摸锋利锈边，也不把身体伸入车辆下方。

why_important.en: Intake or exhaust defects can affect performance, emissions, noise, and safety.
why_important.zh: 进排气缺陷可能影响动力、排放、噪声和安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 检查排气管是否存在裂纹、锈蚀或松动情况

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent smoke, abnormal liquid, popping or leak noise, or a strong odor noticed without active sniffing is abnormal; odor cannot exclude carbon monoxide, so leave and seek follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 持续烟雾、异常滴液、爆鸣/漏气声，或被动察觉到强烈异常气味；气味不能排除一氧化碳，应离开并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: Persistent smoke, abnormal liquid, popping or leak noise, or a strong odor noticed without active sniffing is abnormal; odor cannot exclude carbon monoxide, so leave and seek follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 持续烟雾、异常滴液、爆鸣/漏气声，或被动察觉到强烈异常气味；气味不能排除一氧化碳，应离开并专业复检。

check_what.en: Only outdoors in an open area, observe visible smoke, liquid, or abnormal sound during normal idle from clean air to the side and rear. Stay away from the tailpipe, never sniff exhaust directly, and never rely on odor to detect carbon monoxide.
check_what.zh: 只在室外开阔处，从排气口侧后方的清洁空气位置观察正常怠速时的可见烟雾、滴液或异常声响；不靠近排气口、不直接嗅闻，也不依赖气味判断一氧化碳。

detailed_explanation.en: “Exhaust odor and other emission symptoms” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “观察尾气排放是否有异常气味或其他排放问题”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: From clean outdoor air during normal idle, there is no persistent visible smoke, abnormal liquid, or exhaust noise, and no one approaches or directly sniffs the exhaust.
normal_observation.zh: 室外清洁空气位置观察正常怠速时，无持续可见烟雾、异常滴液或排气异响；未主动靠近或直接嗅闻尾气。

en: running the engine in an enclosed or partly enclosed space
sniffing or inhaling exhaust near the tailpipe
using odor to exclude carbon monoxide or revving merely to observe emissions
zh: 在封闭或半封闭空间运行发动机
靠近排气口直接嗅闻或吸入尾气
用气味排除一氧化碳或为观察排放深踩油门

en: dizziness, headache, nausea, drowsiness, or breathing discomfort
exhaust accumulates or the setting is not open outdoors
flame, dense smoke, fuel dripping, or unexpected vehicle movement appears
zh: 头晕、头痛、恶心、困倦或呼吸不适
尾气聚集、现场不是室外开阔环境
出现火焰、浓烟、燃油滴漏或车辆非预期移动

warning.en: Observe normal-idle emissions only in an open outdoor area from clean air to the side and rear. Stay away from exhaust, never sniff it directly, and never rely on odor to detect carbon monoxide.
warning.zh: 只在室外开阔处观察正常怠速排放；观察者站在排气口侧后方的清洁空气位置，远离尾气，不得直接嗅闻或依赖气味判断一氧化碳。

en: Only outdoors in an open area, observe visible smoke, liquid, or abnormal sound during normal idle from clean air to the side and rear. Stay away from the tailpipe, never sniff exhaust directly, and never rely on odor to detect carbon monoxide.
zh: 只在室外开阔处，从排气口侧后方的清洁空气位置观察正常怠速时的可见烟雾、滴液或异常声响；不靠近排气口、不直接嗅闻，也不依赖气味判断一氧化碳。

why_important.en: Intake or exhaust defects can affect performance, emissions, noise, and safety.
why_important.zh: 进排气缺陷可能影响动力、排放、噪声和安全。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Exhaust odor and other emission symptoms
title.zh: 观察尾气排放是否有异常气味或其他排放问题

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Pre-drive visible powertrain-bay leakage or abnormal deposits
localized_label.zh: 驶前动力舱可见渗漏或异常油垢

localized_label.en: Only damage or burned/melted appearance of safely visible identified low-voltage wiring; unknown voltage/purpose remains unknown and must not be approached.
localized_label.zh: 只记录当前安全可见、已经识别的低压线束损伤或烧熔类外观；电压用途不明为未知，不接近。

localized_label.en: Burned/melted appearance of non-wiring material
localized_label.zh: 非线束材料烧熔类外观

abnormal_observation.en: Fresh leakage, dripping, abnormal deposits, scorching, or wiring damage within the area visible without cover removal requires professional follow-up without general-user disassembly.
abnormal_observation.zh: 在无需拆罩即可看到的范围内发现新鲜渗漏、挂滴、异常油垢、烧蚀或线束损伤；普通用户不拆罩，转专业复检。

check_what.en: After powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, and natural cooling, inspect from the engine- or power-bay edge only for wetness, drips, abnormal deposits, scorching, and wiring damage visible without cover removal. Select unable to confirm for concealed areas or anything requiring cover removal; a general user must not remove a cover.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用且部件自然冷却后，只从发动机舱或动力舱边缘观察无需拆罩即可看到的湿痕、挂滴、异常油垢、烧蚀和线束损伤。遮挡区或需拆罩才能确认时选择“无法确认”，普通用户不得拆罩。

detailed_explanation.en: “Visible oil and leak inspection without disassembly” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “无需拆卸的可见油污与渗漏检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Engine-bay areas visible without disassembly are dry with no fresh wetness, drip, abnormal deposit, scorching, or wiring damage; concealed areas are not assumed normal.
normal_observation.zh: 无需拆卸即可看到的发动机舱区域干燥，无新鲜湿痕、挂滴、异常油垢、烧蚀或线束损伤；遮挡区不判正常。

en: a general user removing the engine cover
touching orange high-voltage cables, terminals, or unknown electrical parts
removing parts while the engine is running, hot, or able to auto-start
zh: 普通用户拆卸发动机罩盖
触碰橙色高压线束、端子或未知电气部件
在发动机运行、热态或可能自动启动时拆卸

en: the visible check would require cover removal, tools, or disconnecting clips or wiring
a part remains hot, may move, may be energized, or cannot be identified
an orange high-voltage part, damaged wiring, liquid, or scorching is found
zh: 可见检查需要拆罩、工具或断开卡扣/线束
部件仍热、可能转动、带电或用途不明
发现橙色高压部件、破损线束、液体或烧蚀

warning.en: A general user may inspect only areas visible without disassembly and must not remove an engine cover. If source inspection requires removal, only an authorized model-competent professional may do so after shutdown, cooling, and manual-defined isolation; never touch orange high-voltage cables or unknown electrical parts.
warning.zh: 普通用户只观察无需拆卸即可看到的区域，不得拆发动机罩盖。若来源检查必须拆罩，仅由获授权且熟悉车型的专业人员在车辆断电/熄火、冷却并按手册隔离后执行；不得触碰橙色高压线束或未知电气部件。

en: After powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, and natural cooling, inspect from the engine- or power-bay edge only for wetness, drips, abnormal deposits, scorching, and wiring damage visible without cover removal. Select unable to confirm for concealed areas or anything requiring cover removal; a general user must not remove a cover.
zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用且部件自然冷却后，只从发动机舱或动力舱边缘观察无需拆罩即可看到的湿痕、挂滴、异常油垢、烧蚀和线束损伤。遮挡区或需拆罩才能确认时选择“无法确认”，普通用户不得拆罩。

why_important.en: Leaks, aging, and wiring damage can become reliability, fire, or breakdown risks.
why_important.zh: 泄漏、老化和电气损伤可能演变成可靠性、起火或停驶风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Visible oil and leak inspection without disassembly
title.zh: 无需拆卸的可见油污与渗漏检查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: An identified, confirmed-unpressurized, safely accessible rubber hose shows cracking, swelling, powdering, marked brittleness or softness, or wetness; stop touching and obtain professional follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 已识别、确认无压且可安全接近的橡胶软管出现龟裂、鼓包、粉化、明显发脆/过软或潮湿；停止触碰并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: An identified, confirmed-unpressurized, safely accessible rubber hose shows cracking, swelling, powdering, marked brittleness or softness, or wetness; stop touching and obtain professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已识别、确认无压且可安全接近的橡胶软管出现龟裂、鼓包、粉化、明显发脆/过软或潮湿；停止触碰并专业复检。

check_what.en: After shutdown and full natural cooling, first inspect and only then lightly touch an identified safely accessible rubber hose when the vehicle instructions or status clearly show the system is unpressurized. A general user must never open a cap, loosen a fitting, or release pressure; mark unclear status unable to confirm.
check_what.zh: 发动机熄火并自然充分冷却后，只有在车辆手册/状态明确表明相关系统无压力时，才先目视并轻触已识别、可安全接近的橡胶软管；普通用户不得自行开盖、松接头或进行泄压，状态不明即无法确认。

detailed_explanation.en: “Aged or brittle hoses” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “管道老化或发脆情况排查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After shutdown and full natural cooling, with the instructions or vehicle status already confirming the system is unpressurized, an identified safely accessible rubber hose has a smooth surface with no cracking, swelling, powdering, abnormal hardness, or wetness on a light touch; the general user performed no active pressure release.
normal_observation.zh: 停机并自然充分冷却、且手册或车辆状态已确认系统无压力后，已识别且可安全接近的橡胶软管外观平顺，轻触无龟裂、鼓包、粉化、异常发硬或潮湿；普通用户未执行任何主动泄压。

en: squeezing an unknown, hot, or pressurized line
opening a cap, loosening a fitting, or releasing pressure
touching fuel or high-pressure lines
zh: 挤压未知、热态或带压管路
开盖、松接头或自行泄压
触碰燃油/高压管线

en: the line cannot be identified
the surface is wet, cracked, swollen, or actively leaking
the system remains hot or pressurized or a fitting would need opening
zh: 管路用途不明
表面潮湿、龟裂、鼓包或正在渗漏
系统仍热、带压或需要拆开接头

warning.en: After shutdown and full natural cooling, inspect only when the instructions or vehicle status already confirm that the system is unpressurized. A general user must never open a cap, loosen a fitting, or release pressure and may lightly touch only an identified safely accessible rubber hose.
warning.zh: 发动机熄火并自然充分冷却后，只有在手册/车辆状态已确认相关系统无压力时才先目视；普通用户不得自行开盖、松接头或泄压，只可轻触已识别且可安全接近的橡胶软管。

en: After shutdown and full natural cooling, first inspect and only then lightly touch an identified safely accessible rubber hose when the vehicle instructions or status clearly show the system is unpressurized. A general user must never open a cap, loosen a fitting, or release pressure; mark unclear status unable to confirm.
zh: 发动机熄火并自然充分冷却后，只有在车辆手册/状态明确表明相关系统无压力时，才先目视并轻触已识别、可安全接近的橡胶软管；普通用户不得自行开盖、松接头或进行泄压，状态不明即无法确认。

why_important.zh: 泄漏、老化和电气损伤可能演变成可靠性、起火或停驶风险。

reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 管道老化或发脆情况排查

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Visible identified low-voltage wiring damage
localized_label.zh: 已识别低压线束外观损伤

localized_label.en: This source records only actual exterior damage to orange high-voltage wiring visible from a safe distance; no battery-housing or warning-lamp extension.
localized_label.zh: 本来源仅记录安全距离可见橙色高压线束外表实际破损；不扩展为电池外壳或警告灯检查。

abnormal_observation.en: Confirmed visible low-voltage wiring has damaged insulation, a bare conductor, loose connector, scorching, or non-standard wiring, or orange high-voltage wiring is visibly damaged from a safe distance; obtain immediate professional follow-up without touching or unplugging.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已确认的可见低压线束出现破皮、裸线、松脱插头、烧蚀或非规范接线，或从安全距离可见橙色高压线束已破损；不触碰、不拔插，立即转专业复检。

check_what.en: After powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, and cooling related parts, visually inspect only visible low-voltage wiring confirmed by labels or instructions; never touch or unplug it. Select unable to confirm when low- versus high-voltage identity is unclear, trim removal is needed, or unknown wiring must be approached; classify only actual damage visible from a safe distance as abnormal.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用且相关部件冷却后，只目视已由标签/手册确认的可见低压线束；不触碰、不拔插。低压/高压或用途边界不明、需要拆饰件或靠近未知线束时选择“无法确认”；从安全距离看见实际破损才记为异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Visible low-voltage and power-bay wiring condition” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “可见低压与动力舱线束状态”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: With the powertrain shut down, cooled, and unable to auto-start, safely visible low-voltage insulation is intact, retainers are secure, and connectors are seated; orange high-voltage wiring remains untouched.
normal_observation.zh: 动力系统关闭、冷却且不会自动启动时，可安全目视的低压线束外皮完整、固定点可靠、插头就位；橙色高压线束保持未触碰。

en: touching or unplugging orange high-voltage wiring or an unknown connector
piercing insulation, shorting terminals, or live probing
reaching into the bay while the powertrain runs or may auto-start
zh: 触碰或拔插橙色高压线束及未知接头
用探针刺穿绝缘层、短接端子或带电检测
在动力系统运行或可能自动启动时伸入发动机舱

en: orange high-voltage wiring, exposed conductor, scorching, smoke, or liquid is found
the check would require cover removal, moving wiring, unplugging a connector, or using a probe
a part remains hot, may move, may be energized, or cannot be identified
zh: 发现橙色高压线束、裸露导体、烧蚀、冒烟或液体
需要拆罩、移动线束、拔插接头或使用探针
部件仍热、可能转动、带电或用途不明

warning.en: After shutdown, cooling, and confirming that the powertrain cannot auto-start, visually inspect only safely accessible insulation, retainers, and connector seating. Never touch or unplug orange high-voltage or unidentified wiring.
warning.zh: 动力系统关闭、充分冷却并确认不会自动启动后，只目视可安全接近的线束外皮、固定点和插接状态；橙色高压线束及用途不明的线缆一律不触碰、不拔插。

en: After powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, and cooling related parts, visually inspect only visible low-voltage wiring confirmed by labels or instructions; never touch or unplug it. Select unable to confirm when low- versus high-voltage identity is unclear, trim removal is needed, or unknown wiring must be approached; classify only actual damage visible from a safe distance as abnormal.
zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用且相关部件冷却后，只目视已由标签/手册确认的可见低压线束；不触碰、不拔插。低压/高压或用途边界不明、需要拆饰件或靠近未知线束时选择“无法确认”；从安全距离看见实际破损才记为异常。

why_important.en: Fluids, low-voltage electrical systems, and under-vehicle clues vary by powertrain and model and must be identified from the instructions within no-disassembly, high-voltage, and hot-part boundaries.
why_important.zh: 位置因动力形式和车型而异的流体、低压电气与车底迹象必须按手册识别，并在不拆卸、不接触高压或高温部件的边界内检查。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Visible low-voltage and power-bay wiring condition
title.zh: 可见低压与动力舱线束状态

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Compared with the pre-drive baseline, the same visible area shows a reproducible fresh wet trace, drip, or pooled fluid; never perform an aggressive drive for this item and seek professional localization.
localized_label.zh: 与行驶前基线相比，同一可见区域出现可重复的新鲜湿痕、挂滴或积液；不得为此激烈试驾，记录并专业定位。

abnormal_observation.en: Compared with the pre-drive baseline, the same visible area shows a reproducible fresh wet trace, drip, or pooled fluid; never perform an aggressive drive for this item and seek professional localization.
abnormal_observation.zh: 与行驶前基线相比，同一可见区域出现可重复的新鲜湿痕、挂滴或积液；不得为此激烈试驾，记录并专业定位。

check_what.en: Before ordinary driving, document a dry baseline for the same VHC-GEN-046 area visible without disassembly. After the ordinary trip, park safely, wait until hot parts have cooled enough for observation, and recheck from the same viewpoint. Select unable to confirm when no pre-drive baseline exists or cooling is incomplete; never pressure-clean the engine bay or perform an aggressive drive for this item.
check_what.zh: 先在正常行驶前记录 VHC-GEN-046 同一无需拆卸可见区域的干燥基线。完成普通行程后安全停稳，等待高温部件充分冷却到可观察，再从相同视角复查；未建立行驶前基线或尚未冷却时选择“无法确认”，不得自行精洗发动机舱或为本项激烈试驾。

detailed_explanation.en: “Pre-drive baseline and cooled same-area leak reinspection” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “行驶前基线与冷却后同区域渗漏复检”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The same visible dry area documented before ordinary driving remains dry with no new or expanding wet trace after safe parking and enough cooling for observation.
normal_observation.zh: 正常行驶前已记录的同一可见干燥区域，在行驶后安全停稳并充分冷却到可观察时仍保持干燥，无新出现或扩大的湿痕。

en: using a pressure-cleaned, detailed, or wiped area as the pre-drive dry baseline
hard acceleration, aggressive driving, or extending a road test for this item
touching unknown fluid or hot parts or removing a cover for reinspection
zh: 压力清洗、精洗或擦除区域后把它当行驶前干燥基线
为本项急加速、激烈驾驶或延长路试
触摸未知液体、热部件或拆罩复查

en: the same-area pre-drive baseline is missing or the same safe viewpoint cannot be reproduced
parts remain hot, the powertrain may auto-start, or smoke or burning odor appears
reinspection would require disassembly, fluid contact, or approach to a moving or energized part
zh: 缺少行驶前同区域基线或无法复现同一安全视角
部件仍热、动力系统可能自动启动或出现烟雾/焦味
复查需要拆卸、触摸液体或接近运动/带电部件

warning.en: Before ordinary driving, document a dry baseline for the same VHC-GEN-046 area visible without disassembly. After the ordinary trip, secure and shut down the vehicle, wait until hot parts are cool enough to observe, and recheck from the same viewpoint. Never pressure-clean to create a baseline or drive aggressively for this item.
warning.zh: 先在正常行驶前记录 VHC-GEN-046 同一无需拆卸可见区域的干燥基线；完成普通行程后停稳、关闭动力系统并等待高温部件冷却到可观察，再从同一视角复查。不得为建立基线而压力清洗，也不得为本项激烈驾驶。

en: Before ordinary driving, document a dry baseline for the same VHC-GEN-046 area visible without disassembly. After the ordinary trip, park safely, wait until hot parts have cooled enough for observation, and recheck from the same viewpoint. Select unable to confirm when no pre-drive baseline exists or cooling is incomplete; never pressure-clean the engine bay or perform an aggressive drive for this item.
zh: 先在正常行驶前记录 VHC-GEN-046 同一无需拆卸可见区域的干燥基线。完成普通行程后安全停稳，等待高温部件充分冷却到可观察，再从相同视角复查；未建立行驶前基线或尚未冷却时选择“无法确认”，不得自行精洗发动机舱或为本项激烈试驾。

why_important.en: Leaks, aging, and wiring damage can become reliability, fire, or breakdown risks.
why_important.zh: 泄漏、老化和电气损伤可能演变成可靠性、起火或停驶风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Pre-drive baseline and cooled same-area leak reinspection
title.zh: 行驶前基线与冷却后同区域渗漏复检

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A new fluid spot, drip, or continuing wet trace after the full 10 minutes is abnormal; do not touch unknown fluid, record its relative location, and obtain professional follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 完整10分钟后出现新液斑、滴落或持续湿痕；不触碰未知液体，记录相对位置并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: A new fluid spot, drip, or continuing wet trace after the full 10 minutes is abnormal; do not touch unknown fluid, record its relative location, and obtain professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 完整10分钟后出现新液斑、滴落或持续湿痕；不触碰未知液体，记录相对位置并专业复检。

check_what.en: Only after powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, full natural cooling of the exhaust, catalyst, and other thermal parts, and removal of sparks, flame, and smoking may a clean absorbent board be placed from the vehicle edge on safely reachable ground and the full 10-minute timer started. Keep the board away from all hot parts. After the full 10-minute wait, retrieve it only from the edge and inspect for a new spot or drip. Stop immediately and select unable to confirm for heat, smoke, fuel odor, or inability to place or retrieve it safely from the edge.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用，排气/催化器及相关热部件完全自然冷却且现场无火花、明火或吸烟后，才从车身外缘把干净吸液纸板放到安全可达地面并开始完整10分钟计时；纸板不得接触或靠近热部件。完整等待10分钟后只从外缘安全取回并查看新液斑/滴落。出现热气、烟雾、燃油味或无法从外缘安全放置/取回时立即停止并选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Leak evidence beneath the vehicle” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车底渗漏”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After the full 10-minute wait on level ground, the safely retrieved clean absorbent board shows no new fluid spot or drip; this only covers that observation window.
normal_observation.zh: 水平地面完整等待10分钟后，安全取回的干净吸液纸板无新液斑或滴落；仅代表该时间窗未见落地泄漏。

en: sliding the board toward the exhaust, catalyst, or another hot part
placing a body, head, hand, or arm beneath the vehicle
placing the board while the powertrain runs, parts are hot, or sparks, flame, or smoking is present
zh: 把纸板滑向排气、催化器或其他热部件
身体、头、手或手臂伸入车下
在动力系统运行、热态或存在火花/明火/吸烟时放置纸板

en: heat, smoke, burning or fuel odor, or auto-start risk remains
the board cannot be placed or retrieved safely from the vehicle edge
an active leak, unknown fluid, electrical arcing, or an ignition source appears
zh: 仍有热气、烟雾、焦味、燃油味或可能自动启动
无法从车身外缘安全放置或取回纸板
发现活跃滴漏、不明液体、电气打火或现场点火源

warning.en: Shut down the powertrain, disable auto-start, and let the exhaust, catalyst, and all other thermal parts cool fully and naturally. After removing sparks, flame, and smoking, place and retrieve a clean absorbent board only from the vehicle edge on safely reachable ground. Keep the board away from all hot parts.
warning.zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用，并让排气、催化器及其他热部件完全自然冷却；清除火花、明火和吸烟后，只可从车身外缘把干净吸液纸板放在安全可达地面并从外缘取回。纸板不得接触或靠近热部件。

en: Only after powertrain shutdown, disabling auto-start, full natural cooling of the exhaust, catalyst, and other thermal parts, and removal of sparks, flame, and smoking may a clean absorbent board be placed from the vehicle edge on safely reachable ground and the full 10-minute timer started. Keep the board away from all hot parts. After the full 10-minute wait, retrieve it only from the edge and inspect for a new spot or drip. Stop immediately and select unable to confirm for heat, smoke, fuel odor, or inability to place or retrieve it safely from the edge.
zh: 动力系统关闭、自动启动已禁用，排气/催化器及相关热部件完全自然冷却且现场无火花、明火或吸烟后，才从车身外缘把干净吸液纸板放到安全可达地面并开始完整10分钟计时；纸板不得接触或靠近热部件。完整等待10分钟后只从外缘安全取回并查看新液斑/滴落。出现热气、烟雾、燃油味或无法从外缘安全放置/取回时立即停止并选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Fluids, low-voltage electrical systems, and under-vehicle clues vary by powertrain and model and must be identified from the instructions within no-disassembly, high-voltage, and hot-part boundaries.
why_important.zh: 位置因动力形式和车型而异的流体、低压电气与车底迹象必须按手册识别，并在不拆卸、不接触高压或高温部件的边界内检查。

reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

abnormal_observation.en: The component is clearly a low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery, but its visible location or mounting materially conflicts with the instructions or replacement records, or the tray, restraint, or case is displaced, loose, or damaged; stop approaching and obtain professional follow-up.

normal_observation.en: The low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery location is confirmed from the vehicle instructions and labels visible without disassembly, with no seat, trim, or cover removal and no contact with terminals, orange wiring, or unknown components.

localized_label.en: A safely read and properly decoded low-voltage battery date is materially outlying, later than the claimed replacement, earlier than a reasonable inventory range, or conflicts with an invoice or replacement record; record the evidence and obtain professional review.
localized_label.zh: 已安全读取并按适用规则确认的低压电池日期明显离群、晚于所称更换时间、早于合理库存范围，或与发票/更换记录矛盾；记录证据并专业核对。

abnormal_observation.en: A safely read and properly decoded low-voltage battery date is materially outlying, later than the claimed replacement, earlier than a reasonable inventory range, or conflicts with an invoice or replacement record; record the evidence and obtain professional review.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已安全读取并按适用规则确认的低压电池日期明显离群、晚于所称更换时间、早于合理库存范围，或与发票/更换记录矛盾；记录证据并专业核对。

check_what.en: After confirming from the instructions that the component is the low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery, read only a label or date code visible without disassembly and compare it with production and replacement records under the applicable rule. check_what.zh: 按车辆手册确认对象是低压辅助/启动电池后，只读取无需拆卸即可看到的标签或日期码，并按适用规则与生产和更换记录比较；不得拆盖或接触端子/高压组件。

detailed_explanation.en: “Low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery production date” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.

normal_observation.en: A low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery label or date code visible without disassembly is legible and, under the applicable decoding rule, aligns with vehicle production and replacement records.
normal_observation.zh: 无需拆卸即可看到的低压辅助/启动电池标签或日期码清晰，按适用规则解读后与车辆生产和更换记录逻辑相符。

title.en: Low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery production date
title.zh: 低压辅助/启动电池生产日期

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A confirmed low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery shows swelling, leakage, heat damage, sparking, or severe corrosion, or a qualified person's low-voltage health result is outside the vehicle or battery maker's range; stop and obtain professional service.
localized_label.zh: 已确认的低压辅助/启动电池出现鼓包、泄漏、过热、打火或严重腐蚀，或合格人员取得的低压健康结果超出车型/电池制造商规定范围；停止并专业处置。

abnormal_observation.en: A confirmed low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery shows swelling, leakage, heat damage, sparking, or severe corrosion, or a qualified person's low-voltage health result is outside the vehicle or battery maker's range; stop and obtain professional service.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已确认的低压辅助/启动电池出现鼓包、泄漏、过热、打火或严重腐蚀，或合格人员取得的低压健康结果超出车型/电池制造商规定范围；停止并专业处置。

check_what.en: First confirm from instructions and visible labels that the component and test point belong to the low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery. A general user performs visual inspection only; testing is only by a qualified person with compatible equipment at a manual-defined low-voltage point. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when voltage identity is unclear, qualified personnel or compatible equipment is unavailable, or no valid result can be obtained.
check_what.zh: 先按手册和可见标签确认对象及测试点属于低压辅助/启动电池。普通用户只目视；仅由合格人员用兼容设备在手册指定低压点测试。低压/高压边界不明、缺少合格人员/兼容设备或无法取得有效结果时选择“无法确认”，不得把缺少结果记为异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Low-voltage auxiliary-battery condition and professional health data” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “低压辅助电池外观与专业健康数据”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery shows no visible swelling, leakage, heat damage, or severe corrosion, and a qualified person using compatible equipment at a manual-defined low-voltage point obtained a health result within the vehicle or battery maker's range; without that result, do not select normal and use unable to confirm.
normal_observation.zh: 低压辅助/启动电池无可见鼓包、泄漏、过热痕或严重腐蚀，且合格人员在手册指定低压点使用兼容设备得到的健康结果处于车型/电池制造商规定范围；缺少该结果时不选正常，改选无法确认。

en: shorting terminals, using improvised probes, or a general user disconnecting the battery
connecting to a traction battery, orange high-voltage cable, or unknown terminal
zh: 短接端子、使用临时探针或普通用户拆接电池
连接动力电池、橙色高压线束或未知端子

en: the battery, terminal, or test point cannot be confirmed as low voltage
the battery is swollen, leaking, hot, smoking, sparking, or severely corroded
the equipment is incompatible, requires disconnection, or a high-voltage warning appears
zh: 无法确认电池、端子或测试点属于低压系统
电池鼓包、泄漏、过热、冒烟、打火或严重腐蚀
设备不兼容、要求拆接电池或出现高压警告

warning.en: This item covers only the low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery. A general user records only safely visible corrosion, swelling, or leakage. Capacity or health testing is for a qualified person using compatible professional equipment at manual-defined low-voltage test points; never test a traction battery, orange high-voltage cable, or unknown terminal.
warning.zh: 该项目仅指低压辅助/启动电池。普通用户只记录可安全看到的腐蚀、鼓包或泄漏；容量/健康测试只能由合格人员在手册指定的低压测试点使用兼容专业设备。不得测试动力电池、橙色高压线束或未知端子。

en: First confirm from instructions and visible labels that the component and test point belong to the low-voltage auxiliary or starter battery. A general user performs visual inspection only; testing is only by a qualified person with compatible equipment at a manual-defined low-voltage point. Select unable to confirm, not abnormal, when voltage identity is unclear, qualified personnel or compatible equipment is unavailable, or no valid result can be obtained.
zh: 先按手册和可见标签确认对象及测试点属于低压辅助/启动电池。普通用户只目视；仅由合格人员用兼容设备在手册指定低压点测试。低压/高压边界不明、缺少合格人员/兼容设备或无法取得有效结果时选择“无法确认”，不得把缺少结果记为异常。

why_important.en: Fluids, low-voltage electrical systems, and under-vehicle clues vary by powertrain and model and must be identified from the instructions within no-disassembly, high-voltage, and hot-part boundaries.
why_important.zh: 位置因动力形式和车型而异的流体、低压电气与车底迹象必须按手册识别，并在不拆卸、不接触高压或高温部件的边界内检查。

title.en: Low-voltage auxiliary-battery condition and professional health data
title.zh: 低压辅助电池外观与专业健康数据

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A sinking or abnormally soft pedal, brake warning, leakage, inability to remain securely stationary, or professional standard-procedure result outside the vehicle specification requires an immediate stop and professional follow-up without a general-user emergency braking road test.
localized_label.zh: 踏板明显下沉或异常偏软、出现制动警告/泄漏、车辆不能可靠保持静止，或专业标准程序结果超出车型规定范围；立即停止并专业复检，普通用户不做紧急制动路试。

abnormal_observation.en: A sinking or abnormally soft pedal, brake warning, leakage, inability to remain securely stationary, or professional standard-procedure result outside the vehicle specification requires an immediate stop and professional follow-up without a general-user emergency braking road test.
abnormal_observation.zh: 踏板明显下沉或异常偏软、出现制动警告/泄漏、车辆不能可靠保持静止，或专业标准程序结果超出车型规定范围；立即停止并专业复检，普通用户不做紧急制动路试。

check_what.en: While parked, record brake warnings, visible leakage, and static pedal feedback. A general user must not perform an emergency stop or braking road test; dynamic performance belongs to a professional at a closed professional facility, otherwise mark unable to confirm/professional follow-up.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳时记录制动警告、可见泄漏和踏板静态反馈；普通用户不得执行紧急制动或制动力路试。动态制动力仅由专业人员在封闭专业场地验证，否则标记无法确认/需要专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Static brake-pedal condition and professional braking verification” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “制动踏板静态状态与专业制动力验证”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked there is no brake warning or visible leakage and static pedal feedback follows the instructions, and a professional using a standard procedure at a closed facility obtained dynamic braking results within the vehicle specification; without that professional result, do not select normal and use unable to confirm.
normal_observation.zh: 驻车时无制动警告或可见泄漏、踏板静态反馈与车辆手册一致，且专业人员在封闭专业场地按标准程序得到的动态制动力结果处于车型规定范围；缺少专业动态结果时不选正常，改选无法确认。

en: a general user actively performing an emergency stop or braking road test
limit braking on a public road or outside a professional facility
zh: 普通用户主动执行紧急制动或制动力路试
在公共道路或非专业场地测试极限制动

en: the pedal sinks, feels abnormally soft, or a brake warning appears
fluid leakage, abnormal noise, or inability to keep the vehicle stationary is found
anyone asks for an emergency stop or limit test on a road
zh: 踏板明显下沉、异常偏软或制动警告出现
发现液体泄漏、异响或车辆不能可靠保持静止
有人要求在道路上紧急制动或进行极限测试

warning.en: A general user may record only parked brake warnings, visible leakage, and static pedal feedback; do not perform an emergency stop or braking road test. Dynamic braking performance may be verified only by a professional using a standard procedure at a closed professional facility; otherwise mark unable to confirm/professional follow-up.
warning.zh: 普通用户只在车辆停稳时记录制动警告、可见泄漏和踏板静态反馈；不得进行紧急制动或制动力路试。动态制动力只可由专业人员在封闭专业场地按标准程序验证；无该条件时标记无法确认/需要专业复检。

en: While parked, record brake warnings, visible leakage, and static pedal feedback. A general user must not perform an emergency stop or braking road test; dynamic performance belongs to a professional at a closed professional facility, otherwise mark unable to confirm/professional follow-up.
zh: 车辆停稳时记录制动警告、可见泄漏和踏板静态反馈；普通用户不得执行紧急制动或制动力路试。动态制动力仅由专业人员在封闭专业场地验证，否则标记无法确认/需要专业复检。

why_important.en: Brake defects are direct safety risks and cannot be offset by unrelated normal findings.
why_important.zh: 制动缺陷是直接安全风险，不能由其他正常项目抵消。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Static brake-pedal condition and professional braking verification
title.zh: 制动踏板静态状态与专业制动力验证

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Repeatable squealing, metal-on-metal scraping, knocking, rubbing, or one-sided noise during ordinary braking is abnormal; do not reproduce it with hard braking.
localized_label.zh: 普通制动即出现可重复尖叫、磨铁声、敲击、摩擦或单侧异响；不以急刹复现，记录工况并专业检查。

abnormal_observation.en: Repeatable squealing, metal-on-metal scraping, knocking, rubbing, or one-sided noise during ordinary braking is abnormal; do not reproduce it with hard braking.
abnormal_observation.zh: 普通制动即出现可重复尖叫、磨铁声、敲击、摩擦或单侧异响；不以急刹复现，记录工况并专业检查。

check_what.en: Only during ordinary progressive braking on a normal trip, have a qualified driver and seated occupant record repeatable squealing, metal-on-metal scraping, knocking, or one-sided noise. Never reproduce it with hard or repeated braking or near a rotating wheel.
check_what.zh: 仅在正常行程中的普通渐进制动时由有资格驾驶员和乘员记录是否出现可重复尖叫、金属摩擦、敲击或单侧异响；不得用急刹、反复制动或靠近转动车轮复现。

detailed_explanation.en: “Brake noise” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.

en: Only during ordinary progressive braking on a normal trip, have a qualified driver and seated occupant record repeatable squealing, metal-on-metal scraping, knocking, or one-sided noise. Never reproduce it with hard or repeated braking or near a rotating wheel.

localized_label.zh: 普通渐进制动即出现明显或持续方向盘抖动、跑偏、制动警告或控制不稳；停止，不急刹、不松手，转封闭专业场地。

abnormal_observation.en: Material or sustained steering vibration, pull, a brake warning, or unstable control during ordinary progressive braking requires stopping and closed-facility follow-up without hard braking or releasing the wheel.
abnormal_observation.zh: 普通渐进制动即出现明显或持续方向盘抖动、跑偏、制动警告或控制不稳；停止，不急刹、不松手，转封闭专业场地。

check_what.en: Only a qualified driver may use ordinary progressive braking on a legal, open, low-speed controlled route while keeping both hands in control and recording abnormal steering vibration. Never hard-brake, release the wheel, or repeat the test in public traffic; use a closed professional facility when conditions are insufficient.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且受控的路段做普通渐进制动，双手保持控制并记录方向盘是否异常抖动；不得急刹、松手或在公共交通中反复测试，条件不足时转封闭专业场地。

detailed_explanation.en: “Steering-wheel vibration while braking” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “刹车时方向盘抖动检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During one ordinary progressive stop on a legal, open, low-speed controlled route, a qualified driver experiences a stable steering wheel without abnormal oscillation or sustained vibration.
normal_observation.zh: 有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速受控路段一次普通渐进制动时，方向盘保持稳定，无异常摆动或持续振动。

abnormal_observation.en: Visible rust, a purple heat spot, groove, or uneven wear is abnormal; do not touch or remove the wheel, and record it for professional assessment.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可见锈斑、紫色热斑、沟槽或偏磨；不触摸、不拆轮，记录位置并由专业人员判断影响和处置。

check_what.en: After parking and cooling the brakes, inspect visible rotor areas through the wheel for rust, heat spots, grooves, or uneven wear; refer wheel removal or measurement to a professional.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳并待制动部件冷却后，仅从轮辐可见区域观察锈斑、热斑、沟槽和偏磨；需要拆轮或测量时转专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Brake-disc rust, heat spots, or grooves” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “刹车盘锈斑、紫色热斑或细线沟槽检查”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After cooling, the rotor contact band visible through the wheel is reasonably even without concentrated rust, purple heat spots, deep grooves, or uneven wear.
normal_observation.zh: 制动部件冷却后，从轮辐可见的刹车盘接触带相对均匀，无明显锈蚀集中、紫色热斑、深沟槽或偏磨。

en: removing a wheel in an uncontrolled setting
touching a hot rotor or reaching into the caliper pinch area
zh: 在未受控环境自行拆轮
触碰热刹车盘或把手伸入卡钳夹伤区

en: brake parts remain hot
wheel removal or reaching into a pinch area would be required

warning.en: Secure the parked vehicle and let brake parts cool; inspect only through visible wheel openings or with an appropriate gauge, and refer any wheel removal to a professional.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮辐等可见位置观察或使用合适量具；需要拆轮时转专业复检。

localized_label.en: Within a scope safely visible or measurable without wheel removal, friction material is below 3 mm, unevenly worn, or damaged; do not mark that position normal and obtain professional action.
localized_label.zh: 在无需拆轮且可安全看见/测量的范围内，摩擦材料厚度低于3毫米、偏磨或破损；停止把该位置判为正常并专业处置。

localized_label.en: Friction-material thickness
localized_label.zh: 摩擦材料厚度

abnormal_observation.en: Within a scope safely visible or measurable without wheel removal, friction material is below 3 mm, unevenly worn, or damaged; do not mark that position normal and obtain professional action.
abnormal_observation.zh: 在无需拆轮且可安全看见/测量的范围内，摩擦材料厚度低于3毫米、偏磨或破损；停止把该位置判为正常并专业处置。

check_what.en: With the vehicle securely parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only from outside through the spokes or have a qualified person use an appropriate gauge where no wheel removal is needed. The source's about 10 mm new-pad figure is only a reference; apply the below 3 mm threshold and any stricter model or manufacturer limit. Select unable to confirm when safe viewing or measurement is impossible or wheel removal is required; select abnormal only for an actually visible or measured below-limit result, uneven wear, or damage.
check_what.zh: 车辆可靠停稳、车轮固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮辐外侧观察，或由合格人员在无需拆轮的安全位置使用合适量具。来源的新片约10mm仅为参考；以低于3mm及任何更严格车型/制造商限值判断。无法安全看见/测量或需要拆轮时选择“无法确认”；只有实际可见/测得低于限值、偏磨或破损才选异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Remaining brake-pad thickness” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “刹车片剩余厚度测量”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When cooled and safely visible or measurable without wheel removal, friction material is not below the source's 3 mm threshold and any stricter model limit has also been checked.
normal_observation.zh: 制动部件冷却且无需拆轮即可安全看见/测量时，摩擦材料未低于来源3毫米阈值，并已核对车型更严格限值。

abnormal_observation.en: Repeatable knock, clunk, rubbing noise, or abnormal residual body motion over minor unevenness is abnormal; never seek potholes, increase speed, or repeat impacts.
abnormal_observation.zh: 轻微起伏即反复出现敲击、咯噔、摩擦声或车身余振异常；不得主动找坑、加速或反复冲击，转专业复检。

check_what.en: During an ordinary trip only, a qualified driver may cross unavoidable minor unevenness at the legal low speed and listen for repeatable suspension noise. Never seek potholes, increase speed, or repeat impacts; use professional follow-up when it cannot be observed safely.
check_what.zh: 只在正常行程中由有资格驾驶员按合法低速通过不可避免的轻微起伏，监听悬挂是否有重复异响；不得主动寻找坑洞、提高速度或反复冲击，无法安全观察时转专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Suspension noise over mild unavoidable unevenness” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “正常行程轻微起伏时的悬挂异响”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During one unavoidable minor uneven section on an ordinary trip, the suspension has no repeatable knock, clunk, spring rub, or one-sided noise and the body settles promptly.
normal_observation.zh: 正常行程仅一次经过不可避免的轻微起伏时，悬挂无重复敲击、咯噔、弹簧摩擦或单侧异响，车身能及时稳定。

abnormal_observation.en: A material loose feel, several continuing oscillations, knock, or rubbing noise after one low-speed pass is abnormal; never accelerate into or repeatedly cross the hump.
abnormal_observation.zh: 一次低速通过即出现明显松散感、持续多次余振、敲击或摩擦声；不得加速冲击或为清单反复通过。

check_what.en: If a compliant speed hump occurs on the normal route, a qualified driver may cross it once at the posted low speed and record excess body motion, looseness, or noise. Do not accelerate into or repeatedly cross it for the checklist.
check_what.zh: 如正常路线存在合规减速带，由有资格驾驶员按标示低速一次通过，记录车身余振、松散感和异响；不得加速冲击或为清单反复通过。

detailed_explanation.en: “Loose vehicle feel over a speed bump” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “减速带通过时车辆“松散”感评估”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: If a compliant speed hump occurs on the normal route, one pass at the posted low speed is followed by prompt body settling without a material loose feel, continued oscillation, or noise.
normal_observation.zh: 正常路线若有合规减速带，以标示低速一次通过后车身及时稳定，无明显松散感、连续余振或异响。
