change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: An abrupt effort increase, binding, kickback, abnormal noise, or steering fault is abnormal; do not force or hold a mechanical stop and seek professional follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 转向阻力突然增大、卡顿、回弹、异响或故障提示；不强行顶到/保持机械止点，停止并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: An abrupt effort increase, binding, kickback, abnormal noise, or steering fault is abnormal; do not force or hold a mechanical stop and seek professional follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 转向阻力突然增大、卡顿、回弹、异响或故障提示；不强行顶到/保持机械止点，停止并专业复检。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked on level ground and tire areas clear, turn the steering slowly through the range permitted by the vehicle instructions and observe binding, abrupt resistance, or noise. Never force or hold it against a mechanical stop.
check_what.zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳并清空轮胎附近后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘至允许范围，观察卡顿、阻力突变或异响；不得强行顶到或持续保持机械止点。

detailed_explanation.en: “Steering noise or binding within the permitted parked range” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “驻车允许转向范围内的异响或卡顿”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked on level ground, slow steering within the manual-permitted range has continuous effort without binding, abrupt change, or abnormal noise and is not held against a stop.
normal_observation.zh: 水平地面驻车时，在手册允许转向范围内缓慢操作，方向盘阻力连续，无卡顿、突变或异常异响，且未顶住止点。

en: forcing or holding the steering against its stop
placing hands or feet near tires or steering linkages
performing limit steering while the vehicle is moving
zh: 强行打到或持续保持转向止点
把手脚伸入轮胎或转向机构附近
在车辆移动中做极限转向

en: the steering binds, makes severe noise, shows a warning, or changes resistance abruptly
the vehicle or a wheel moves unexpectedly
a person or obstacle enters a tire area
zh: 方向盘卡滞、剧烈异响、故障警告或阻力突变
车辆或车轮发生非预期移动
有人或障碍物进入轮胎附近

warning.en: Park on level ground and clear the surrounding and tire areas, then turn the steering slowly as permitted by the vehicle instructions. Observe smoothness and noise only within the permitted range; never force or hold the steering against a mechanical stop.
warning.zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳、周围和轮胎附近清空后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘；只在允许范围内观察顺滑性和异响，不强行顶到或持续保持机械止点。

en: With the vehicle parked on level ground and tire areas clear, turn the steering slowly through the range permitted by the vehicle instructions and observe binding, abrupt resistance, or noise. Never force or hold it against a mechanical stop.
zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳并清空轮胎附近后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘至允许范围，观察卡顿、阻力突变或异响；不得强行顶到或持续保持机械止点。

why_important.en: Suspension and steering faults affect control, tire wear, and emergency maneuvering.
why_important.zh: 悬挂与转向异常会影响车辆控制、轮胎磨损和紧急避让能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Steering noise or binding within the permitted parked range
title.zh: 驻车允许转向范围内的异响或卡顿

change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent one-sided pull or abnormal steering-center position after accounting for wind, crown, and obvious pressure differences requires professional alignment, tire, or suspension review without releasing the wheel.
localized_label.zh: 在排除横风、路拱和明显胎压差后仍持续偏向一侧，或方向盘居中异常；不得松手或诱导偏航，专业检查定位/轮胎/悬挂。

abnormal_observation.en: Persistent one-sided pull or abnormal steering-center position after accounting for wind, crown, and obvious pressure differences requires professional alignment, tire, or suspension review without releasing the wheel.
abnormal_observation.zh: 在排除横风、路拱和明显胎压差后仍持续偏向一侧，或方向盘居中异常；不得松手或诱导偏航，专业检查定位/轮胎/悬挂。

check_what.en: Only a qualified driver on a legal, straight, low-risk road may observe persistent pull while maintaining two-hand control at a normal low speed. Never release the steering or induce a swerve; first account for crosswind, road crown, and tire pressure.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、平直、低风险路段以正常低速保持双手控制，观察车辆是否持续偏向一侧；不得松开方向盘或用偏航动作验证，先排除横风、路拱和胎压影响。

detailed_explanation.en: “Vehicle pull or alignment symptoms while driving” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “行驶途中检查四轮定位是否有跑偏”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: With a qualified driver maintaining two-hand control on a legal straight low-risk road, the vehicle follows the intended path without persistent one-sided pull after accounting for crosswind, road crown, and tire pressure.
normal_observation.zh: 有资格驾驶员在合法平直低风险路段双手控车时，车辆保持预期轨迹，无持续向一侧偏移；已考虑横风、路拱和胎压。

en: emergency or limit maneuvers in public traffic
testing beyond the driver's competence
zh: 在公共交通中进行紧急或极限动作
超出驾驶员能力测试

en: a qualified driver, legal low-risk route, or seller permission is unavailable
traffic, road, or vehicle conditions are unsafe
zh: 没有合格驾驶员、合法低风险路段或卖家同意
交通、路面或车辆状态不安全

warning.en: Only a qualified driver may test in a legal, open, low-speed setting with permission; stop for unsafe traffic, road, or vehicle conditions.
warning.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且卖家同意的环境测试；交通、路面或车辆状态不安全时立即停止。

en: Only a qualified driver on a legal, straight, low-risk road may observe persistent pull while maintaining two-hand control at a normal low speed. Never release the steering or induce a swerve; first account for crosswind, road crown, and tire pressure.
zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、平直、低风险路段以正常低速保持双手控制，观察车辆是否持续偏向一侧；不得松开方向盘或用偏航动作验证，先排除横风、路拱和胎压影响。

why_important.en: Suspension and steering faults affect control, tire wear, and emergency maneuvering.
why_important.zh: 悬挂与转向异常会影响车辆控制、轮胎磨损和紧急避让能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Vehicle pull or alignment symptoms while driving
title.zh: 行驶途中检查四轮定位是否有跑偏

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Continued vertical oscillation, severe vibration, noise, pull, a brake warning, or unstable control after ordinary progressive braking requires stopping and closed-facility follow-up.
localized_label.zh: 普通渐进制动后仍持续上下振荡，或出现剧烈抖动、异响、跑偏、制动警告/控制不稳；停止并转封闭专业场地。

abnormal_observation.en: Continued vertical oscillation, severe vibration, noise, pull, a brake warning, or unstable control after ordinary progressive braking requires stopping and closed-facility follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 普通渐进制动后仍持续上下振荡，或出现剧烈抖动、异响、跑偏、制动警告/控制不稳；停止并转封闭专业场地。

check_what.en: Only a qualified driver may perform one ordinary progressive stop in a legal, open, low-speed controlled setting while maintaining full control and recording abnormal sustained body pitch. Never hard-brake or perform a limit test; use a closed professional facility when conditions are insufficient or stronger verification is required.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且受控的环境做一次普通渐进制动并保持完整车辆控制，记录车身是否出现异常持续俯仰；不得急刹或做极限测试，条件不足或需要更强制动验证时转封闭专业场地。

detailed_explanation.en: “Body pitch during ordinary progressive braking” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “普通渐进制动时的车身俯仰观察”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After one ordinary progressive stop, body pitch settles promptly without sustained up-and-down oscillation, a brake warning, strong pull, or unstable control.
normal_observation.zh: 一次普通渐进制动后，车身俯仰及时收敛，无持续上下振荡、制动警告、明显跑偏或控制不稳。

en: hard, emergency, or limit braking
repeating the test in public traffic or releasing the steering
placing an obstacle, increasing speed, or exceeding driver competence
zh: 急刹、紧急制动或极限制动
在公共交通中反复测试或松开方向盘
设置障碍物、提高车速或超出驾驶员能力

en: traffic, road, weather, or vehicle condition is unsuitable
a brake warning, strong pull, severe oscillation, noise, or loss of control appears
observation would require hard braking, releasing control, repeated impacts, or exceeding driver competence
zh: 交通、路面、天气或车辆状态不适合
出现制动警告、明显跑偏、剧烈抖动、异响或控制不稳
观察需要急刹、松手、重复冲击或超出驾驶员能力

warning.en: A general user may have only a qualified driver perform one ordinary progressive stop in a legal, open, low-speed controlled setting while maintaining full control. Never hard-brake or perform a limit test; stronger verification belongs at a closed professional facility.
warning.zh: 普通用户仅可由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且受控的环境做一次普通渐进制动并保持完整车辆控制；不得急刹或做极限测试，需要更强制动验证时转封闭专业场地。

en: Only a qualified driver may perform one ordinary progressive stop in a legal, open, low-speed controlled setting while maintaining full control and recording abnormal sustained body pitch. Never hard-brake or perform a limit test; use a closed professional facility when conditions are insufficient or stronger verification is required.
zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且受控的环境做一次普通渐进制动并保持完整车辆控制，记录车身是否出现异常持续俯仰；不得急刹或做极限测试，条件不足或需要更强制动验证时转封闭专业场地。

why_important.en: Suspension and steering faults affect control, tire wear, and emergency maneuvering.
why_important.zh: 悬挂与转向异常会影响车辆控制、轮胎磨损和紧急避让能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Body pitch during ordinary progressive braking
title.zh: 普通渐进制动时的车身俯仰观察

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit finds out-of-limit play, a torn boot, leakage, noise, or displacement; act on the professional finding and never allow a general user beneath the vehicle.
localized_label.zh: 合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内发现超限松旷、防尘套破裂、渗漏、异响或位移；应按专业结论处理，普通用户不得进入车下。

abnormal_observation.en: A qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit finds out-of-limit play, a torn boot, leakage, noise, or displacement; act on the professional finding and never allow a general user beneath the vehicle.
abnormal_observation.zh: 合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内发现超限松旷、防尘套破裂、渗漏、异响或位移；应按专业结论处理，普通用户不得进入车下。

check_what.en: This item accepts only a located record produced by a qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit. Select unable to confirm when qualified personnel, an approved lift or pit, or the record is unavailable; a general user must not substitute a jack, go beneath the vehicle, or pry components.
check_what.zh: 该项目只接受合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内形成的带位置记录。缺少合格人员、合格举升/检查坑或该记录时选择“无法确认”；普通用户不得用千斤顶替代、进入车下或自行撬动部件。

detailed_explanation.en: “Lifted inspection of ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “升起检查球头、连杆、顶胶、轴承老化情况”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: A qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit records no out-of-limit play, cracking, leakage, or displacement at ball joints, links, mounts, bearings, or boots.
normal_observation.zh: 合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑完成检查并记录：球头、连杆、顶胶、轴承和防尘套无超限间隙、裂损、渗漏或位移。

en: entering beneath a jack-supported vehicle
zh: 仅靠千斤顶支撑进入车底

en: qualified personnel and a certified lift or controlled inspection pit are unavailable
the vehicle is supported only by a jack
zh: 缺少合格人员、认证举升机或受控检查坑
车辆仅由千斤顶支撑

warning.en: This is a professional lift inspection; never enter beneath a vehicle supported only by a jack.
warning.zh: 该项目归为专业举升检查；不得仅靠千斤顶支撑进入车下。

en: This item accepts only a located record produced by a qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit. Select unable to confirm when qualified personnel, an approved lift or pit, or the record is unavailable; a general user must not substitute a jack, go beneath the vehicle, or pry components.
zh: 该项目只接受合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内形成的带位置记录。缺少合格人员、合格举升/检查坑或该记录时选择“无法确认”；普通用户不得用千斤顶替代、进入车下或自行撬动部件。

title.en: Lifted inspection of ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings
title.zh: 升起检查球头、连杆、顶胶、轴承老化情况

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: After a confirmed compatible and working tool establishes a connection, a current or pending code, conflicting mileage field, model-reference cold-data deviation, or new vehicle warning during reading requires saving raw values for professional interpretation.
localized_label.zh: 已确认兼容且正常工作的设备完成连接后，存在当前/待定故障码、里程字段矛盾、冷车数据超出车型参考，或读取过程触发车辆新警告；保存原值并由专业人员解释。

abnormal_observation.en: After a confirmed compatible and working tool establishes a connection, a current or pending code, conflicting mileage field, model-reference cold-data deviation, or new vehicle warning during reading requires saving raw values for professional interpretation.
abnormal_observation.zh: 已确认兼容且正常工作的设备完成连接后，存在当前/待定故障码、里程字段矛盾、冷车数据超出车型参考，或读取过程触发车辆新警告；保存原值并由专业人员解释。

check_what.en: Use a confirmed compatible and working OBD tool in the manual-permitted port and vehicle state to save available codes, mileage fields, and raw cold data read-only; never clear codes, code the vehicle, or treat automated interpretation as diagnosis. Select unable to confirm when tool compatibility or operation is uncertain or a stable connection cannot be established; select abnormal only for actual abnormal data after connection.
check_what.zh: 使用已确认兼容且正常工作的 OBD 设备，在车辆手册允许的接口和状态下只读保存可用故障码、里程字段和冷车原始数据；不清码、不编码、不把自动解释当诊断。无法确认设备兼容/工作状态，或无法建立稳定连接时选择“无法确认”；连接后出现实际异常数据才选异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “OBD codes, transmission mileage, and available cold live data” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “OBD故障码、变速箱里程及可用冷车数据读取”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: A compatible OBD tool connects and saves available module codes, mileage-related fields, and raw cold live data without creating a new fault, with interpretation explicitly labeled non-diagnostic.
normal_observation.zh: 兼容 OBD 设备能完成连接并保存可用模块故障码、里程相关字段和冷车数据原值，读取过程无新增故障，解释明确标为非诊断。

en: clearing trouble codes or readiness data
coding, flashing, or bidirectional control
zh: 清除故障码或就绪状态
编码、刷写或执行双向控制

en: the scanner or port overheats
a new warning appears or safe ignition state cannot be maintained
the tool requests writing or clearing data
zh: 扫描仪或接口异常发热
车辆出现新的警告或无法保持安全点火状态
工具要求写入或清除数据

warning.en: Use read-only diagnostics and follow vehicle/scanner instructions for ignition state. Do not clear codes, reset readiness, code, or write to a control module.
warning.zh: 仅执行只读诊断；按车辆和扫描仪说明设置点火状态。不得清码、重置就绪状态、编码或写入控制模块。

en: Use a confirmed compatible and working OBD tool in the manual-permitted port and vehicle state to save available codes, mileage fields, and raw cold data read-only; never clear codes, code the vehicle, or treat automated interpretation as diagnosis. Select unable to confirm when tool compatibility or operation is uncertain or a stable connection cannot be established; select abnormal only for actual abnormal data after connection.
zh: 使用已确认兼容且正常工作的 OBD 设备，在车辆手册允许的接口和状态下只读保存可用故障码、里程字段和冷车原始数据；不清码、不编码、不把自动解释当诊断。无法确认设备兼容/工作状态，或无法建立稳定连接时选择“无法确认”；连接后出现实际异常数据才选异常。

why_important.en: Appropriate tools can add code, structural, or surface evidence that visual inspection alone cannot confirm.
why_important.zh: 合适工具可补充肉眼无法确认的故障码、结构或表面证据。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: OBD codes, transmission mileage, and available cold live data
title.zh: OBD故障码、变速箱里程及可用冷车数据读取

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A panel-wide high cluster, edge discontinuity, non-repeatable difference, or a roof unsuitable as a baseline because of material or repair history is a repair clue only.
localized_label.zh: 某覆盖件出现成片高值、边缘跳变、不可重复差异，或车顶材质/维修历史不适合作基准；只记录修复线索。

localized_label.en: Coating thickness
localized_label.zh: 涂层厚度

abnormal_observation.en: A panel-wide high cluster, edge discontinuity, non-repeatable difference, or a roof unsuitable as a baseline because of material or repair history is a repair clue only.
abnormal_observation.zh: 某覆盖件出现成片高值、边缘跳变、不可重复差异，或车顶材质/维修历史不适合作基准；只记录修复线索。

check_what.en: Confirm gauge and panel compatibility and calibrate it, then take perpendicular multi-point grid readings across same-material metal panels and repeat outliers. Use the roof only when material and repair history support it, and never climb on the vehicle.
check_what.zh: 确认漆膜仪和面板材质兼容并完成校准，在全车同材质金属覆盖件按固定网格多点垂直测量并复测异常点；车顶只有在材质和维修记录支持时才作比较参考，禁止攀爬车身。

detailed_explanation.en: “Full-body paint-gauge scan” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “漆膜仪全车金属面扫描”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Multi-point readings across same-material metal panels are continuous and repeatable, and the roof is used as a reference only when material and records support it.
normal_observation.zh: 全车同材质金属面多点读数分布连续、复测稳定，车顶仅在材质和记录支持时作为参考基准。

en: climbing the vehicle, standing on a sill or seat, or overreaching
forcing a reading with an uncalibrated or incompatible gauge
comparing across materials or assuming the roof is an original-paint baseline without evidence
zh: 攀爬车身、站上门槛/座椅或过度伸展
用未校准或不兼容量具强行取值
跨材质或无依据地把车顶当原漆基准

en: gauge compatibility or calibration, panel material, or reference justification cannot be confirmed
a point would require climbing, overreaching, or standing on the vehicle
a surface is wet, hot, moving, or a reading cannot be repeated reliably
zh: 量具兼容性/校准状态、面板材质或参考依据无法确认
测点需要攀爬、过度伸展或站上车辆
表面潮湿、高温、运动或读数无法可靠复测

warning.en: First confirm that the paint gauge is compatible with the target material and calibrated, and use only a same-material reference justified by material and repair records. Every point must be safely reachable from the ground; never climb, stand on a sill or seat, or overreach.
warning.zh: 先确认漆膜仪与待测材质兼容并完成校准，只把有材质和维修记录依据的同材质面作为参考；所有测点必须从地面安全可达，不得攀爬、站上门槛/座椅或过度伸展。

en: Confirm gauge and panel compatibility and calibrate it, then take perpendicular multi-point grid readings across same-material metal panels and repeat outliers. Use the roof only when material and repair history support it, and never climb on the vehicle.
zh: 确认漆膜仪和面板材质兼容并完成校准，在全车同材质金属覆盖件按固定网格多点垂直测量并复测异常点；车顶只有在材质和维修记录支持时才作比较参考，禁止攀爬车身。

why_important.en: Appropriate tools can add code, structural, or surface evidence that visual inspection alone cannot confirm.
why_important.zh: 合适工具可补充肉眼无法确认的故障码、结构或表面证据。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 漆膜仪全车金属面扫描

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Only location-linked structural repair records, visible non-original joining clues, stretching or misalignment; hidden or unconfirmed suspicion remains unknown for professional reinspection.
localized_label.zh: 只记录本部位结构维修资料、可见切焊/非原厂连接线索、褶皱拉伸或错位；不可见或疑似而未证实时为未知，并专业复检。

abnormal_observation.en: An available record shows structural repair, or cutting, a non-factory weld or sealer, a stretched crush area, or displacement is found within the safely visible scope; obtain professional structural inspection.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可用记录显示结构维修，或从安全可见范围发现切焊、非原厂焊点/密封胶、褶皱拉伸或错位；按线索转专业结构检测。

check_what.en: First review collision and structural-repair records, then compare left/right structural references, welds, seam sealer, crush areas, and rail ends only where safely visible from the vehicle edge or above. Never go beneath, measure, or pry; mark hidden areas or anything requiring lifting or measurement unable to confirm. Classify actual visible cutting, stretching, displacement, or a repair record as abnormal and obtain professional structural inspection.
check_what.zh: 先核对事故和结构维修记录，再从车辆外缘及上方安全可见位置比较左右结构基准、焊点、密封胶、褶皱和纵梁端部；不得进入车下或自行测量/撬动，不可见或疑似切焊、拉伸、错位时标记无法确认并专业结构检测。

detailed_explanation.en: “Structural accident inspection” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “事故排查：一体件受损或大梁受损”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Collision and repair records align with safely visible structural references, and visible rail ends, welds, seam sealer, and crush areas show no cutting, stretching, displacement, or non-factory repair clue.
normal_observation.zh: 事故/维修记录与安全可见的结构基准相互一致；可见纵梁端部、焊点、密封胶和褶皱区未见切焊、拉伸、错位或非原厂修复线索。

en: going beneath the vehicle
inspecting after jack-only lifting
prying, measuring, or scraping structural coating
zh: 身体进入车下
用千斤顶举升后检查
自行撬动、测量或刮除结构涂层

en: a cutting, stretching, displacement, or non-factory weld or sealer clue is found
critical structure is concealed or would require lifting or measurement
the ground, vehicle, or viewing position is unstable
zh: 发现切焊、拉伸、错位或非原厂焊点/密封胶线索
关键结构被遮挡或需要举升/测量
地面、车辆或观察位置不稳定

warning.en: A general user may review only collision or structural-repair records and welds, seam sealer, crush areas, or rail ends safely visible from the vehicle edge or above. Never go beneath, lift, measure, pry, or scrape coating.
warning.zh: 普通用户只核对事故/结构维修记录和从车辆外缘或上方安全可见的焊点、密封胶、褶皱及纵梁端部；不得进入车下、自行举升、测量、撬动或刮除涂层。

en: First review collision and structural-repair records, then compare left/right structural references, welds, seam sealer, crush areas, and rail ends only where safely visible from the vehicle edge or above. Never go beneath, measure, or pry; mark hidden areas or anything requiring lifting or measurement unable to confirm. Classify actual visible cutting, stretching, displacement, or a repair record as abnormal and obtain professional structural inspection.
zh: 先核对事故和结构维修记录，再从车辆外缘及上方安全可见位置比较左右结构基准、焊点、密封胶、褶皱和纵梁端部；不得进入车下或自行测量/撬动，不可见或疑似切焊、拉伸、错位时标记无法确认并专业结构检测。

why_important.en: Exterior differences can indicate repairs, collision damage, corrosion, or fit issues and guide professional follow-up.
why_important.zh: 外观差异可能提示维修、事故、腐蚀或装配问题，并影响后续专业复检重点。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 事故排查：一体件受损或大梁受损

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Weather-seal damage, deterioration or displacement
localized_label.zh: 密封条破损、老化或脱位

localized_label.en: Visible waterline, dampness or related deposit
localized_label.zh: 可见水线、潮湿或相关沉积迹象

abnormal_observation.en: A hardened, cracked, gapped, or displaced seal, or nearby water marks, mold, dampness, or flood clue is abnormal and requires controlled professional water-ingress follow-up.
abnormal_observation.zh: 密封条老化发硬、开裂、缺口、脱位，或周边出现水迹、霉斑、潮湿/水泡线索；记录并专业做受控淋水复检。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked and closures stationary, inspect door and fitted sunroof seals for continuity, flexibility, cracks, flattening, and displacement, then check adjacent carpet or headliner for water lines, dampness, or mold. Do not create leakage with uncontrolled water testing.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳且开合件静止时，沿车门和如配备的天窗密封条观察连续性、柔韧性、裂口、压扁和脱位，再查看相邻地毯/顶棚是否有水线、潮湿或霉斑；不以无控制淋水制造渗漏。

detailed_explanation.en: “Door and sunroof weather-seal aging or cracking” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车门、天窗密封条老化或开裂”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Door and fitted sunroof seals are continuous, flexible, and seated without cracking, gaps, flattening, or displacement, and adjacent areas have no water line, mold, or dampness.
normal_observation.zh: 车门和如配备的天窗密封条连续柔韧、固定到位，无裂纹、缺口、压扁脱位；周边无水线、霉斑或潮湿。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: With the vehicle parked and closures stationary, inspect door and fitted sunroof seals for continuity, flexibility, cracks, flattening, and displacement, then check adjacent carpet or headliner for water lines, dampness, or mold. Do not create leakage with uncontrolled water testing.
zh: 车辆停稳且开合件静止时，沿车门和如配备的天窗密封条观察连续性、柔韧性、裂口、压扁和脱位，再查看相邻地毯/顶棚是否有水线、潮湿或霉斑；不以无控制淋水制造渗漏。

why_important.en: Seal and fuel-system problems can cause water ingress, corrosion, odor, fire, or environmental hazards.
why_important.zh: 密封和燃油异常可能造成进水、腐蚀、异味、起火或环境风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Door and sunroof weather-seal aging or cracking
title.zh: 车门、天窗密封条老化或开裂

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Underbody protective-coating damage
localized_label.zh: 底盘防护涂层破损

localized_label.en: Only layered corrosion or impact damage of load-bearing material at this underbody location; coating cracks, exposure and trapped water belong to the coating task.
localized_label.zh: 仅记录本车底部位起层锈蚀或撞击造成的承载材料破损；涂层开裂、露底和水分夹层由涂层任务记录。

abnormal_observation.en: Large coating cracks or delamination, exposed substrate, scaling rust, impact damage, or a visible trapped-moisture layer requires professional lift inspection without going beneath the vehicle.
abnormal_observation.zh: 护甲大片开裂/剥落、露底、起层锈蚀、撞击破损或可见水分夹层；不得进入车下，转专业举升检查。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect only visible underbody areas from the vehicle edge using a flashlight, phone, or mirror; never place any body part beneath the vehicle.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后，只从车身边缘用手电筒、手机或镜子观察可见底盘；身体任何部位不得进入车辆下方。

detailed_explanation.en: “Underbody protective coating corrosion or damage” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “底盘护甲锈蚀或破损”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Underbody coating visible from the vehicle edge remains continuously adhered without large delamination, through-damage, scaling corrosion, or fresh scrape exposing substrate.
normal_observation.zh: 从车身外缘可见的底盘护甲/涂层连续附着，无大片剥落、穿透破损、起层锈蚀或新鲜刮碰露底。

en: placing the body beneath the vehicle
relying on uncertified or unstable support
zh: 身体进入车辆下方
依赖未认证或不稳定支撑

en: a clear view would require placing the head, arm, or body beneath the vehicle
the ground, lighting, or parked vehicle is unstable
a loose panel, active drip, or another unknown hazard is found
zh: 必须把头、手臂或身体伸入车辆下方才能看清
地面、光线或车辆停放不稳定
发现松动护板、滴漏或其他不明危险

warning.en: Observe only from the vehicle edge using a flashlight, phone, or mirror; no part of the body may go beneath the vehicle.
warning.zh: 只能从车身边缘用手电筒、手机或镜子观察；身体不得进入车辆下方。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect only visible underbody areas from the vehicle edge using a flashlight, phone, or mirror; never place any body part beneath the vehicle.
zh: 车辆停稳后，只从车身边缘用手电筒、手机或镜子观察可见底盘；身体任何部位不得进入车辆下方。

why_important.en: Seal and fuel-system problems can cause water ingress, corrosion, odor, fire, or environmental hazards.
why_important.zh: 密封和燃油异常可能造成进水、腐蚀、异味、起火或环境风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Underbody protective coating corrosion or damage
title.zh: 底盘护甲锈蚀或破损

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A damaged door or seal, failed latch, visible wet trace, or vehicle warning is abnormal; stop for fuel odor noticed passively and never approach, sniff, or locate a leak by smell.
localized_label.zh: 盖板/密封圈破损、锁止失败、周围可见湿痕或车辆提示异常；被动察觉明显燃油味时立即停止，严禁靠近嗅闻或靠气味定位。

abnormal_observation.en: A damaged door or seal, failed latch, visible wet trace, or vehicle warning is abnormal; stop for fuel odor noticed passively and never approach, sniff, or locate a leak by smell.
abnormal_observation.zh: 盖板/密封圈破损、锁止失败、周围可见湿痕或车辆提示异常；被动察觉明显燃油味时立即停止，严禁靠近嗅闻或靠气味定位。

check_what.en: With the engine off, ventilation provided, and sparks and flame absent, visually inspect only the fuel door, hinge, latch, visible seal, nearby wet traces, and vehicle messages. Never approach or sniff to locate a leak; stop and leave for fuel odor noticed passively.
check_what.zh: 熄火、通风并远离火花和明火时，只目视油箱盖、铰链、锁止和可见密封圈，检查周围湿痕及车辆提示；严禁靠近嗅闻或用气味定位，被动察觉明显燃油味即停止并离开。

detailed_explanation.en: “Fuel-cap sealing” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “油箱盖密封性”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The fuel door, hinge, and visible seal are intact and clean, latch as instructed, and show no fresh wet trace or vehicle fuel-cap warning.
normal_observation.zh: 油箱盖、铰链和可见密封圈完整、清洁并能按手册可靠锁止，周围无新鲜湿痕或车辆燃油盖提示。

en: disconnecting fuel lines
creating sparks or flame near fuel
approaching to sniff or locating a leak by odor
zh: 拆卸燃油管路
在燃油附近制造火花或明火
靠近直接嗅闻或用气味定位泄漏

en: strong fuel odor, wetness, or drips appear
a fuel line would need opening or moving
an ignition source is present or ventilation is inadequate
zh: 出现明显燃油味、湿痕或滴漏
需要开启或移动燃油管路
现场存在点火源或通风不足

warning.en: Shut the engine down, ventilate, and keep away from sparks, flames, and smoking; observe visible areas only, never open or disconnect fuel lines, and never approach or sniff to locate a leak.
warning.zh: 发动机熄火并保持通风，远离火花、明火和吸烟；只观察可见区域，不开启或拆卸燃油管路，也不得靠近嗅闻或用气味定位。

en: With the engine off, ventilation provided, and sparks and flame absent, visually inspect only the fuel door, hinge, latch, visible seal, nearby wet traces, and vehicle messages. Never approach or sniff to locate a leak; stop and leave for fuel odor noticed passively.
zh: 熄火、通风并远离火花和明火时，只目视油箱盖、铰链、锁止和可见密封圈，检查周围湿痕及车辆提示；严禁靠近嗅闻或用气味定位，被动察觉明显燃油味即停止并离开。

why_important.en: Seal and fuel-system problems can cause water ingress, corrosion, odor, fire, or environmental hazards.
why_important.zh: 密封和燃油异常可能造成进水、腐蚀、异味、起火或环境风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 油箱盖密封性

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Visible cracking, wetness, staining, dripping, a loose retainer, or fuel odor noticed passively is abnormal; do not touch, disconnect, or sniff, and leave for professional action.
localized_label.zh: 可见龟裂、潮湿、污迹、滴漏、管卡松脱，或被动察觉燃油味；不触摸、不拆接、不嗅闻，离开并专业处置。

abnormal_observation.en: Visible cracking, wetness, staining, dripping, a loose retainer, or fuel odor noticed passively is abnormal; do not touch, disconnect, or sniff, and leave for professional action.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可见龟裂、潮湿、污迹、滴漏、管卡松脱，或被动察觉燃油味；不触摸、不拆接、不嗅闻，离开并专业处置。

check_what.en: Shut the engine down, ventilate, and keep away from sparks, flame, and smoking. From a safe visible position only, inspect fuel-line surfaces for cracking, wetness, staining, or drips; do not touch, disconnect, or locate a leak by smell.
check_what.zh: 发动机熄火并保持通风，远离火花、明火和吸烟；只从安全可见位置观察燃油管路外表的龟裂、潮湿、污迹或滴漏，不触摸、不拆接，也不靠气味定位泄漏。

detailed_explanation.en: “Fuel-line aging or leakage evidence” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “燃油管路老化或渗漏痕迹”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: With the engine off, ventilation provided, and ignition sources absent, fuel-line surfaces visible from a safe position are intact, secure, and dry without cracking, staining, or dripping.
normal_observation.zh: 熄火通风且远离火源时，从安全位置可见的燃油管路外表完整、固定可靠、周围干燥，无龟裂、污迹或滴漏。

en: disconnecting fuel lines
creating sparks or flame near fuel
approaching to sniff or locating a leak by odor
zh: 拆卸燃油管路
在燃油附近制造火花或明火
靠近直接嗅闻或用气味定位泄漏

en: strong fuel odor, wetness, or drips appear
a fuel line would need opening or moving
an ignition source is present or ventilation is inadequate
zh: 出现明显燃油味、湿痕或滴漏
需要开启或移动燃油管路
现场存在点火源或通风不足

warning.en: Shut the engine down, ventilate, and keep away from sparks, flames, and smoking; observe visible areas only, never open or disconnect fuel lines, and never approach or sniff to locate a leak.
warning.zh: 发动机熄火并保持通风，远离火花、明火和吸烟；只观察可见区域，不开启或拆卸燃油管路，也不得靠近嗅闻或用气味定位。

en: Shut the engine down, ventilate, and keep away from sparks, flame, and smoking. From a safe visible position only, inspect fuel-line surfaces for cracking, wetness, staining, or drips; do not touch, disconnect, or locate a leak by smell.
zh: 发动机熄火并保持通风，远离火花、明火和吸烟；只从安全可见位置观察燃油管路外表的龟裂、潮湿、污迹或滴漏，不触摸、不拆接，也不靠气味定位泄漏。

why_important.en: Seal and fuel-system problems can cause water ingress, corrosion, odor, fire, or environmental hazards.
why_important.zh: 密封和燃油异常可能造成进水、腐蚀、异味、起火或环境风险。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 燃油管路老化或渗漏痕迹

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Explicit ABS/ESP fault or unavailability
localized_label.zh: ABS/ESP明确故障或不可用

localized_label.en: Explicit ADAS fault, unavailability or incomplete calibration
localized_label.zh: ADAS明确故障、不可用或校准未完成

abnormal_observation.en: A fault lamp or explicit unavailable message appears, or an available record shows an unresolved related fault; obtain professional closed-facility follow-up without triggering AEB, ABS, stability control, or an emergency scenario.
abnormal_observation.zh: 出现故障灯或明确不可用提示，或可用记录显示相关故障尚未处理；不得触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急场景，转专业封闭场地。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, review only warning self-tests, settings, explicit availability messages, and available service or diagnostic records. A general user must not trigger AEB, ABS, stability control, or an emergency scenario. Select unable to confirm when self-test conditions, status meaning, or records cannot be established, and select abnormal only for explicit fault evidence.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后只核对安全系统警告灯自检、设置、明确可用性提示及可用维修/诊断记录；普通用户不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。自检条件、状态含义或记录无法确认时选择“无法确认”，仅在发现明确故障证据时选择“异常”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Stationary safety-system status and records review” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “安全系统静态状态与记录核对”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked, safety-system warning self-tests, settings, and availability messages are normal and available records show no unresolved related fault; intervention was not actively tested.
normal_observation.zh: 驻车时安全系统警告自检、设置和可用性提示正常，可用维修/诊断记录无未处理的相关故障；未主动测试介入。

en: intentionally triggering AEB, ABS, stability control, or emergency braking
using a person, vehicle, or object as an activation target
verifying safety-system intervention on a public road
zh: 主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或紧急制动
放置人员、车辆或物体作为触发目标
在公共道路验证安全系统介入

en: a fault warning, unavailable message, or unclear status appears during stationary review
verification would require moving the vehicle, placing an obstacle, or inducing a skid or emergency stop
model instructions, authorized records, or a professional facility are unavailable
zh: 静态自检出现故障灯、不可用提示或状态不明
验证需要移动车辆、设置障碍物或制造打滑/紧急制动
缺少车型手册、授权记录或专业场地

warning.en: A general user may review only parked warning self-tests, settings, availability messages, and service or diagnostic records. Do not intentionally trigger AEB, ABS, or stability control or create an emergency. Dynamic verification is for qualified professionals following manufacturer procedures at a closed professional facility and is not instructed here.
warning.zh: 普通用户只核对驻车状态下的警告灯自检、设置、可用性提示及维修/诊断记录；不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。动态功能只能由专业人员在封闭专业场地按制造商程序验证，本清单不指导执行。

en: With the vehicle parked, review only warning self-tests, settings, explicit availability messages, and available service or diagnostic records. A general user must not trigger AEB, ABS, stability control, or an emergency scenario. Select unable to confirm when self-test conditions, status meaning, or records cannot be established, and select abnormal only for explicit fault evidence.
zh: 车辆停稳后只核对安全系统警告灯自检、设置、明确可用性提示及可用维修/诊断记录；普通用户不得主动触发 AEB、ABS、ESP 或制造紧急事件。自检条件、状态含义或记录无法确认时选择“无法确认”，仅在发现明确故障证据时选择“异常”。

why_important.en: Interior control and safety-device faults may reveal electrical, restraint-system, or equipment problems.
why_important.zh: 车内控制与安全设备异常可能反映电气、约束系统或配置功能故障。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Stationary safety-system status and records review
title.zh: 安全系统静态状态与记录核对

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A pink crystalline ring, damp center, or downward trace around the joint is only a possible leakage clue; do not touch or clean it or diagnose a leak source from color.
localized_label.zh: 接头周围有粉色结晶环、潮湿中心或向下流痕；仅记为可能渗漏线索，不触摸/清洗残留，也不直接诊断漏点。

abnormal_observation.en: A pink crystalline ring, damp center, or downward trace around the joint is only a possible leakage clue; do not touch or clean it or diagnose a leak source from color.
abnormal_observation.zh: 接头周围有粉色结晶环、潮湿中心或向下流痕；仅记为可能渗漏线索，不触摸/清洗残留，也不直接诊断漏点。

check_what.en: After powertrain shutdown and natural cooling of the related circuit, inspect one visible coolant joint from a safe position for a pink crystalline ring, damp center, or downward trace and photograph it first. Never touch, taste, clean, or disconnect it or diagnose the leak source from color.
check_what.zh: 动力系统关闭并让相关冷却回路自然冷却后，从安全位置查看一个可见冷却接头周围是否有粉色结晶环、湿润中心或向下流痕，并先拍照记录；不得触摸、品尝、擦洗或拆接，也不凭颜色确定漏点。

detailed_explanation.en: “Pink residue around coolant hoses” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “冷却管周边粉色粉末”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After shutdown and cooling, the visible coolant joint is dry and ordinary dust is uniform without a pink crystalline edge, damp center, or downward trace.
normal_observation.zh: 停机冷却后，可见冷却接头干燥；普通灰尘颜色均匀，无粉色结晶边缘、湿润中心或向下流痕。

en: opening a hot or pressurized cooling or thermal-system cap
touching, tasting, or wiping an unknown fluid or deposit
approaching a fan, pump, orange wiring, or another moving or energized part
zh: 打开热态或带压冷却/热管理系统盖
触摸、品尝或擦除未知液体/结晶
接近风扇、泵、橙色线束或其他运动/带电部件

en: a component remains hot, the system may be pressurized, or the powertrain may auto-start
spray, an active leak, smoke, scorching, or a high-voltage warning appears
inspection would require opening, disconnecting, touching fluid, or approaching a moving or energized part
zh: 部件仍热、系统可能带压或动力系统可能自动启动
发现喷溅、活跃滴漏、冒烟、烧蚀或高压警告
观察需要开盖、拆接、触摸液体或接近运动/带电部件

warning.en: After powertrain shutdown and model-defined natural cooling of the related thermal or cooling circuit, inspect only from a safely visible position. Never open a hot or pressurized cap, touch an unknown fluid, or reach toward a fan, pump, or another part that may move or remain energized.
warning.zh: 动力系统关闭并让相关热管理/冷却回路按车型规定自然冷却后，只从安全可见位置观察；不得打开任何热态或带压盖、触碰未知液体，或把手伸向风扇、泵和其他可能运动/带电部件。

en: After powertrain shutdown and natural cooling of the related circuit, inspect one visible coolant joint from a safe position for a pink crystalline ring, damp center, or downward trace and photograph it first. Never touch, taste, clean, or disconnect it or diagnose the leak source from color.
zh: 动力系统关闭并让相关冷却回路自然冷却后，从安全位置查看一个可见冷却接头周围是否有粉色结晶环、湿润中心或向下流痕，并先拍照记录；不得触摸、品尝、擦洗或拆接，也不凭颜色确定漏点。

why_important.en: Cooling-system problems can cause overheating and major powertrain damage.
why_important.zh: 冷却系统异常可能导致过热和严重动力系统损伤。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 冷却管周边粉色粉末

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Concentrated rust, a purple heat spot, or material uneven wear is abnormal; preserve this checked-source scope without adding a groove conclusion and obtain professional assessment.
localized_label.zh: 可见集中锈斑、紫色热斑或明显偏磨；保持本勾选来源范围，不额外加入沟槽结论，交专业人员判断。

abnormal_observation.en: Concentrated rust, a purple heat spot, or material uneven wear is abnormal; preserve this checked-source scope without adding a groove conclusion and obtain professional assessment.
abnormal_observation.zh: 可见集中锈斑、紫色热斑或明显偏磨；保持本勾选来源范围，不额外加入沟槽结论，交专业人员判断。

check_what.en: After parking and cooling the brakes, inspect visible rotor areas through the wheel for rust, heat spots, grooves, or uneven wear; refer wheel removal or measurement to a professional.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳并待制动部件冷却后，仅从轮辐可见区域观察锈斑、热斑、沟槽和偏磨；需要拆轮或测量时转专业复检。

detailed_explanation.en: “Brake-disc rust or purple heat spots” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “刹车盘锈斑、紫色热斑”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After cooling, the visible rotor contact band is reasonably even without concentrated rust, purple heat discoloration, or material uneven wear.
normal_observation.zh: 制动部件冷却后，可见刹车盘接触带相对均匀，无集中锈斑、紫色热变色或明显偏磨。

en: removing a wheel in an uncontrolled setting
touching a hot rotor or reaching into the caliper pinch area
zh: 在未受控环境自行拆轮
触碰热刹车盘或把手伸入卡钳夹伤区

en: brake parts remain hot
wheel removal or reaching into a pinch area would be required
the vehicle or wheel cannot be secured
zh: 制动部件仍热
必须拆轮或把手伸入夹伤区域
车辆或车轮无法可靠固定

warning.en: Secure the parked vehicle and let brake parts cool; inspect only through visible wheel openings or with an appropriate gauge, and refer any wheel removal to a professional.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮辐等可见位置观察或使用合适量具；需要拆轮时转专业复检。

en: After parking and cooling the brakes, inspect visible rotor areas through the wheel for rust, heat spots, grooves, or uneven wear; refer wheel removal or measurement to a professional.
zh: 车辆停稳并待制动部件冷却后，仅从轮辐可见区域观察锈斑、热斑、沟槽和偏磨；需要拆轮或测量时转专业复检。

why_important.en: Brake defects are direct safety risks and cannot be offset by unrelated normal findings.
why_important.zh: 制动缺陷是直接安全风险，不能由其他正常项目抵消。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Brake-disc rust or purple heat spots
title.zh: 刹车盘锈斑、紫色热斑

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit finds out-of-limit play, aging, damage, leakage, or displacement; act on the professional finding, and a jack is not a substitute.
localized_label.zh: 合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内发现超限松旷、老化、破损、渗漏或位移；按专业结论处理，千斤顶不可替代。

abnormal_observation.en: A qualified professional using a certified lift or controlled inspection pit finds out-of-limit play, aging, damage, leakage, or displacement; act on the professional finding, and a jack is not a substitute.
abnormal_observation.zh: 合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内发现超限松旷、老化、破损、渗漏或位移；按专业结论处理，千斤顶不可替代。

check_what.en: Only a qualified professional on a certified lift or in a controlled inspection pit may inspect ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings and provide a located written result. A general user must not substitute a jack, go beneath the vehicle, or pry components; otherwise mark unable to confirm.
check_what.zh: 只由合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内检查球头、连杆、顶胶和轴承，并向用户提供带位置和结论的记录；普通用户不得用千斤顶替代、进入车下或自行撬动部件，条件不足直接无法确认。

detailed_explanation.en: “Lifted inspection of ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “升起检查球头、连杆、顶胶、轴承老化情况”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: On a certified lift or in a controlled inspection pit, a qualified professional records no out-of-limit play, aging damage, leakage, or displacement at ball joints, links, mounts, or bearings.
normal_observation.zh: 在认证举升机或受控检查坑内，由合格人员记录球头、连杆、顶胶和轴承无超限松旷、老化破损、渗漏或位移。

en: entering beneath a jack-supported vehicle
zh: 仅靠千斤顶支撑进入车底

en: qualified personnel and a certified lift or controlled inspection pit are unavailable
the vehicle is supported only by a jack
zh: 缺少合格人员、认证举升机或受控检查坑
车辆仅由千斤顶支撑

warning.en: This is a professional lift inspection; never enter beneath a vehicle supported only by a jack.
warning.zh: 该项目归为专业举升检查；不得仅靠千斤顶支撑进入车下。

en: Only a qualified professional on a certified lift or in a controlled inspection pit may inspect ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings and provide a located written result. A general user must not substitute a jack, go beneath the vehicle, or pry components; otherwise mark unable to confirm.
zh: 只由合格人员在认证举升机或受控检查坑内检查球头、连杆、顶胶和轴承，并向用户提供带位置和结论的记录；普通用户不得用千斤顶替代、进入车下或自行撬动部件，条件不足直接无法确认。

why_important.en: Suspension and steering faults affect control, tire wear, and emergency maneuvering.
why_important.zh: 悬挂与转向异常会影响车辆控制、轮胎磨损和紧急避让能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.en: Lifted inspection of ball joints, links, mounts, and bearings
title.zh: 升起检查球头、连杆、顶胶、轴承老化情况

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: After confirming compatible material and safe reach, repeat readings show a same-material high-value cluster or edge discontinuity suggesting repair; generally using the roof is not an absolute rule.
localized_label.zh: 确认材质兼容且可安全到达后，同材质多点读数出现可重复的成片高值或边缘突变，提示修复线索；“一般参考车顶”不能当绝对规则。

localized_label.en: Coating thickness
localized_label.zh: 涂层厚度

abnormal_observation.en: After confirming compatible material and safe reach, repeat readings show a same-material high-value cluster or edge discontinuity suggesting repair; generally using the roof is not an absolute rule.
abnormal_observation.zh: 确认材质兼容且可安全到达后，同材质多点读数出现可重复的成片高值或边缘突变，提示修复线索；“一般参考车顶”不能当绝对规则。

check_what.en: First verify roof and target-panel material, repair history, gauge compatibility, and safe reach, then choose the roof or an adjacent same-material panel as a justified reference, take perpendicular grid readings, and repeat differences. Select unable to confirm when material, history, compatibility, or safe access cannot be established; never compare across materials or climb.
check_what.zh: 先核对车顶和待测覆盖件的材质、维修记录、量具兼容性及安全可达性，再选择车顶或相邻同材质面作有依据的参考，按固定网格多点垂直测量并复测差异。材质/历史/兼容性不明或无法安全到达时选择“无法确认”；禁止跨材质比较和攀爬。

detailed_explanation.en: “Full-body paint-gauge scan” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “漆膜仪全车金属面扫描”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After checking material and repair history, the selected roof or adjacent same-material reference is justified and multi-point readings are continuous and repeatable.
normal_observation.zh: 先核对材质和维修记录后，所选车顶或相邻同材质参考面有依据，多点读数连续且复测一致。

en: climbing the vehicle, standing on a sill or seat, or overreaching
directly comparing readings across materials
measuring a hot, wet, or moving surface
zh: 攀爬车身、站上门槛/座椅或过度伸展
跨材质直接比较数值
在高温、潮湿或运动表面测量

en: material, repair history, or gauge compatibility cannot be confirmed
a point would require climbing, overreaching, or standing on the vehicle
a surface is wet, hot, moving, or a reading cannot be repeated reliably
zh: 材质、维修历史或量具兼容性无法确认
测点需要攀爬、过度伸展或站上车辆
表面潮湿、高温、运动或读数无法可靠重复

warning.en: First confirm target and reference material, repair history, and gauge compatibility. Measure same-material surfaces only from a safely reachable ground position without climbing the vehicle, standing on a sill or seat, or comparing across materials.

en: First verify roof and target-panel material, repair history, gauge compatibility, and safe reach, then choose the roof or an adjacent same-material panel as a justified reference, take perpendicular grid readings, and repeat differences. abnormal_observation.en: Record a conflict only when source, method and conditions are complete and sufficiently comparable, then verify the original data or obtain professional reinspection. Missing source, method or conditions remains unknown and is not an abnormal finding.
abnormal_observation.zh: 仅在来源、方法和条件完整、足以比较时，记录仍存在的可比数据矛盾，并要求核实原始数据或专业复检。来源、方法或条件不足选择无法确认，不因缺失资料选择异常。

check_what.zh: 记录已经取得的健康数据，区分 BMS 估计、完整厂商测试和其他方法；同时记录工具、软件、时间、SOC、温度及测试是否完整。

detailed_explanation.en: Do not infer SOH from displayed range or use a universal threshold for life or safety. Missing context remains unknown. A lengthy full OEM test is not mandatory in quick mode.
detailed_explanation.zh: 不把表显续航换算成 SOH，不使用通用阈值判定寿命或安全；缺失上下文按无法确认处理。完整厂商测试可能耗时很长，不列入快速必做。

normal_observation.en: Source, method and conditions are complete and verifiable; this item alone does not declare a battery healthy.
normal_observation.zh: 数据来源、方法和条件完整可核验；本项目不单独给出电池正常结论。

check_what.zh: 由合格人员在正确支撑后逐轮观察制动管路的可见渗漏、损伤、扭转、鼓胀和异常摩擦。

abnormal_observation.zh: 存在解释不足的倒退或资料冲突，需要核实原始记录和仪表更换史。

check_what.zh: 按日期排列已取得的里程记录，保留原单位，与现场表显核对；记录仪表更换和来源不明等解释缺口。

detailed_explanation.zh: 磨损、单份低里程记录或单位差异本身不能证明调表，也不能恢复真实总里程。

normal_observation.zh: 已取得记录之间未发现无法解释的里程倒退或单位矛盾；缺失区间仍未知。

abnormal_observation.zh: 记录结构裂损、明显变形或与可核验厂商方法不一致的连接，安排专业车身检查。

check_what.en: At this location, record visible structural joints, cracks, deformation, corrosion and repair clues. Compare with the applicable OEM material and joining method without exposing hidden areas.
check_what.zh: 分别记录当前位置可见的结构连接、裂纹、变形、腐蚀和维修痕迹；按该车型的材料和连接方法核对，隐蔽部分不拆开。

localized_label.zh: 弹簧或减振器可见异常

abnormal_observation.en: Record definite fracture, insecure attachment or clear damage/leakage and arrange professional attention.
abnormal_observation.zh: 记录明确断裂、不安全固定或明显损伤泄漏，并建议专业处理。

check_what.en: With model-correct support and loading, a qualified person checks each location for broken springs, insecure attachment, damper damage or substantial leakage.
check_what.zh: 合格人员按车型要求支撑和加载后，逐处检查弹簧断裂、部件不安全固定、减振器损伤或明显泄漏。

localized_label.en: Static brake stop indication
localized_label.zh: 静态制动存在停止条件

abnormal_observation.en: Stop road testing and obtain professional reinspection for an abnormal brake warning, obvious sinking or unexpectedly soft pedal, visible leakage, inability to remain stationary, or a known unresolved brake defect.
abnormal_observation.zh: 出现异常制动警告、明显下沉或异常偏软、可见泄漏、不能可靠保持静止，或已有未解决制动缺陷时停止路试并专业复检。

check_what.en: Park and secure the vehicle. Follow the applicable manual to check brake warnings and parking state, recording only stationary pedal feedback and safely visible leakage. Check for known unresolved brake defects. Do not move the vehicle, perform emergency braking or test braking performance for this item.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳并可靠固定，按本车型手册核对制动警告与驻车状态，只记录踏板静态反馈及安全可见处的渗漏。同时核对已经发现但未解决的制动问题；不为本项动车，不执行紧急制动或制动力测试。

detailed_explanation.en: Missing model instructions, unexplained pedal feedback or unverified conditions remains unknown and blocks road testing. Electronic assistance and brake-by-wire feedback can differ; do not impose a conventional vacuum-servo procedure. A normal static screen must not be copied to the professional braking-performance item. Do not disassemble, open reservoirs, repeatedly pump the pedal or perform limit braking.
detailed_explanation.zh: 缺少车型手册、无法解释的踏板反馈或未核实条件选择无法确认，并停止路试。电子助力或线控制动的踏板反馈可能不同，不套用传统真空助力程序。不把此项正常复制为原专业制动力项目正常，也不做拆解、开储液壶、反复泵踏或极限制动。

normal_observation.en: All static conditions are verifiable: no abnormal brake warning, obvious sinking or unexpectedly soft pedal, visible leakage or inability to remain securely stationary, and no known unresolved brake defect. This records no stop indication in the static screen; it does not establish dynamic braking performance.
normal_observation.zh: 上述静态条件均能核实：无异常制动警告、明显下沉或异常偏软、可见泄漏或不能可靠保持静止，且没有已知未解决的制动缺陷。仅表示本静态筛查未发现阻止继续的迹象，不表示动态制动力合格。

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Only model-specific plate reattachment/insecurity, readable VIN mismatch or manufacture-date conflict with trusted records; other document gaps are outside this task.
localized_label.zh: 只记录本车型铭牌重贴/固定异常、已读VIN不符或制造日期与可信资料矛盾；其他文件缺口不由此项判断。

abnormal_observation.en: After the model- and market-specific location is confirmed and fields are safely legible, a reattached or insecure plate, masked-VIN mismatch, or production-date conflict with a trusted record requires official or professional verification.
abnormal_observation.zh: 在本车型/市场位置已获确认且字段安全可读后，发现铭牌重贴/固定异常、脱敏 VIN 不一致或生产日期与可信记录矛盾；需官方或专业复核。

check_what.en: First use model- and market-specific information to confirm the manufacturer-plate location and field meanings, then read the masked VIN and production date from a safely visible position and compare them with contract or handover records. Select unable to confirm when the plate is obscured, a field is unreadable, or location or meaning is uncertain; select abnormal only for reattachment or insecure mounting, a VIN mismatch, or a date conflict with a trusted record.
check_what.zh: 先按本车型和市场资料确认制造商铭牌位置与字段含义，再从安全可见位置读取脱敏 VIN 和生产日期并与合同/交付记录比较。铭牌遮挡、字段不可读、位置/含义无法确认时选择“无法确认”；重贴/固定异常、VIN 不一致或日期与可信记录矛盾才选异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Vehicle identification plate” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车辆铭牌”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The manufacturer plate is securely fitted and legible, the masked VIN matches the contract character by character, and the production date is readable with location and meaning confirmed for the model and market.
normal_observation.zh: 制造商标识铭牌固定完整、字段清晰，脱敏 VIN 与合同逐位一致，生产日期可读且位置/含义按本车型和市场资料确认。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: First use model- and market-specific information to confirm the manufacturer-plate location and field meanings, then read the masked VIN and production date from a safely visible position and compare them with contract or handover records. Select unable to confirm when the plate is obscured, a field is unreadable, or location or meaning is uncertain; select abnormal only for reattachment or insecure mounting, a VIN mismatch, or a date conflict with a trusted record.

why_important.en: Document and identity checks help confirm the vehicle, configuration, and supplied records.
why_important.zh: 文件与身份核对有助于确认车辆、配置和交付资料是否相符。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

abnormal_observation.zh: 适用文件缺失、VIN/车型/日期不一致、来源无法核实、涂改或关键页缺少；按所在地官方规则复核，不以其他市场名称替代。

check_what.en: Check the locally applicable certificate or import document, certificate of conformity, purchase invoice, warranty documents, and owner manual.
check_what.zh: 按所在地核对适用的合格或进口文件、一致性证明、购车发票、保修凭证和用户手册。

normal_observation.en: Locally applicable conformity or import documents, certificate of conformity, purchase invoice, warranty evidence, and owner manual are present, traceable, and mutually consistent on vehicle details.
normal_observation.zh: 所在地适用的合格/进口文件、一致性证明、购车发票、保修凭证和用户手册齐全，车辆信息相互一致且来源可追溯。

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: A through-scratch, localized gloss loss, materially different orange peel, color mismatch, overspray, or edge repaint line is an appearance or repair clue.
localized_label.zh: 划痕穿透、局部失光、橘皮纹明显不同、色差、飞漆或边缘补漆线可见；记录为外观/修复线索。

abnormal_observation.en: A through-scratch, localized gloss loss, materially different orange peel, color mismatch, overspray, or edge repaint line is an appearance or repair clue.
abnormal_observation.zh: 划痕穿透、局部失光、橘皮纹明显不同、色差、飞漆或边缘补漆线可见；记录为外观/修复线索。

check_what.en: Walk around the vehicle under consistent good light and compare bumpers, door edges, and adjacent paint from matching angles for scratches, gloss, orange peel, color mismatch, and paint edges. Capture paired comparisons without diagnosing a collision from a difference alone.
check_what.zh: 在一致且光线充足的位置绕车一周，从相同角度比较前后保险杠、车门边缘和相邻漆面的划痕、光泽、橘皮纹、色差和喷漆边界；拍摄成对对照，不以差异单独诊断事故。

detailed_explanation.en: “Paint finish and gloss” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车漆光泽”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: In good light, bumpers, door edges, and adjacent paint have continuous gloss and color without a deep scratch, abrupt orange-peel texture, or repaint boundary.
normal_observation.zh: 光线充足时，前后保险杠、车门边缘及相邻漆面光泽和颜色连续，无深划痕、突兀橘皮纹或补漆分界。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Walk around the vehicle under consistent good light and compare bumpers, door edges, and adjacent paint from matching angles for scratches, gloss, orange peel, color mismatch, and paint edges. Capture paired comparisons without diagnosing a collision from a difference alone.
zh: 在一致且光线充足的位置绕车一周，从相同角度比较前后保险杠、车门边缘和相邻漆面的划痕、光泽、橘皮纹、色差和喷漆边界；拍摄成对对照，不以差异单独诊断事故。

why_important.en: Fit, paint, tires, and exterior closures affect vehicle condition and future repairs.
why_important.zh: 装配、漆面、轮胎和外部开合件会影响车辆状态与后续维修。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

localized_label.zh: 套用错误点码规则、固定角落找不到编码、单片日期明显离群或与更换记录冲突；仅作复检线索。

abnormal_observation.en: Using the wrong dot-code rule, failing because of a fixed-corner assumption, a materially outlying pane date, or conflict with replacement records is a follow-up clue only.
abnormal_observation.zh: 套用错误点码规则、固定角落找不到编码、单片日期明显离群或与更换记录冲突；仅作复检线索。

check_what.en: Use the applicable vehicle or glass-supplier coding guide, compare each glass date with vehicle production and known replacement records, and treat one outlier only as a clue to record and review.
check_what.zh: 按车辆或玻璃供应商的适用编码规则读取各片玻璃日期，与整车生产时间和已知更换记录比较；单片差异只作为记录和复检线索。

detailed_explanation.en: “Glass date codes” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “玻璃日期”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When decoded using the applicable vehicle or glass-supplier rule, each pane date aligns logically with production timing and known replacement records.
normal_observation.zh: 按车辆或玻璃供应商适用规则解读后，各片玻璃日期与生产时间及已知更换记录逻辑一致。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

localized_label.en: Insufficient tread or abnormal wear
localized_label.zh: 胎纹不足或异常磨耗

localized_label.en: Decoded tire age/date discrepancy
localized_label.zh: 已解读胎龄或日期组合异常

localized_label.en: Tire bulge, cracking or exposed cord
localized_label.zh: 轮胎鼓包、裂损或露线

localized_label.en: Wheel damage or deformation
localized_label.zh: 轮毂裂损或变形

localized_label.en: Tire specification conflicts with verified requirements
localized_label.zh: 轮胎规格与可核实要求不符

abnormal_observation.en: Wheel damage or deformation, a tire-specification mismatch, anomalous date mix, insufficient tread, uneven wear, bulge, or cracking is abnormal; molding hairs are not a used-vehicle standard.
abnormal_observation.zh: 轮毂裂损/变形，轮胎规格不符、日期组合异常、花纹不足、偏磨、鼓包或裂纹；不得把胎毛存在与否作为二手车正常标准。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only visible wheels, tread, and sidewalls from outside and compare them with the placard, configuration, or replacement records. Never put a hand or body into the wheel well or brake pinch zone, turn or remove a wheel, or go beneath the vehicle; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从车轮外侧核对可见轮毂、胎面和侧壁，并与车辆标牌/配置/更换记录比较。不得把手或身体伸入轮拱/制动夹伤区，不转轮、不拆轮、不进入车下；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Tires and wheels” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “轮胎轮毂”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Wheels show no crack or deformation, all tire brands, sizes, and models align with the placard, configuration, or replacement records, and age, tread, and sidewalls show no independent hazard.
normal_observation.zh: 轮毂无裂损或变形，四轮轮胎品牌、规格和型号符合车辆标牌、配置或更换记录；胎龄、花纹和侧壁均无独立危险。

en: putting a hand or body into a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
turning or removing a wheel or measuring while the vehicle moves
approaching hot brake parts or applying force in a loaded hazard zone
zh: 把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
转动车轮、拆轮或在车辆移动时测量
靠近仍热的制动件或在受载危险区施力测量

en: the vehicle or wheel cannot be kept securely stationary
a hand or body would need to enter a wheel well, brake pinch zone, or beneath the vehicle
the wheel would need turning or removal or a hot or moving part would need to be approached
zh: 车辆或车轮不能可靠保持静止
必须把手或身体伸入轮拱、制动夹伤区或车下
需要转轮、拆轮或接近仍热/运动的部件

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only from outside the tire or wheel or use an appropriate gauge at safely reachable outside points; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从轮胎/车轮外侧观察或在安全可达的外侧测点使用合适量具；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

en: With the vehicle parked, wheels secured, and brake parts cooled, inspect only visible wheels, tread, and sidewalls from outside and compare them with the placard, configuration, or replacement records. Never put a hand or body into the wheel well or brake pinch zone, turn or remove a wheel, or go beneath the vehicle; select unable to confirm when a critical inner area is hidden.
zh: 车辆停稳、车轮可靠固定且制动部件冷却后，只从车轮外侧核对可见轮毂、胎面和侧壁，并与车辆标牌/配置/更换记录比较。不得把手或身体伸入轮拱/制动夹伤区，不转轮、不拆轮、不进入车下；关键内侧范围不可见时选择“无法确认”。

localized_label.en: A raised corner, left/right gap mismatch, latch-area step, excessive or narrow gap, or closure rubbing is abnormal; observe only while the lid is stationary.
localized_label.zh: 盖角翘起、左右缝隙差异、锁扣区域错台、过宽/过窄或开合摩擦；只在盖板静止时观察。

abnormal_observation.en: A raised corner, left/right gap mismatch, latch-area step, excessive or narrow gap, or closure rubbing is abnormal; observe only while the lid is stationary.
abnormal_observation.zh: 盖角翘起、左右缝隙差异、锁扣区域错台、过宽/过窄或开合摩擦；只在盖板静止时观察。

check_what.en: With front- and rear-trunk lids stationary and securely latched, compare paired corners and side edges for gap width and flushness and look for rubbing. Stay out of powered travel paths and never use fingers as a gauge.
check_what.zh: 让前备箱盖和后备箱盖完全静止并可靠锁止后，成对比较四角和左右边缘与车身的缝隙宽度和平齐度，同时查看摩擦痕；避开电动开合路径，不用手指作量规。

detailed_explanation.en: “Panel-gap uniformity” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “接缝均匀度”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Front- and rear-trunk lid corners and side gaps are symmetric, sit flush with adjacent bodywork when latched, and show no rubbing.
normal_observation.zh: 前备箱盖、后备箱盖四角及左右边缘缝隙对称，锁止后与相邻车身平齐且无摩擦痕。

en: leaning in to measure while a lid moves
using fingers as a gauge or forcing a lid corner
remaining in a powered travel path
zh: 在盖板运动时俯身测缝
用手指作量规或强压盖角
停留在电动开合路径内

en: a lid starts moving, is not securely latched, or drops unexpectedly
a person, clothing, or object enters a powered lid path
comparison would require fingers as a gauge, forcing a corner, or overreaching
zh: 盖板开始移动、锁止不可靠或突然下落
人员、衣物或物品进入电动盖板路径
比较需要用手指作量规、强压盖角或过度伸展

warning.en: Park the vehicle and compare paired corner and side gaps only after the front- and rear-trunk lids are fully stationary and securely latched. Stay clear of powered lid travel paths and never put fingers into a gap.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳；前备箱盖和后备箱盖完全静止并可靠锁止后，才从成对安全位置比较四角与左右边缘缝隙。远离电动盖板运动路径，不用手指伸入缝隙。

en: With front- and rear-trunk lids stationary and securely latched, compare paired corners and side edges for gap width and flushness and look for rubbing. Stay out of powered travel paths and never use fingers as a gauge.
zh: 让前备箱盖和后备箱盖完全静止并可靠锁止后，成对比较四角和左右边缘与车身的缝隙宽度和平齐度，同时查看摩擦痕；避开电动开合路径，不用手指作量规。

why_important.zh: 装配、漆面、轮胎和外部开合件会影响车辆状态与后续维修。

localized_label.en: Charge-flap movement, latch or panel defect
localized_label.zh: 充电口盖动作、锁止或盖板异常

localized_label.en: Weather-seal damage, deterioration or displacement
localized_label.zh: 密封条破损、老化或脱位

localized_label.en: Visible charging-connector exterior defect
localized_label.zh: 充电接口外部可见异常

abnormal_observation.en: Binding, failed latching, abnormal noise, door misalignment, a damaged or displaced seal, water trace, or scorching around the port is abnormal and requires stopping.
abnormal_observation.zh: 开合卡滞、无法锁止、异响、盖板错位，密封圈破损/脱位，或接口周围有水迹、烧蚀；停止并复检。

check_what.en: Clear the charge-port door path, operate it repeatedly as instructed, and observe smooth movement, seating, and noise. With it stationary, inspect the seal and port area for water or scorching; stop for an abnormality and never force it.
check_what.zh: 清空充电口盖运动路径，按车辆手册多次开合并观察是否平顺、到位和有无异响；盖板静止时检查密封圈、接口周边水迹和烧蚀，异常即停止且不强推。

detailed_explanation.en: “Charge-port door” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “充电口盖”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The charge-port door repeatedly opens and closes smoothly and seats reliably as instructed without abnormal noise, while its seal is continuous and the area is dry.
normal_observation.zh: 充电口盖按手册多次开合均平顺、可靠到位，无异响；密封圈连续完整且接口周围干燥。

en: connecting a charger merely to inspect the door
touching charging terminals or bypassing an interlock
forcing, blocking, or dismantling the door
zh: 为检查盖板连接充电器
触碰充电端子或绕过联锁
强推、阻挡或拆卸盖板

en: the door binds, moves abnormally, or will not latch
water, scorching, damage, or a warning appears near the inlet
inspection would require charging, terminal contact, or disassembly
zh: 盖板动作卡滞、异常或无法锁止
接口区域有水迹、烧蚀、破损或报警
检查需要接电、触碰端子或拆卸

warning.en: This item checks only the charge-port door, hinge or latch, and visible seal. Park the vehicle and clear the door path; do not connect a charger, touch terminals, or dismantle high-voltage parts.
warning.zh: 本项只检查充电口盖、铰链/锁扣和可见密封区域；车辆停稳并清空盖板路径后操作，不连接充电器、不触碰端子或拆解高压部件。

en: Clear the charge-port door path, operate it repeatedly as instructed, and observe smooth movement, seating, and noise. With it stationary, inspect the seal and port area for water or scorching; stop for an abnormality and never force it.
zh: 清空充电口盖运动路径，按车辆手册多次开合并观察是否平顺、到位和有无异响；盖板静止时检查密封圈、接口周边水迹和烧蚀，异常即停止且不强推。

why_important.en: Fit, paint, tires, and exterior closures affect vehicle condition and future repairs.
why_important.zh: 装配、漆面、轮胎和外部开合件会影响车辆状态与后续维修。

title.zh: 充电口盖
