change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Visible seat upholstery damage
localized_label.zh: 座椅材质或内衬可见损坏

localized_label.en: Seat-adjustment defect
localized_label.zh: 座椅调节异常

abnormal_observation.en: Damaged material, a deep stain, collapsed bolster, split seam, or any fitted adjustment that binds, makes abnormal noise, loses a direction, or cannot hold is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 材质破损、深污渍、侧翼塌陷、缝线开裂，或任一配备调节卡滞、异响、方向失效/无法保持。

check_what.en: Inspect the actual seat upholstery and bolsters for wrinkles, scratches, stains, or collapse, then test every adjustment fitted to this vehicle.
check_what.zh: 检查座椅实际材质和侧翼的褶皱、划痕、污渍或塌陷，并测试本车实际配备的各调节方向。

detailed_explanation.en: “Seat material and adjustment” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “座椅材质与调节”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The actual upholstery and bolsters have no material scratch, stain, cracking, or collapse, and every fitted adjustment moves smoothly and holds position.
normal_observation.zh: 座椅实际材质和侧翼无异常划痕、污渍、开裂或塌陷，实际配备的各调节方向运行平顺并能保持位置。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Inspect the actual seat upholstery and bolsters for wrinkles, scratches, stains, or collapse, then test every adjustment fitted to this vehicle.
zh: 检查座椅实际材质和侧翼的褶皱、划痕、污渍或塌陷，并测试本车实际配备的各调节方向。

why_important.en: Interior damage, odor, and storage issues can reveal use, fit, or water-ingress problems.
why_important.zh: 内饰损伤、异味和储物空间问题可提示使用、装配或进水异常。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 座椅材质与调节

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Glass damage or laminate defect
localized_label.zh: 玻璃裂损或夹层异常

localized_label.en: Visible waterline, dampness or related deposit
localized_label.zh: 可见水线、潮湿或相关沉积迹象

localized_label.en: Sunshade operation defect
localized_label.zh: 遮阳帘运行异常

abnormal_observation.en: A glass crack or chip, laminate defect, water trace near a seal, or a shade that binds, tracks incorrectly, makes noise, or fails is abnormal; do not press damaged glass.
abnormal_observation.zh: 玻璃裂纹/崩点、夹层异常、密封周边水迹，或遮阳帘卡滞、跑偏、异响/失效；不要按压损伤处。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, inspect the panoramic roof, laminate, and seal edges from the cabin and safely reachable exterior edge for cracks, chips, spreading inclusions, and water traces. If fitted, clear the shade path and operate it once; never press damaged glass.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后从车内和安全可达外缘观察全景顶棚玻璃、夹层和密封边缘的裂纹、崩点、杂质扩展及水迹；如配备遮阳帘，清空路径后测试一次开合，不按压损伤玻璃。

detailed_explanation.en: “Glass roof” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “顶棚玻璃”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The panoramic roof glass and visible edges have no crack, chip, spreading laminate inclusion, or water trace, and a fitted shade moves continuously and holds position.
normal_observation.zh: 全景顶棚玻璃和可见边缘无裂纹、崩点、夹层杂质扩展或水迹；如配备遮阳帘，开合连续并能停位。

en: climbing the vehicle or standing on a seat or sill
pressing or striking damaged glass
forcing a binding shade
zh: 攀爬车身或站在座椅/门槛上
按压或敲击损伤玻璃
强行操作卡滞遮阳帘

en: a crack, chip, or loose glass is found
inspection would require climbing or pressing the glass
the shade or glass area moves unexpectedly
zh: 发现裂纹、崩点或玻璃松动
观察需要攀爬或按压玻璃
遮阳帘或玻璃区域出现非预期动作

warning.en: Inspect roof glass only from the cabin or a safely reachable ground-level edge. Never climb the vehicle, stand on a sill or seat, press a crack, or remain beneath damaged glass.
warning.zh: 只从车内或地面安全可达外缘观察顶棚玻璃；不得攀爬车身、站在门槛/座椅上、按压裂纹或在损伤玻璃下方停留。

en: With the vehicle parked, inspect the panoramic roof, laminate, and seal edges from the cabin and safely reachable exterior edge for cracks, chips, spreading inclusions, and water traces. If fitted, clear the shade path and operate it once; never press damaged glass.
zh: 车辆停稳后从车内和安全可达外缘观察全景顶棚玻璃、夹层和密封边缘的裂纹、崩点、杂质扩展及水迹；如配备遮阳帘，清空路径后测试一次开合，不按压损伤玻璃。

why_important.en: Interior damage, odor, and storage issues can reveal use, fit, or water-ingress problems.
why_important.zh: 内饰损伤、异味和储物空间问题可提示使用、装配或进水异常。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 顶棚玻璃

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Persistent abnormal odor after ventilation
localized_label.zh: 通风后持续异常气味

abnormal_observation.en: A persistent sharp chemical, damp, mold, fuel, burning, or other discomfort-causing odor that remains after adequate ventilation is abnormal; do not sniff closely and leave immediately if anyone feels unwell.
abnormal_observation.zh: 充分通风后仍持续存在刺鼻化学味、潮湿味、霉味、燃油味、烧焦味或其他使人不适的气味；不主动贴近嗅闻，出现不适立即离开。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation, then passively assess from a normal seating position whether persistent sharp chemical, damp or mold, fuel, or burning odor remains. Never sniff near a surface or unknown substance. Leave immediately for persistent hazardous odor, smoke, or any personal discomfort; select unable to confirm when ventilation is unavailable.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风，再从正常乘坐位置被动判断是否仍有持续刺鼻化学味、潮湿/霉味、燃油味或烧焦味；不要贴近表面或未知物质嗅闻。持续危险气味、烟雾或任何人员不适时立即离开；无法通风时选择“无法确认”。

detailed_explanation.en: “Interior odor” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “内饰异味”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After ventilation, the cabin has no persistent sharp chemical, damp, mold, or burning odor, and a normal result does not depend on leather or new-car smell.
normal_observation.zh: 通风后座舱无持续刺鼻化学味、潮湿/霉味或烧焦味；正常结论不依赖“皮革味”或“新车味”。

en: sniffing directly near upholstery, carpet, or an unknown substance
remaining in the cabin for a persistent odor or personal discomfort
using ignition, heat, or a chemical to locate an odor
zh: 贴近座椅、地毯或未知物质直接嗅闻
在持续异味或人员不适时留在座舱
用点火、加热或化学剂定位气味

en: persistent fuel, burning, or strong chemical odor, smoke, or visible leakage
anyone feels dizzy, headache, nausea, breathing discomfort, or eye or nose irritation
the area cannot be ventilated or assessment would require sniffing near an unknown substance
zh: 持续燃油味、烧焦味、强烈化学味、烟雾或可见泄漏
任何人头晕、头痛、恶心、呼吸不适或眼鼻刺激
现场无法通风或需要靠近未知物质嗅闻

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation. Assess cabin air passively from a normal seating position without putting a face near a surface or taking a deliberate deep sniff.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风；人员从正常乘坐位置被动判断座舱空气，不把脸贴近表面或主动深嗅。

en: With the vehicle parked, first open doors or windows for adequate ventilation, then passively assess from a normal seating position whether persistent sharp chemical, damp or mold, fuel, or burning odor remains. Never sniff near a surface or unknown substance. Leave immediately for persistent hazardous odor, smoke, or any personal discomfort; select unable to confirm when ventilation is unavailable.
zh: 车辆停稳后先打开车门或车窗充分通风，再从正常乘坐位置被动判断是否仍有持续刺鼻化学味、潮湿/霉味、燃油味或烧焦味；不要贴近表面或未知物质嗅闻。持续危险气味、烟雾或任何人员不适时立即离开；无法通风时选择“无法确认”。

why_important.en: Interior damage, odor, and storage issues can reveal use, fit, or water-ingress problems.
why_important.zh: 内饰损伤、异味和储物空间问题可提示使用、装配或进水异常。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 内饰异味

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Storage liner, security, foreign-object or closure defect
localized_label.zh: 储物内衬、固定、异物或开闭异常

localized_label.en: Visible waterline, dampness or related deposit
localized_label.zh: 可见水线、潮湿或相关沉积迹象

abnormal_observation.en: A raised or damaged liner, binding compartment, loose fitting, water trace, mold, sharp or abandoned object, or non-factory alteration is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 内衬翘起/破损、储物格开合卡滞、固定松脱，或发现水迹、霉斑、尖锐物、遗留物及非原厂改动。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked and lids stationary, open the center console, door bins, and front trunk one at a time, inspect liner fit, security, dryness, foreign objects, and water traces, then close normally to check binding. Stop for and safely handle any sharp object.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳并让盖板静止后，逐一打开扶手箱、门板储物格和前备箱，检查内衬平整、固定、干燥、异物和水迹，再正常关闭确认不卡滞；先移除尖锐物再继续。

detailed_explanation.en: “Storage compartments” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “储物空间”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The center console, door bins, and front-trunk liner are secure, flat, dry, and clean, closures move smoothly, and no foreign object or water trace remains.
normal_observation.zh: 扶手箱、门板储物格和前备箱内衬平整固定、干燥清洁，开合件顺畅且无遗留异物或水迹。

en: handling a sharp, contaminated, or unknown object with bare hands
operating multiple closures at once or putting fingers in a hinge or latch
forcing a binding closure
zh: 徒手接触尖锐/污染/不明物
同时操作多个开合件或把手指伸入铰链/锁扣
强行开合卡滞部件

en: a sharp object, contaminant, unknown fluid, smoke, or irritating odor is found
a closure binds, drops unexpectedly, or cannot remain safely open or latched
a hand, clothing, or object approaches a hinge, latch, or travel path
zh: 发现尖锐物、污染物、不明液体、烟雾或刺激性气味
开合件卡滞、突然下落或不能可靠保持/锁止
手、衣物或物品接近铰链、锁扣或运动路径

warning.en: With the vehicle parked, first visually confirm that a compartment or front trunk contains no sharp, contaminated, or unknown object. Keep fingers clear of hinges and latches, operate one closure at a time, and inspect its liner only when fully stationary.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳后，先目视确认储物格或前备箱内无尖锐、污染或不明物；手指远离铰链/锁扣，每次只开合一个部件并在其完全静止后观察内衬。

en: With the vehicle parked and lids stationary, open the center console, door bins, and front trunk one at a time, inspect liner fit, security, dryness, foreign objects, and water traces, then close normally to check binding. Stop for and safely handle any sharp object.
zh: 车辆停稳并让盖板静止后，逐一打开扶手箱、门板储物格和前备箱，检查内衬平整、固定、干燥、异物和水迹，再正常关闭确认不卡滞；先移除尖锐物再继续。

why_important.en: Interior damage, odor, and storage issues can reveal use, fit, or water-ingress problems.
why_important.zh: 内饰损伤、异味和储物空间问题可提示使用、装配或进水异常。

reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 储物空间

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Display pixel, backlight or touch defect
localized_label.zh: 屏幕像素、背光或触控异常

localized_label.en: Only repeated blackouts/restarts or explicit unresolved critical-update/fault messages; an older version is not automatically abnormal.
localized_label.zh: 只记录频繁黑屏/重启或车辆明确提示关键更新/故障未处理；版本不够新不自动异常。

abnormal_observation.en: A material dead-pixel or leakage area, touch dead zone or drift, repeated blackout or reboot, or an explicit unresolved critical update or fault prompt is abnormal; record it without unauthorized flashing.
abnormal_observation.zh: 大片坏点/漏光、触控死区或漂移、频繁黑屏/重启，或系统明确提示关键更新/故障未处理；记录而不擅自刷写。

check_what.en: Inspect the display for dead pixels or backlight leakage, test touch response, and record the installed version and any manufacturer-provided update prompt without treating 'not latest' alone as abnormal.
check_what.zh: 检查屏幕坏点、漏光和触控，并记录已安装的软件版本及车辆是否提示可用更新；不要仅因不是所谓“最新版本”判为异常。

detailed_explanation.en: “Center display” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “中控屏幕”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: The center display has no material dead pixel or backlight leak, touch response is consistent across regions, and installed software plus manufacturer update prompts are recorded without treating not-latest alone as abnormal.
normal_observation.zh: 中控屏无明显坏点或漏光，触控各区域响应一致；已记录当前软件版本和制造商提供的更新提示，未把“非最新”单独判异常。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Inspect the display for dead pixels or backlight leakage, test touch response, and record the installed version and any manufacturer-provided update prompt without treating 'not latest' alone as abnormal.
zh: 检查屏幕坏点、漏光和触控，并记录已安装的软件版本及车辆是否提示可用更新；不要仅因不是所谓“最新版本”判为异常。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

title.zh: 中控屏幕

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Speaker, channel or volume-output defect
localized_label.zh: 扬声器、声道或音量输出异常

abnormal_observation.en: A fitted speaker or subwoofer that is silent, distorted, popping, persistently noisy, or mapped incorrectly by channel or balance is abnormal; assess only fitted equipment.
abnormal_observation.zh: 任一配备扬声器或低音炮无声、破音、爆音、持续杂音，或声道/平衡控制响应错误；仅按实际配置判断。

check_what.en: Play non-copyrighted test audio and check every fitted speaker for distortion or silence, including a subwoofer only if equipped.
check_what.zh: 播放无版权测试音频，检查本车实际配备的各扬声器是否破音或无声；低音炮仅在配备时检查。

detailed_explanation.en: “Audio system” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “音响测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Non-copyrighted test audio plays clearly and continuously through every fitted speaker, left/right and balance controls respond, and there is no distortion, noise, or silent channel.
normal_observation.zh: 无版权测试音频在实际配备的每个扬声器中清晰连续，左右声道和平衡控制响应，无破音、杂音或缺声。

warning.en: Choose unable to confirm/professional follow-up when conditions are insufficient.
warning.zh: 条件不足时选择“无法确认/需要专业复检”。

en: Play non-copyrighted test audio and check every fitted speaker for distortion or silence, including a subwoofer only if equipped.
zh: 播放无版权测试音频，检查本车实际配备的各扬声器是否破音或无声；低音炮仅在配备时检查。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 音响测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Climate temperature, airflow or operation defect
localized_label.zh: 空调温度、风量或运行异常

localized_label.en: Persistent abnormal odor after ventilation
localized_label.zh: 通风后持续异常气味

abnormal_observation.en: Insufficient temperature response, weak or failed airflow level, direction that does not follow settings, blower noise, or mold, burning, or irritating odor is abnormal.
abnormal_observation.zh: 温度响应不足、风量弱/档位失效、风向不随设置、风机异响，或出现霉味、烧焦味、刺激性气味。

check_what.en: Under permitted operating conditions, select cooling, heating, airflow levels, and directions and allow a reasonable response time to record temperature change, airflow, noise, and abnormal odor noticed passively. Never sniff closely at a vent.
check_what.zh: 在车辆手册允许工况下分别设置制冷、制热、不同风量和风向，等待合理时间记录温度变化、风量、噪声和被动察觉的异常气味；不得贴近出风口嗅闻。

detailed_explanation.en: “Climate-control system” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “空调系统”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Under permitted conditions, cooling and heating produce a clear temperature change, airflow volume and direction respond continuously, and output has no abnormal odor.
normal_observation.zh: 在允许工况下，制冷/制热产生明确温度变化，风量和风向调节响应连续，出风无异常异味。

en: running an internal-combustion engine in an enclosed or partly enclosed garage to test climate control
leaving a running vehicle or bypassing Park or an interlock
sniffing directly at a vent or removing trim to inspect a filter
zh: 在封闭或半封闭车库运行燃油发动机测试空调
离开运行中车辆或绕过驻车/联锁
把脸贴近出风口嗅闻或拆饰板查滤芯

en: dizziness, headache, nausea, breathing discomfort, or exhaust accumulation occurs
unexpected movement, an engine, high-voltage, or climate warning, or a burning odor appears
testing would require trim removal, approaching belts or fans, or inadequate ventilation
zh: 出现头晕、头痛、恶心、呼吸不适或尾气聚集
车辆非预期移动、发动机/高压/空调警告或焦味
测试需要拆饰板、接近皮带风扇或现场通风不足

warning.en: Secure the vehicle with the parking brake and confirm Park or Neutral as instructed. Test heating and cooling only outdoors or with adequate ventilation under model-permitted conditions. If an internal-combustion engine must run, a qualified driver remains in control; never idle in an enclosed garage or leave the vehicle unattended.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳、驻车制动生效并按手册确认驻车档/空档；只在室外或充分通风处按车型允许工况测试制冷/制热。燃油发动机需要运行时由有资格驾驶员控制，不得在封闭车库怠速或让车辆无人看管。

en: Under permitted operating conditions, select cooling, heating, airflow levels, and directions and allow a reasonable response time to record temperature change, airflow, noise, and abnormal odor noticed passively. Never sniff closely at a vent.
zh: 在车辆手册允许工况下分别设置制冷、制热、不同风量和风向，等待合理时间记录温度变化、风量、噪声和被动察觉的异常气味；不得贴近出风口嗅闻。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 空调系统

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Window movement, stop or safety-function defect
localized_label.zh: 车窗动作、停位或安全功能异常

abnormal_observation.en: Binding, skew, abnormal noise, failed sealing or stopping, or no reversal during a no-injury anti-pinch test is abnormal; never use fingers or another body part.
abnormal_observation.zh: 车窗卡滞、偏斜、异响、无法密封/停位，或无伤害测试下防夹不反向；不得用手指或身体测试。

check_what.en: Follow the owner manual and use a method that cannot injure a person; never use fingers or another body part to test anti-pinch.
check_what.zh: 按车辆手册使用无身体夹伤风险的方法验证防夹；不得用手指或身体测试。

detailed_explanation.en: “Window operation” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “车窗升降”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: Each window moves smoothly, stops and seals correctly, and anti-pinch is verified only by a manual-defined no-injury method with the expected reversal.
normal_observation.zh: 各车窗升降平顺、能正确停位和密封；防夹仅按手册使用无人体夹伤风险的方法验证并有正确反向响应。

en: testing anti-pinch with fingers or the body
forcibly blocking a powered closure
zh: 用手指或身体测试防夹
强行阻挡电动开合件

en: the closure moves abnormally
anti-pinch cannot be tested without body contact
a person or object enters the travel path
zh: 开合件运动异常
防夹测试无法在无人体接触下完成
有人或物进入运动路径

warning.en: Clear the closing path and keep fingers, bodies, and loose objects away; use only the no-injury method described by the vehicle instructions.
warning.zh: 先清空开合路径，远离手指、身体和松动物；只能按车辆手册使用无夹伤风险的方法测试。

en: Follow the owner manual and use a method that cannot injure a person; never use fingers or another body part to test anti-pinch.
zh: 按车辆手册使用无身体夹伤风险的方法验证防夹；不得用手指或身体测试。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 车窗升降

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Front-trunk lid movement or latch defect
localized_label.zh: 前备箱盖运动或锁止异常

localized_label.en: Weather-seal damage, deterioration or displacement
localized_label.zh: 密封条破损、老化或脱位

localized_label.en: Visible waterline, dampness or related deposit
localized_label.zh: 可见水线、潮湿或相关沉积迹象

abnormal_observation.en: Binding, sudden dropping, abnormal noise, failed latching, a damaged seal, or water trace requires an immediate stop without forcing, blocking, or observing from the travel path.
abnormal_observation.zh: 盖板动作卡滞、突然下落、异响、无法锁止，或胶条破损/水迹；立即停止，不强推、阻挡或在运动路径内观察。

check_what.en: Clear the front-trunk lid path and keep people, fingers, and loose objects away. Following the vehicle instructions, operate the fitted powered or manual opening and closing method once without forcing or blocking it, then inspect the weather seal and latch only while the lid is stationary; stop for abnormal movement.
check_what.zh: 清空前备箱盖运动路径并让人员、手指和松动物远离；按车辆手册仅测试本车实际配备的电动或手动开启/关闭方式一次，不强推或阻挡。随后在盖板静止时观察防水胶条和锁扣；动作异常立即停止。

detailed_explanation.en: “Front trunk (if equipped)” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “前备箱（Frunk）”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After clearing the travel path, the fitted front-trunk opening and closing method operates smoothly once, and while stationary its latch and weather seal are intact and the area is dry.
normal_observation.zh: 清空运动路径后，实际配备的前备箱开启/关闭方式一次运行平顺，盖板静止时锁扣和防水胶条完整、周边干燥。

en: blocking the lid with a hand or body or remaining in its travel zone
forcing or repeatedly cycling a binding lid
inspecting the latch, seal, or hinge while the lid moves
zh: 用手或身体阻挡盖板或停留在运动区
强推、强拉或反复循环卡滞盖板
盖板运动时观察锁扣、胶条或铰链

en: the lid binds, drops unexpectedly, makes abnormal noise, or will not latch reliably
a person, clothing, or object enters the travel zone
operation would require blocking, forcing, repeated cycling, or bypassing an interlock
zh: 盖板卡滞、突然下落、异响或无法可靠锁止
人员、衣物或物品进入运动区
操作需要阻挡、强推、反复循环或绕过联锁

warning.en: Park the vehicle and confirm the front-trunk operating method in the instructions. Clear the entire lid travel zone and keep people, bodies, clothing, and objects away; perform one normal cycle only and inspect the latch and seal only after the lid is fully stationary.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳并按手册确认前备箱开合方式；清空整个盖板运动区，让人员、身体、衣物和物品全部远离，只执行一次正常开合。盖板完全静止后才观察锁扣和胶条。

en: Clear the front-trunk lid path and keep people, fingers, and loose objects away. Following the vehicle instructions, operate the fitted powered or manual opening and closing method once without forcing or blocking it, then inspect the weather seal and latch only while the lid is stationary; stop for abnormal movement.
zh: 清空前备箱盖运动路径并让人员、手指和松动物远离；按车辆手册仅测试本车实际配备的电动或手动开启/关闭方式一次，不强推或阻挡。随后在盖板静止时观察防水胶条和锁扣；动作异常立即停止。

why_important.en: Fit, paint, tires, and exterior closures affect vehicle condition and future repairs.
why_important.zh: 装配、漆面、轮胎和外部开合件会影响车辆状态与后续维修。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 前备箱（Frunk）

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Only explicit unavailability, faults, calibration or unresolved records for this vehicle’s lane assistance and adaptive cruise; do not add AEB absent from this source.
localized_label.zh: 只核对本车车道保持和自适应巡航的明确不可用、故障、校准或未处理记录；不扩展为本来源未列的AEB。

abnormal_observation.en: An unavailable or fault display, incomplete calibration, or unresolved record requires professional follow-up; a general user must not release control or create following or lane-departure scenarios.
abnormal_observation.zh: 显示不可用/故障、校准未完成或记录有未处理问题；普通用户不松手、不制造跟车/偏离场景验证，转专业程序。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked, review only displayed availability, settings, calibration prompts, and service records for fitted lane keeping and adaptive cruise. A general user must not release control, depart a lane, or create a following scenario to trigger intervention; refer dynamic validation.
check_what.zh: 车辆停稳时只核对如配备的车道保持和自适应巡航显示可用性、设置、校准提示及维修记录；普通用户不得为验证介入而松开控制、偏离车道或制造跟车场景，动态验证转专业程序。

detailed_explanation.en: “Stationary driver-assistance status and records” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “驾驶辅助静态状态与记录”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked, fitted lane-keeping and adaptive-cruise functions are reviewed only through displayed availability, settings, and service records, with no fault or unresolved prompt and no intentional intervention test.
normal_observation.zh: 车辆停稳时，如配备的车道保持和自适应巡航仅核对显示可用性、设置及维修记录，未见故障或未处理提示；未主动触发介入。

en: releasing control, departing a lane, or approaching a vehicle to verify operation
using a person, vehicle, or object as a trigger target
intentionally testing intervention on a public road
zh: 为验证而松手、偏离车道或靠近前车
设置人员/车辆/物体作为触发目标
在公共道路主动测试介入

en: a fault, unavailable state, or incomplete calibration is displayed
verification would require vehicle movement or a trigger scenario
model instructions, permission, or relevant records are unavailable
zh: 显示故障、不可用或校准未完成
验证需要移动车辆或制造触发场景
缺少车型说明、权限或相关记录

warning.en: A general user may review only parked driver-assistance availability displays, settings, calibration prompts, and service records. Never release control, depart a lane, create a following or obstacle scenario, or intentionally trigger intervention.
warning.zh: 普通用户只在车辆停稳时核对驾驶辅助显示可用性、设置、校准提示和维修记录；不得松开控制、偏离车道、制造跟车/障碍场景或主动触发介入。

en: With the vehicle parked, review only displayed availability, settings, calibration prompts, and service records for fitted lane keeping and adaptive cruise. A general user must not release control, depart a lane, or create a following scenario to trigger intervention; refer dynamic validation.
zh: 车辆停稳时只核对如配备的车道保持和自适应巡航显示可用性、设置、校准提示及维修记录；普通用户不得为验证介入而松开控制、偏离车道或制造跟车场景，动态验证转专业程序。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 驾驶辅助静态状态与记录

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Only connector insecurity, water traces, burned/melted appearance or damage and immediate hazards; never touch or force removal of a suspect connector.
localized_label.zh: 只记录接口松动、水迹、烧熔样外观或损伤及即时危险；不触碰或强拔危险接口。

localized_label.en: Charging malfunction after a safe connection
localized_label.zh: 安全连接后的实际充电异常

abnormal_observation.en: Failure to start, repeated interruption, abnormal zero power, looseness, water, scorching, abnormal heat, arcing, or a vehicle or charger warning is abnormal. Stop charging through the normal safe control when possible. Do not touch or force-disconnect a wet, hot, arcing, or damaged connector; keep clear and follow equipment emergency guidance for professional help, unplugging normally only after it is confirmed de-energized and safe under the instructions.
abnormal_observation.zh: 无法开始/反复中断充电、功率异常为零、接口松动/水迹/烧蚀、异常发热、打火或车辆/充电器报警；优先用正常安全控制停止充电。潮湿、发热、打火或连接器损伤时不要触碰/强拔，远离并按设备应急指引联系专业处置；仅在确认断电、安全且说明允许后正常拔除。

check_what.en: If an intact, compatible, safely grounded charger is available, connect it and confirm that the vehicle reports active charging and power; do not treat one indicator color as a cross-brand rule.
check_what.zh: 如有完好、兼容且安全接地的充电设备，连接后确认车辆显示正在充电及充电功率；不要把特定指示灯颜色当作跨品牌统一结论。

detailed_explanation.en: “Charging test” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “充电测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: After connection to an intact, compatible, safely grounded charger, the vehicle reports active charging and plausible power, and the interface remains dry without abnormal heating or warning.
normal_observation.zh: 使用完好、兼容且安全接地的设备连接后，车辆明确显示正在充电及合理充电功率，接口保持干燥、无异常发热/报警。

en: touching charging terminals or dismantling an energized high-voltage system
using damaged equipment, an unapproved adapter, or a wet inlet
bypassing a charging interlock or forcing the connector
zh: 触碰充电端子或带电拆解高压系统
使用破损设备、非批准转接件或潮湿接口
绕过充电联锁或强行插拔连接器

en: the inlet, connector, or cable is wet, cracked, scorched, or loose
arcing, abnormal heat, burning odor, a warning, or failure to latch appears
charger compatibility, grounding, or site power conditions cannot be confirmed
zh: 接口、插头或线缆有水迹、裂损、烧蚀或松动
出现打火、异常发热、焦味、报警或无法可靠锁止
设备兼容性、接地或现场供电条件无法确认

warning.en: With the vehicle parked and the inlet, hands, and ground dry, use only an intact model-compatible charger grounded as instructed. Never touch terminals, use an unapproved adapter, or bypass an interlock.
warning.zh: 车辆停稳且接口、手部和地面干燥时，只使用外观完好、车型兼容并按说明可靠接地的充电设备；不得触碰端子、使用非批准转接件或绕过联锁。

en: If an intact, compatible, safely grounded charger is available, connect it and confirm that the vehicle reports active charging and power; do not treat one indicator color as a cross-brand rule.
zh: 如有完好、兼容且安全接地的充电设备，连接后确认车辆显示正在充电及充电功率；不要把特定指示灯颜色当作跨品牌统一结论。

why_important.en: Display, charging, driver-assistance, and electronic functions affect use and safety boundaries.
why_important.zh: 显示、充电、驾驶辅助和电子功能会影响车辆使用与安全边界。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 充电测试

change_reason.en: Retain the existing professional method, stable key and provenance; add position tasks, stable finding codes and contextual measurement contracts.
change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Cabin-trim noise over a minor unevenness
localized_label.zh: 轻微起伏时车内饰件异响

localized_label.en: Underbody noise or abnormal after-motion over a minor unevenness
localized_label.zh: 轻微起伏时底盘异响或异常余振

abnormal_observation.en: Repeatable knocking, creaking, rubbing, or loose noise over minor unevenness is abnormal; never seek potholes, accelerate into impacts, or repeat the pass.
abnormal_observation.zh: 轻微起伏即触发可重复敲击、咯吱、摩擦或松散声；不得主动找坑、加速冲击或反复通过，记录来源区域并复检。

check_what.en: Only during a normal low-speed trip, a qualified driver may cross one unavoidable minor uneven section or compliant speed hump while seated occupants record chassis, door, and dashboard noise. Never seek potholes, accelerate into an impact, or repeat the pass.
check_what.zh: 仅在正常低速行程中由有资格驾驶员一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏或合规减速带，乘员从座位上记录底盘、车门和中控台异响；不得主动找坑、加速冲击或反复通过。

detailed_explanation.en: “Road-test noise check” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “异响测试”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: During a normal low-speed trip, one unavoidable minor uneven section or compliant speed hump produces no repeatable loose, knocking, or rubbing noise from the chassis, doors, or dashboard.
normal_observation.zh: 正常低速行程中一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏或合规减速带时，底盘、车门和中控台无重复松散、敲击或摩擦声。

en: emergency or limit maneuvers in public traffic
testing beyond the driver's competence
zh: 在公共交通中进行紧急或极限动作
超出驾驶员能力测试

en: a qualified driver, legal low-risk route, or seller permission is unavailable
traffic, road, or vehicle conditions are unsafe
zh: 没有合格驾驶员、合法低风险路段或卖家同意
交通、路面或车辆状态不安全

warning.en: Only a qualified driver may test in a legal, open, low-speed setting with permission; stop for unsafe traffic, road, or vehicle conditions.
warning.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、空旷、低速且卖家同意的环境测试；交通、路面或车辆状态不安全时立即停止。

en: Only during a normal low-speed trip, a qualified driver may cross one unavoidable minor uneven section or compliant speed hump while seated occupants record chassis, door, and dashboard noise. Never seek potholes, accelerate into an impact, or repeat the pass.
zh: 仅在正常低速行程中由有资格驾驶员一次通过不可避免的轻微起伏或合规减速带，乘员从座位上记录底盘、车门和中控台异响；不得主动找坑、加速冲击或反复通过。

why_important.en: Low-speed dynamic behavior can reveal noise, steering, or regenerative-braking issues missed while parked.
why_important.zh: 低速动态表现可暴露静态检查无法发现的异响、转向或再生制动问题。

change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Suddenly absent or fluctuating regeneration, unpredictable jerk, an unresponsive one-pedal setting, or a powertrain or brake warning is abnormal; retain brake control and stop testing.
localized_label.zh: 再生减速突然缺失、强弱跳变、不可预测顿挫、单踏板设置不响应或出现动力/制动警告；保持制动控制并停止测试。

abnormal_observation.en: Suddenly absent or fluctuating regeneration, unpredictable jerk, an unresponsive one-pedal setting, or a powertrain or brake warning is abnormal; retain brake control and stop testing.
abnormal_observation.zh: 再生减速突然缺失、强弱跳变、不可预测顿挫、单踏板设置不响应或出现动力/制动警告；保持制动控制并停止测试。

check_what.en: Only during an ordinary legal low-risk trip, a qualified driver may normally release the accelerator once while retaining full braking control and observe whether regenerative deceleration is continuous and predictable. Never repeat abrupt lift-off or create a limit stop.
check_what.zh: 仅由有资格驾驶员在合法、低风险且周围安全的正常行程中按平常方式松开加速踏板一次，保持随时制动控制并观察再生减速是否连续可预测；不得反复急收油或制造极限制动。

detailed_explanation.en: “Regenerative braking” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “动能回收”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: When a qualified driver normally releases the accelerator in a legal low-risk setting, regenerative deceleration builds continuously and predictably without severe jerk or a warning.
normal_observation.zh: 有资格驾驶员在合法低风险环境按正常方式松开加速踏板时，再生减速建立连续、可预测，车辆无剧烈顿挫或警告。

change_reason.zh: 保留既有专业方法、稳定键和来源；新增位置执行、固定异常代码和上下文测量合同。

localized_label.en: Abrupt effort change, binding, kickback, abnormal noise, or a steering fault is abnormal; never force full lock, hold a stop, or perform limit steering while moving.
localized_label.zh: 阻力突变、卡顿、回弹、异响或转向故障提示；不强行打满、不持续顶住止点，也不在移动中做极限转向。

abnormal_observation.en: Abrupt effort change, binding, kickback, abnormal noise, or a steering fault is abnormal; never force full lock, hold a stop, or perform limit steering while moving.
abnormal_observation.zh: 阻力突变、卡顿、回弹、异响或转向故障提示；不强行打满、不持续顶住止点，也不在移动中做极限转向。

check_what.en: With the vehicle parked on level ground and tire areas clear, turn the steering slowly through the range permitted by the vehicle instructions and observe smoothness or noise. Do not force or hold it against a mechanical stop or perform limit steering while moving.
check_what.zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳并清空轮胎附近后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘至允许范围，观察是否顺滑或有异响；不要强行打到或持续保持机械止点，也不要在移动中做极限转向。

detailed_explanation.en: “Stationary steering smoothness and noise” cross-checks on-site observations against the vehicle instructions, fitted configuration, and available records without disassembly or crossing a safety boundary.
detailed_explanation.zh: “驻车转向顺滑性与异响”用于在不拆解、不越过安全边界的前提下，把现场观察与车辆手册、实际配置及可用记录相互核对。

normal_observation.en: While parked on level ground, slow steering within the manual-permitted range is smooth with continuous effort and no binding, noise, or fault, without holding a mechanical stop.
normal_observation.zh: 水平地面驻车时，方向盘在手册允许范围内缓慢转动平顺，阻力连续，无卡顿、异响或故障提示，未顶住机械止点。

en: forcing or holding the steering against its stop
placing hands or feet near tires or steering linkages
performing limit steering while the vehicle is moving
zh: 强行打到或持续保持转向止点
把手脚伸入轮胎或转向机构附近
在车辆移动中做极限转向

en: the steering binds, makes severe noise, shows a warning, or changes resistance abruptly
the vehicle or a wheel moves unexpectedly
a person or obstacle enters a tire area
zh: 方向盘卡滞、剧烈异响、故障警告或阻力突变
车辆或车轮发生非预期移动
有人或障碍物进入轮胎附近

warning.en: Park on level ground and clear the surrounding and tire areas, then turn the steering slowly as permitted by the vehicle instructions. Observe smoothness and noise only within the permitted range; never force or hold the steering against a mechanical stop.
warning.zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳、周围和轮胎附近清空后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘；只在允许范围内观察顺滑性和异响，不强行顶到或持续保持机械止点。

en: With the vehicle parked on level ground and tire areas clear, turn the steering slowly through the range permitted by the vehicle instructions and observe smoothness or noise. Do not force or hold it against a mechanical stop or perform limit steering while moving.
zh: 车辆在水平地面停稳并清空轮胎附近后，按车型手册缓慢转动方向盘至允许范围，观察是否顺滑或有异响；不要强行打到或持续保持机械止点，也不要在移动中做极限转向。

why_important.en: Suspension and steering faults affect control, tire wear, and emergency maneuvering.
why_important.zh: 悬挂与转向异常会影响车辆控制、轮胎磨损和紧急避让能力。

reinspection_advice.en: Recheck using the original method and safety boundary; insufficient conditions, visibility or evidence remain unknown.
reinspection_advice.zh: 按原方法和安全边界复核；条件、视野或来源不足时记录无法确认。

title.zh: 驻车转向顺滑性与异响
